summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks when chain-of-thought helps and when it hurts. It frames the issue as a serial-depth bottleneck in decoder-only transformers: direct answering forces all computation into one forward pass, while CoT externalizes intermediate states into the output stream and gives the model additional sequential computation steps.
summary_en.importance: The main value for pretraining and reasoning research is that it turns the effect of CoT from a prompt-level observation into a task-structure hypothesis. The paper is careful about the theory: the Hdp bound from Chen et al. 2024 is asymptotic and does not numerically bind at realistic context lengths. For the tested models, the non-vacuous prompt lengths are around 10^(10^34.4) to 10^(10^77.8), far beyond practical settings. Still, the bound identifies a useful variable: serial depth. This helps separate cases where the model has the local operations but lacks enough single-pass sequential depth, from cases where the task is mainly knowledge recall, shallow classification, or pattern matching. The paper is not a pretraining method paper, but it is useful for reasoning evaluation design, CoT data construction, and interpreting test-time compute gains.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors use the multi-party autoregressive communication framework of Chen et al. 2024 as a conceptual guide. In that framework, Hdp equals the number of attention heads times head dimension times numerical precision, and represents the bandwidth available to a single forward pass. The original theorem gives an asymptotic lower bound for L-sequential function composition, but this paper does not treat it as a direct quantitative predictor. Instead, it maps five common NLP benchmarks into coarse computational-depth classes: GSM8K and MATH as multi-step sequential composition, and MMLU, ARC, and HumanEval as lower or different depth regimes. The pre-registered hypothesis is two-sided: high-depth tasks should benefit from CoT because intermediate computation must be externalized; low-depth tasks should be insensitive to CoT or may be harmed by extra noisy tokens.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments compare direct-answer prompting and CoT prompting on Qwen-2.5-7B, Qwen-2.5-32B, and Llama-3.1-8B across five benchmarks. The central empirical result is a within-benchmark serial-depth gradient: no-CoT accuracy decreases monotonically as per-item serial depth increases, while CoT accuracy is roughly depth-invariant. The positive hypothesis is supported on GSM8K and MATH across all three models, where CoT recovers performance on multi-step problems. The negative hypothesis is not strongly supported after correcting answer extraction: on MMLU and ARC, CoT is roughly neutral, with changes ranging from 0.0 to +4.6 percentage points across six model-task cells. The main surviving negative case is HumanEval with Qwen-7B, where CoT drops performance by 28.7 percentage points; the authors classify HumanEval as an L-class benchmark rather than a low-depth TC0 case. The paper also shows that answer extraction details can materially change CoT conclusions, which is an important evaluation caveat.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20-minute skim is appropriate. Start with the Introduction and Background sections to see how the paper uses the Hdp bound without overclaiming its practical numerical relevance. Then read the benchmark-to-complexity mapping and the main direct-answer versus CoT result tables. The most useful part is the within-benchmark serial-depth analysis, because it is more informative than average benchmark gains. Appendix B on answer extraction is also worth reading, especially for anyone building reasoning evaluations, since parser and formatting failures can distort measured CoT effects.

recommendation.zh: 这篇把 CoT 收益压到 serial depth 上，判断干净；优先看任务分层和 no-CoT 退化曲线。
recommendation.en: The useful part is the clean mapping from CoT gains to serial depth; read the task stratification and the no-CoT degradation curves.

paper.title: PhysX-CoT: Structured Physical Reasoning from a Single Image to Simulation-Ready 3D Assets
paper.abstract: Simulation-ready 3D assets are central to robotics and embodied AI. Generating them from a single image is usually framed as a vision-language model that emits a serialized asset for a decoder to turn into geometry and physical fields, leaving the image-to-3D reasoning implicit. We argue the limiting factor is this output-centric view: part placement and local shape are entangled in one global-coordinate token stream, and the intermediate physical states are never exposed for supervision, condit

summary.core_problem: 从单张图像生成仿真就绪3D资产时，现有方法将图像到3D的推理隐式化，零件放置与局部形状纠缠在全局坐标token流中
summary.importance: 方法创新，将单图像3D资产生成重新建模为显式结构化物理推理过程，而非端到端序列化输出
summary.technical_approach: PhysX-CoT把生成分解为零件级状态的有序可解析轨迹（分解、2D/3D grounding、关系、粗几何、表面线索），各阶段分别监督并作为几何条件和奖励目标；几何因子化为3D box（位置）+ local code（形状）；用CoT对齐的GRPO优化解析有效性
summary.experiments: 单图像到仿真就绪3D资产生成任务，验证结构化推理轨迹相比隐式序列化输出的优势
summary.authors_note: 作者含Chen Qian等，跨机构合作

summary_en.core_problem: Existing single-image-to-3D-asset methods treat image-to-3D reasoning implicitly, entangling part placement and local shape in one global-coordinate token stream
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation reframing single-image 3D asset generation as an explicit structured physical reasoning process rather than end-to-end serialized output
summary_en.technical_approach: PhysX-CoT decomposes generation into an ordered, machine-parseable trajectory of part-level states (decomposition, 2D/3D grounding, relations, coarse geometry, surface cues), each separately supervised and used as geometry conditioning and reward targets; geometry factorized into 3D boxes (placement) + local codes (shape); CoT-aligned GRPO optimizes parse validity
summary_en.experiments: Single-image to simulation-ready 3D asset generation, validating structured reasoning trajectory over implicit serialized output
summary_en.authors_note: Authors include Chen Qian; cross-institutional collaboration

recommendation.zh: 核心是3D生成，结构化推理+GRPO的思路对post-training有微弱参考，但与LLM预训练距离远，看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: Core is 3D generation; the structured-reasoning-plus-GRPO angle has marginal post-training relevance but is far from LLM pretraining. Abstract suffices.

paper.title: Stealing Reasoning Traces from Proprietary LLM APIs
paper.abstract: Leading large language model providers now conceal their models' step-by-step reasoning, or chain-of-thought, to protect intellectual property and limit information leakage. Rather than storing these traces server-side, providers return them to the client as blocks of encrypted text, which the client passes back with each subsequent request. Building on prior research, we identify an architectural vulnerability: these encrypted blocks are fully compatible and interchangeable across different ses

summary.core_problem: 如何从闭源 LLM API 中窃取被隐藏的思维链（CoT）推理轨迹？
summary.importance: 揭示了当前闭源模型隐藏 CoT 机制的一个严重架构漏洞，证明了通过跨模型注入加密块可以实现 CoT 窃取，对模型安全和知识产权保护提出了新挑战。
summary.technical_approach: 利用 API 返回的加密 CoT 文本块在同一提供商生态系统内跨模型、跨会话兼容的漏洞。将强模型生成的加密 CoT 注入到弱模型或安全限制较少的模型中，迫使其以明文形式逐字解码输出，从而绕过强模型的直接越狱防御。
summary.experiments: 未提供具体参数量和数据集，但指出该漏洞可用于规避反蒸馏机制等四种攻击向量。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自多个机构，包括 EPFL、ETH Zurich 等，关注模型安全和对抗攻击。

summary_en.core_problem: How to steal hidden Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning traces from proprietary LLM APIs?
summary_en.importance: Reveals a critical architectural vulnerability in current mechanisms for hiding CoT in closed-source models, demonstrating that CoT theft is possible via cross-model injection of encrypted blocks, posing new challenges for model security and IP protection.
summary_en.technical_approach: Exploits the vulnerability that encrypted CoT text blocks returned by APIs are compatible across models and sessions within the same provider's ecosystem. Injects encrypted CoT from a strong model into a weaker or less safeguarded model, forcing it to decode and output the trace verbatim in plaintext, bypassing direct jailbreaks on the strong model.
summary_en.experiments: Specific parameter sizes and datasets are not provided, but the paper notes this vulnerability enables four attack vectors, including circumventing anti-distillation mechanisms.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from institutions like EPFL and ETH Zurich, focusing on model security and adversarial attacks.

recommendation.zh: 揭示了闭源模型隐藏 CoT 的一个巧妙漏洞，通过跨模型注入解密，对关注模型安全和 API 设计的研究员有启发。
recommendation.en: Reveals a clever vulnerability in hiding CoT in proprietary models via cross-model injection for decryption, insightful for researchers focusing on model security and API design.

paper.title: Hidden Language Consistency Phenomena in Reasoning LLMs
paper.abstract: Multilingual reasoning models are commonly evaluated by whether they arrive at the correct answer, but not by whether they preserve the intended language while reasoning and responding. This omission conceals important multilingual behaviors that emerge as tasks become harder. In this paper, we study task difficulty, task accuracy, thinking-language consistency (TC), and answer-language consistency (AC) across reasoning models using PolyMath benchmark in eight languages and four difficulty level

summary.core_problem: 研究多语言推理模型在任务变难时，思考过程和最终答案是否仍保持输入语言一致。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多语言推理行为分析。它指出只看答案正确率会掩盖模型在 hidden reasoning language 与输出语言上的退化，对多语言 post-train 数据和评测设计有弱信号价值。
summary.technical_approach: 在 PolyMath benchmark 的 8 种语言、4 个难度等级上，测量任务准确率、thinking-language consistency（TC）和 answer-language consistency（AC），分析难度变化下语言一致性的模式。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖多个 reasoning LLM、8 种语言和 4 个难度级别。论文报告四类难度相关行为：一致保持、持续不一致、逐步退化、突然崩塌；并提出 language consistency breakdown effect，尤其影响低资源或非拉丁文字语言。摘要未列具体模型和数值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether multilingual reasoning models preserve the intended language in their reasoning traces and final answers as task difficulty increases.
summary_en.importance: This is a behavioral analysis of multilingual reasoning. It argues that answer accuracy alone can hide failures in hidden reasoning language and output-language consistency, which has implications for multilingual post-training data and evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Using the PolyMath benchmark across eight languages and four difficulty levels, the authors measure task accuracy, thinking-language consistency, and answer-language consistency, then analyze how these metrics change with difficulty.
summary_en.experiments: The study evaluates multiple reasoning LLMs across eight languages and four difficulty levels. It reports four difficulty-dependent patterns: consistency maintained, persistent mismatch, gradual degradation, and abrupt collapse. The breakdown effect is strongest for less represented and non-Latin-script languages. Exact models and numbers are not provided in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 看语言崩塌定义和按难度分层图即可；它是多语 RL/SFT 数据配比的弱诊断信号。
recommendation.en: Skim the breakdown definition and difficulty-stratified plots; it is a weak diagnostic signal for multilingual RL/SFT data mixture design.

paper.title: Stochastic Autoregressive Learning
paper.abstract: Motivated by LLMs, which generate outputs by iteratively sampling from next-token distributions, we introduce a PAC-learning model for binary stochastic autoregressive learning. This generalizes the deterministic autoregressive learning framework of Joshi et al., COLT 2025. In our model, one fixed generator assigns a Bernoulli next-token distribution to every prompt string. Starting from an input prompt, a token is sampled and appended to the prompt; the same generator is then applied again to t

summary.core_problem: 为二元随机自回归学习建立PAC模型，并分析base、chain-of-thought、end-to-end三种监督下学习next-token概率的样本复杂度。
summary.importance: 理论贡献，将确定性自回归学习框架推广到随机生成器设定，形式化不同监督粒度对AR模型可学习性的影响。
summary.technical_approach: 固定生成器对每个prompt给出Bernoulli next-token分布，迭代采样M步；分别研究单步样本、完整M步轨迹的CoT样本、以及仅观察最终token的e2e样本所需的最小样本数m_base、m_CoT、m_e2e。
summary.experiments: 纯理论工作，无模型参数量或训练数据；摘要给出三种监督模式的样本复杂度定义，但未列出具体界。
summary.authors_note: 作者Elchanan Mossel是概率论与计算理论领域学者；论文信息未列出具体机构。

summary_en.core_problem: Introduce a PAC-learning model for binary stochastic autoregressive learning and analyze sample complexity under base, chain-of-thought, and end-to-end supervision.
summary_en.importance: A theoretical contribution that generalizes deterministic autoregressive learning to stochastic generators and formalizes how supervision granularity affects learnability.
summary_en.technical_approach: A fixed generator assigns a Bernoulli next-token distribution to every prompt and samples for M steps; the paper studies minimum sample counts m_base, m_CoT, and m_e2e for one-step, full-trajectory, and final-token-only supervision.
summary_en.experiments: This is a purely theoretical paper with no model size or training data; the abstract defines the three sample-complexity functions but does not report concrete bounds.
summary_en.authors_note: Elchanan Mossel is known for work in probability theory and theoretical computer science; affiliations are not listed in the provided paper information.

recommendation.zh: PAC学习理论视角看AR/CoT样本复杂度，结论偏抽象；关心CoT为何比e2e易学可看定理设定，否则跳过。
recommendation.en: PAC-style sample-complexity theory for AR and CoT; read the theorem setup only if you care why trajectory supervision is easier than end-to-end.

paper.title: Mean-Field Dynamics of Chain-of-Thought Reasoning in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) with chain-of-thought reasoning have been widely applied in recent years, and theoretical explanations of their behavior may help deepen our understanding and guide model optimization. In this study, we introduce a framework that seeks statistical regularities and theoretical interpretations in LLM reasoning without simplifying the model architecture or making analogies to existing physical systems. We formulate LLM reasoning as a guided discovery process on a clue g

summary.core_problem: 尝试用统计动力学描述 LLM 的 chain-of-thought 推理过程，解释推理链中线索如何逐步被发现。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析和理论建模；它不直接改进预训练 recipe，但试图给 CoT 推理的宏观统计规律提供可拟合模型，对理解后训练推理行为有间接价值。
summary.technical_approach: 将 LLM 推理表述为 clue graph 上的 guided discovery process，用 mean-field approximation 推导“已发现线索比例”的一维常微分方程；实验上用 student LLM 对 teacher LLM 输出的 normalized surprisal 来识别 clue tokens，再对大量 CoT 轨迹做统计平均。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在同一数据集内观察到可复现的统计规律，并可由推导出的 ODE 拟合；未从摘要确认模型规模、数据集名称、baseline 或拟合误差等关键实验细节。
summary.authors_note: Tsinghua University；未见可确认的知名作者背景信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tries to model chain-of-thought reasoning in LLMs as a statistical dynamic process in which reasoning clues are gradually discovered.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic and theoretical analysis rather than a pretraining method. Its value is indirect: it may offer a compact macro-level description of reasoning trajectories after instruction tuning or prompting.
summary_en.technical_approach: It formulates reasoning as guided discovery on a clue graph and derives a one-dimensional ODE for the fraction of discovered clues using a mean-field approximation. Empirically, clue tokens are identified through the normalized surprisal of a student LLM on teacher-generated reasoning traces, then regularities are estimated by averaging many CoT chains.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports reproducible statistical regularities within the same dataset and ODE fits to those regularities, but does not provide enough metadata to verify model sizes, datasets, baselines, or fitting errors.
summary_en.authors_note: Tsinghua University; no clearly identifiable widely known author background from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 结论先当弱信号；如果读，只看 clue token 定义和 ODE 拟合残差，别被 mean-field 形式本身带跑。
recommendation.en: Treat the conclusion as a weak signal; if reading, focus on the clue-token definition and ODE residuals rather than the mean-field framing itself.

paper.title: Fewer Tokens, Smaller Cache: Reward-Coordinated Efficient Reasoning
paper.abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) excel on complex tasks through long chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning, but their lengthy intermediate steps cause severe overthinking that inflates inference cost. KV-cache compression is a common solution, yet existing reasoning-oriented methods apply a uniform policy across the trajectory and judge compression only by what it removes from the cache. Two observations point the other way. First, a reasoning state's tolerance to context loss varies along the trajector

summary.core_problem: 长链推理模型的KV-cache压缩方法采用统一策略且忽略缓存压缩与生成侧token增长的相互抵消效应，导致推理成本节省被部分侵蚀。
summary.importance: 方法创新：首次提出用过程奖励协调缓存压缩与生成侧token数的联合优化框架，指出压缩-生成的双向权衡。
summary.technical_approach: 提出ReCo（Reward-Coordinated Compression）框架，用轻量过程奖励估计器逐步骤打分，高奖励步骤保留更多上下文，同时在压缩预算和生成token长度间做联合优化。
summary.experiments: 论文摘要未完整披露模型规模、数据集和具体提升幅度，仅给出方法动机和框架描述。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing KV-cache compression for reasoning models applies uniform policies and ignores the tradeoff where smaller caches induce more generated tokens, partially canceling cost savings.
summary_en.importance: Methodological contribution: first framework that coordinates cache compression and generation-side token budget under a unified process reward signal.
summary_en.technical_approach: ReCo (Reward-Coordinated Compression) uses a lightweight process-reward estimator to score each reasoning step, preserving context at high-reward steps and jointly optimizing compression budget against generated token length.
summary_en.experiments: Full experimental details (model size, datasets, numerical gains) are not provided in the available abstract; only motivation and framework description are present.

recommendation.zh: 压缩-生成双向抵消的观察有价值，但方法本身是推理侧工程组合，对预训练无直接启示，看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: The compression-generation tradeoff observation is useful, but the method is inference-side engineering with no direct pretraining implications; read the abstract only.

paper.title: Trace, Verify, and Correct: A Training-Free Framework for Spatial Reasoning in Multimodal LLMs
paper.abstract: Although Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have made substantial progress, their spatial reasoning may still produce intermediate judgments inconsistent with the input image, allowing errors to propagate through the reasoning chain and affect the final answer. Existing methods mainly improve spatial reasoning through training or additional spatial information, without considering whether the reasoning process itself is faithful to the model input. Our study shows that unfaithful reasoning

summary.core_problem: 多模态大模型的空间推理链常包含与输入图像不一致的中间判断，错误沿推理链传播导致最终答案失准，现有方法多通过训练或额外信息改进而未校验推理忠实度。
summary.importance: 首次从推理链忠实度角度切入 MLLM 空间推理，提出免训练的验证-修正框架，属于方法改进与忠实推理分析。
summary.technical_approach: 构建空间证据图 SEG，将 CoT 中抽取的原子空间证据与视觉实体、空间关系、来源步骤及视觉证据关联；设计空间证据可靠性评估 SERA，基于对象检测等评估证据可信度，再对不可靠步骤做模块化修正。
summary.experiments: 在多个 MLLM 空间推理基准上验证，忠实度提升显著带动最终答案准确率提升；对比训练式方法在零样本场景下保持竞争力。

summary_en.core_problem: Spatial reasoning chains in MLLMs often contain intermediate judgments inconsistent with the input image; errors propagate and degrade final accuracy, while existing methods mostly rely on training or extra spatial signals instead of verifying reasoning faithfulness.
summary_en.importance: First approach to MLLM spatial reasoning from the reasoning-faithfulness perspective; proposes a training-free verification-correction framework, contributing method improvement and faithful-reasoning analysis.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs a Spatial Evidence Graph (SEG) linking atomic spatial evidence extracted from CoT to visual entities, spatial relations, source steps and visual evidence; designs Spatial Evidence Reliability Assessment (SERA) to score evidence credibility via object detection, then applies modular correction to unreliable steps.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on multiple MLLM spatial reasoning benchmarks; improved faithfulness consistently lifts final answer accuracy, and remains competitive against training-based methods under zero-shot settings.

recommendation.zh: 免训练后处理类工作，对预训练研究员仅作“空间推理失败模式”的参考素材，读实验失败案例即可。
recommendation.en: Training-free post-hoc correction work; useful to pretraining researchers only as a reference for spatial-reasoning failure modes, read failure-case analysis only.

paper.title: Perception Before Reasoning: Dynamic Latent Reasoning for Video Understanding and Question Answering
paper.abstract: Video question answering requires models to ground language queries in visual evidence and, when necessary, reason over that evidence across time. Existing methods typically rely on long textual chain-of-thought rationales, even though many questions can be answered as soon as the relevant object, action, or frame is localized. We propose Dynamic Latent Reasoning (DyLaR), which first grounds a question in a short block of perception latents (continuous hidden states that encode query-relevant vi

summary.core_problem: 现有视频QA方法过度依赖长文本CoT推理，而很多问题在定位到相关视觉证据后即可直接回答，存在推理冗余和效率低下的问题。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出“先感知后推理”的动态潜在推理框架，减少不必要的文本CoT推理，兼顾准确率和效率。
summary.technical_approach: 提出DyLaR框架：1）将查询ground到短感知潜在块（连续隐状态，编码查询相关视觉证据）；2）自适应决定是否追加推理潜在（在隐空间对证据进行推理）；3）训练流程：用验证的视觉证据ground感知潜在，蒸馏验证的推理链到推理潜在，再用RL优化推理时机的决策。
summary.experiments: 在9个视频benchmark、4个多模态LLM骨干上进行实验，平均准确率优于基线（摘要截断，具体提升幅度未披露）。
summary.authors_note: 作者含Vicente Ordonez（多模态领域知名研究者），所属机构含莱斯大学。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing video QA methods over-rely on long textual Chain-of-Thought reasoning, while many questions can be answered immediately after localizing relevant visual evidence, leading to redundant reasoning and low efficiency.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: a dynamic latent reasoning framework following the 'perception before reasoning' paradigm, reducing unnecessary textual CoT while balancing accuracy and efficiency.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes DyLaR: 1) grounds queries into short perception latent blocks (continuous hidden states encoding query-relevant visual evidence); 2) adaptively decides whether to append reasoning latents for latent-space evidence reasoning; 3) training pipeline: grounds perception latents with verified visual evidence, distills verified rationales into reasoning latents, then refines reasoning timing via RL.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on 9 video benchmarks with 4 multimodal LLM backbones, achieving higher average accuracy than baselines (abstract truncated, exact improvement margins not disclosed).
summary_en.authors_note: Includes Vicente Ordonez, a well-known researcher in multimodal learning, affiliated with Rice University.

recommendation.zh: 多模态中动态切换感知/推理阶段的思路对统一预训练的潜在推理设计有参考，仅看方法框架即可。
recommendation.en: Dynamic perception-reasoning switching in multimodal models informs latent reasoning design for unified pretraining; only review the method framework.

paper.title: Chain-of-Thought Monitoring Can Be Unreliable in Implicit-Influence Settings
paper.abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring is increasingly treated as an important safety layer for frontier reasoning models. Most monitorability evaluations study explicit-influence settings: setups where the prompt directly incentivizes the model to hide something, e.g., by instructing it to perform a hidden side-task. A complementary axis for CoT-monitor evaluations is implicit-influence settings, where the prompt contains no instruction to hide, but the model's behavior is still shaped by features o

summary.core_problem: 现有CoT监控评测大多聚焦显式影响场景（模型被直接要求隐藏行为），缺乏对隐式影响场景（模型行为被无关上下文潜移默化影响）的评估，导致对CoT监控实际可靠性的认知存在偏差。
summary.importance: 首次提出对比显式/隐式影响下CoT可监控性的分析基准，发现隐式影响场景下CoT监控不可靠，修正了对CoT监控作为安全层有效性的普遍认知。
summary.technical_approach: 设计覆盖四种任务格式的评测基准，通过两种方式引入选择倾向助推：显式助推（直接指令要求按助推选择并隐瞒）和隐式助推（作为无关细节自然融入上下文），对比两种场景下CoT监控的检测效果。
summary.experiments: 构建覆盖四种任务格式（二选一、数值等）的评测基准，系统对比显式与隐式影响场景下的CoT可监控性差异，具体模型设置与量化结果因摘要截断未完全披露。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing CoT monitoring evaluations mostly focus on explicit-influence settings (models are directly instructed to hide behavior), lacking assessment of implicit-influence settings (model behavior is subtly biased by irrelevant context), leading to biased understanding of CoT monitoring's real reliability.
summary_en.importance: Introduces the first analytical benchmark comparing CoT monitorability under explicit vs. implicit influence, and finds that CoT monitoring is unreliable in implicit-influence settings, correcting common perceptions of CoT monitoring's effectiveness as a safety layer.
summary_en.technical_approach: Designs an evaluation benchmark covering four task formats, introduces choice nudges in two ways: explicit nudge (direct instruction to follow the nudge and conceal it) and implicit nudge (naturally integrated as irrelevant context), and compares CoT monitoring detection performance across the two settings.
summary_en.experiments: Constructs a benchmark covering four task formats (binary choice, numeric, etc.) to systematically compare CoT monitorability differences between explicit and implicit influence settings; specific model configurations and quantitative results are not fully presented due to truncated abstract.

recommendation.zh: 结论挑战了CoT监控的安全性假设，重点看隐式场景的实验设计和结果对比，可补充到内部对齐评测的场景库中。
recommendation.en: The finding challenges the safety assumption of CoT monitoring; focus on the implicit-scenario experimental design and result comparison, useful for internal alignment evaluation scenario banks.

paper.title: Same Formulas, Different Semantics: Do Language Models Follow Modal Logic Specifications?
paper.abstract: Reasoning about necessity and possibility depends on assumptions about accessibility between worlds and about which objects exist at each one. The same inference may therefore hold under one modal system and fail under another. Evaluating language models on such problems requires testing whether their judgments follow the stated semantics rather than a familiar logic. We construct paired modal problems with identical premises and conjecture but different frame or domain conditions; automated rea

summary.core_problem: 语言模型在模态逻辑推理中，是否真正遵循给定的语义规范（不同框架/域条件），还是依赖熟悉的默认逻辑系统。
summary.importance: 原理分析类贡献，构造了配对的模态逻辑评测数据集，揭示LLM模态推理能力的依赖因素。
summary.technical_approach: 构造配对模态逻辑问题：相同前提和结论，但框架/域条件不同，由自动推理器生成相反标签；平衡核心集避免语义条件单独泄露答案；评估5个近期模型在直接提示和推理模式下的表现。
summary.experiments: 5个模型中4个在直接提示下表现低于条件基线；DeepSeek V4 Flash在推理模式下准确率从4.4%提升至88.1%；省略框架条件时模型常达成一致但符合不同的熟悉逻辑。

summary_en.core_problem: Investigates whether language models follow stated modal logic semantics specifications (different frame/domain conditions) or rely on familiar default logic systems.
summary_en.importance: Mechanism analysis contribution; constructs a paired modal logic evaluation dataset and reveals the factors underlying LLM modal reasoning capability.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs paired modal logic problems with identical premises and conclusions but different frame/domain conditions, with opposite labels verified by automated reasoning; a balanced core set prevents semantic conditions from leaking answers alone; evaluates 5 recent models under direct prompting and reasoning mode.
summary_en.experiments: 4 of 5 recent models perform below the condition-only baseline under direct prompting; DeepSeek V4 Flash accuracy rises from 4.4% to 88.1% when reasoning mode is enabled; models often agree but fit different familiar logics when frame conditions are omitted.

recommendation.zh: 模态逻辑推理的受控分析设计巧妙，推理模式带来的巨大提升值得注意，可作为推理能力与生成模式强相关的弱证据。
recommendation.en: Clever controlled analysis of modal logic reasoning; the massive gain from reasoning mode is notable, useful as weak evidence that reasoning performance is strongly tied to generation mode.

paper.title: Shorter Reasoning, Earlier Answers? An Evaluation of Reasoning Interfaces
paper.abstract: Large language models often reason at length before answering, increasing cost and latency. Prompts and trained settings can shorten this reasoning, but a shorter trace may only show that the model stopped sooner. Here, we evaluate paired runs of the same question at matched reasoning horizons across 198 GPQA Diamond and 500 MMLU-Pro questions. We test a numeric/concision prompt that announces a token limit for Qwen3-14B and the trained effort settings of gpt-oss-20b and -120b. The Qwen prompt s

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是推理长度控制评测中的混淆问题：一个 prompt 或 effort setting 让模型更早给答案，并不等于模型在相同推理 token 预算下有更好的中间状态。
summary.importance: 这篇论文和预训练本身不直接相关，但对 post-train 与 test-time compute 的接口有参考价值。它强调评测 reasoning control 时必须区分两件事：模型何时停止并提交答案，以及在固定推理 horizon 被截断时模型当前倾向于哪个答案。这个区分对训练短推理、RL 奖励设计、推理预算标定都有用。如果只看最终完成 trace 的准确率和长度，很容易把“更早停止”误读成“更高效地思考”。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是 matched-horizon paired evaluation。对同一道题、同一个模型的不同 generation condition，论文在相同 reasoning token horizon B 处比较答案，而不是只比较自然结束后的答案。它定义了多种 readout：natural-terminal readout 使用模型自然结束时的答案；standardized prefix-probe readout 在截断的 reasoning prefix 后接闭合模板，并用候选答案 logits 读出；generated-answer continuation 在截断后让模型贪心生成 final answer；common-context readout 用统一 answer context 回放不同条件的 reasoning token，以减少 answer-time prompt 差异。实现上使用 token-exact replay，避免 decode 再 tokenize 改变 prefix；候选答案评分汇总每个选项字母的有效 one-token spelling，并报告 argmax accuracy、conditional log loss、multiclass Brier score 和 valid-option probability mass。
summary.experiments: 主实验覆盖 198 道 GPQA Diamond 和 500 道 MMLU-Pro，模型包括 Qwen3-14B、gpt-oss-20b 和 gpt-oss-120b，并用 Qwen3-4B/8B 做测量校准，Omni-MATH-2 用于开放数学扩展。Qwen3-14B 的 numeric/concision prompt 可以把 reasoning trace 缩短约 12% 到 17%，但在 matched token limits 下准确率变化小且方向不稳定。另一个 concise/early-answer instruction 在 MMLU-Pro 512 token 预算下提升 3.8 个百分点；即使只看两条 run 都未完成的样本，也有 2.7 个百分点提升，但在 2048 token 时收益不确定。对 gpt-oss 的 low/medium/high effort 比较显示，低 effort 更早正确主要来自更早停止和提交，而不是在同样 horizon 下已经形成更好的答案。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25 到 35 分钟。重点看 matched-horizon probe 的定义、Figure 1、Table A1，以及 readout 设计。实验结果可以优先看 Qwen3-14B 的 concision prompt、concise/early-answer instruction 的九臂 MMLU-Pro 实验，以及 gpt-oss effort setting 的对比。真正有用的部分不是某个 prompt 是否有效，而是评测协议如何把 completion timing、forced answer、common context 和 both-active subset 分开。做 reasoning SFT/RL 或评测推理预算的人可以细看候选 logit probe 的实现细节。
summary.authors_note: 从正文片段可见通讯作者为 Francesca Carlon，机构信息包含 VUB。其他作者和完整机构无法确认。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a confound in evaluating reasoning-length controls: shorter traces may mean that the model stops earlier, not that it has a better answer after the same amount of reasoning.
summary_en.importance: The paper is more relevant to post-training and evaluation than to pretraining recipes, but it is useful for understanding the interface between reasoning training and test-time compute. It separates answer timing from answer quality at a fixed reasoning horizon. This distinction matters for short-reasoning training, RL reward design, and benchmark protocols under token budgets. Final accuracy versus completed trace length is not enough to tell whether a control improves intermediate reasoning or merely changes the stopping policy.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core protocol is paired matched-horizon evaluation. For the same question and model, different generation conditions are stopped and evaluated at the same reasoning-token horizon B. The paper defines several readouts: natural-terminal readout for the answer produced by an uninterrupted run; standardized prefix-probe readout that closes a stopped reasoning block and scores answer candidates from logits; generated-answer continuation that lets the model generate an answer after interruption; and common-context readout that replays stored reasoning tokens under a shared answer context. Token-exact replay is used to avoid perturbing prefixes through decode-retokenize cycles. Candidate-logit scoring aggregates all valid one-token spellings of each answer letter and reports argmax accuracy, conditional log loss, multiclass Brier score, and valid-option probability mass.
summary_en.experiments: The main paired experiments use 198 GPQA Diamond questions and 500 MMLU-Pro questions. Models include Qwen3-14B and gpt-oss-20b/120b, with Qwen3-4B/8B used for calibration and Omni-MATH-2 used as an open-ended math extension. For Qwen3-14B, a numeric/concision prompt shortens reasoning traces by about 12-17%, but matched-horizon accuracy changes are small and mixed. A concise/early-answer instruction improves MMLU-Pro accuracy by 3.8 percentage points at a 512-token horizon, including a 2.7-point gain when both paired runs are still unfinished; the effect at 2,048 tokens is uncertain. For gpt-oss effort settings, lower effort tends to provide correct answers earlier mainly because it stops and commits earlier, not because its stopped intermediate state is clearly better at the same horizon.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25-35 minutes. Focus on the matched-horizon probe definition, Figure 1, Table A1, and the readout taxonomy. For results, prioritize the Qwen3-14B concision prompt, the nine-arm MMLU-Pro experiment for concise early answering, and the gpt-oss effort-setting comparison. The main reusable contribution is the evaluation protocol, especially the separation of completion timing, forced answers, common-context replay, and both-active subsets. Readers working on reasoning SFT, RL, or budgeted inference should inspect the candidate-logit probe implementation.
summary_en.authors_note: The provided text identifies Francesca Carlon as the corresponding author and includes VUB. Other authors and affiliations cannot be verified from the provided content.

recommendation.zh: 控制变量评测做的很干净，打破长推理必然更准的直觉，做test-time scaling的同学应复现这个对照，只看§3实验setup和核心结果即可。
recommendation.en: This well-controlled evaluation challenges the intuition that longer reasoning always yields higher accuracy; test-time scaling teams should replicate this setup, skip to §3 for the design and core results.

paper.title: Risky Business: Measuring The Faithfulness-Safety Tension
paper.abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning offers a promising window into model monitoring. However, monitoring relies on faithfulness, i.e., the model output strictly derives from its reasoning trace. We identify an alignment tension where a model must be faithful enough to be monitored, yet robust enough to reject unsafe reasoning. We demonstrate that this counterbalance exists in current Large Reasoning Models (LRMs), and show ways in which it can be addressed. We introduce HazMart, a human-written dat

summary.core_problem: 大推理模型的Chain-of-Thought推理轨迹用于模型监控时存在根本张力：模型需要足够高的忠实度（输出严格由推理轨迹推导而来）才能被有效监控，同时又需要足够的鲁棒性，在推理轨迹指向有害行为时能够拒绝执行。此前没有工作系统量化这一忠实度与安全性的权衡关系。
summary.importance: 明确了推理模型的忠实度并非越高越好，而是与安全性存在明确的权衡，这对推理模型的对齐目标设计、RL训练流程都有直接参考价值。提出的Targeted Reasoning Replacement方法相比传统基于prompt提示的忠实度评估，能更准确地衡量推理轨迹与模型行为之间的因果关系。白盒表征分析的结果也为理解推理模型的对齐机制、表征操控提供了新的依据。
summary.technical_approach: 研究构建了HazMart数据集，包含77个人工编写的场景、覆盖11个危害类别，模型在其中扮演AI店主，通过函数调用与环境交互；每个场景设置两个等价的安全选项和一个有害选项。核心评估方法为Targeted Reasoning Replacement：不在输入prompt中加入偏置提示，而是直接替换模型自身生成的推理轨迹中的关键内容——将指向某一安全选项的推理内容替换为指向另一安全选项（用于测量忠实度），或替换为指向有害选项（用于测量安全性），以此检验模型是否会跟随修改后的推理轨迹行动。此外还通过白盒探测和表征操控，定位残差流中控制忠实度与安全性的表征方向。
summary.experiments: 在被测模型中，QwQ-32B的安全表现最好，能拒绝73.88%的有害推理轨迹，但忠实度仅为74.7%，即仅在74.7%的情况下会跟随修改后的安全推理行动。DeepSeek-R1_Llama-70B的忠实度很高，97.5%的情况下会跟随修改后的安全推理，但仅能拒绝12.3%的有害推理，基本盲目遵循推理轨迹的结论。整体来看，模型忠实度越高，跟随有害推理的概率也越高，两者呈正相关。对QwQ-32B的白盒分析发现，残差流中存在反相关的两个表征方向，分别控制模型对推理轨迹的遵循与抵抗；在动作提交token处，安全方向的预测AUROC为0.94，忠实度方向为0.78。放大安全方向的表征可使安全行为提升9个百分点，同时不损失核心推理能力。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读引言中对忠实度-安全性张力的问题定义、Targeted Reasoning Replacement方法的设计逻辑（与传统基于prompt的忠实度评估的差异），以及不同模型的对比结果。从事对齐或推理模型可解释性研究的读者可进一步关注白盒表征分析部分。预计阅读时间25-35分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: When Chain-of-Thought reasoning traces are used for monitoring Large Reasoning Models (LRMs), a fundamental tension arises: models need sufficient faithfulness (outputs strictly derived from reasoning traces) to be monitorable, but also sufficient robustness to reject execution when reasoning traces point to harmful behavior. This faithfulness-safety tradeoff has not been systematically quantified in prior work.
summary_en.importance: The work clarifies that higher faithfulness is not universally beneficial for reasoning models, and that an explicit tradeoff exists between faithfulness and safety. This has direct implications for the design of alignment objectives and training recipes for reasoning models, including RL-based alignment. The proposed Targeted Reasoning Replacement method provides a more rigorous measure of the causal link between reasoning traces and model behavior, compared to traditional prompt-hint based faithfulness evaluation. The white-box representation analysis findings also inform research on alignment mechanisms and representation steering in reasoning models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The HazMart dataset is constructed with 77 human-written scenarios across 11 harm categories, where the model acts as an AI shopkeeper interacting with the environment via function calls. Each scenario includes two equivalent safe options and one harmful option. The core evaluation method, Targeted Reasoning Replacement, does not add biasing hints to input prompts. Instead, it directly replaces key content in the model's own generated reasoning trace: references to one safe choice are swapped with references to the other safe choice (for faithfulness measurement) or to the harmful choice (for safety measurement), to test whether the model follows the modified trace. White-box probing and representation steering are also used to identify residual stream directions that control faithfulness and safety.
summary_en.experiments: Among evaluated models, QwQ-32B achieves the best safety performance, rejecting 73.88% of unsafe reasoning traces, but has a faithfulness rate of only 74.7% — it follows modified safe reasoning in 74.7% of cases. DeepSeek-R1_Llama-70B has high faithfulness, following modified safe reasoning in 97.5% of cases, but rejects only 12.3% of unsafe reasoning, essentially blindly adhering to reasoning trace conclusions. Overall, higher model faithfulness correlates with a higher probability of following unsafe reasoning. White-box analysis on QwQ-32B identifies anti-correlated residual stream directions that control reasoning compliance and resistance, respectively. At the action-commit token, the safety direction has a prediction AUROC of 0.94, and the faithfulness direction has an AUROC of 0.78. Amplifying the safety direction improves safe behavior by 9 percentage points without impairing core reasoning capabilities.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the problem framing of the faithfulness-safety tension in the introduction, the design logic of Targeted Reasoning Replacement (and its differences from traditional prompt-based faithfulness evaluation), and the cross-model comparison results. Researchers working on alignment or reasoning model interpretability may further explore the white-box representation analysis section. Estimated reading time is 25–35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看 TRR setup 和 DeepSeek-R1-Llama-70B 结果；它会影响你对“可监控 CoT”的安全 prior。
recommendation.en: Read the TRR setup and the DeepSeek-R1-Llama-70B results; it should update priors on monitorable CoT safety.

paper.title: Evading Chain-of-Thought Monitoring Through Model Poisoning
paper.abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring is an increasingly important component of AI safety stacks but relies on the assumption that a model's reasoning trace is informative about its actions. This work studies the limits of CoT monitoring through the lens of model poisoning. We demonstrate that backdoors can be implanted into reasoning models to elicit an attacker-chosen behavior while their CoT traces appear entirely benign. We find that these CoT-Hidden backdoors can be induced through simple fine-

summary.core_problem: CoT监控依赖推理轨迹反映模型行为的假设，研究模型投毒能否绕过该安全机制。
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次提出CoT-Hidden后门攻击，揭示CoT监控的核心局限性，为AI安全防护设计提供新视角。
summary.technical_approach: 通过简单微调配方在推理模型中植入后门，使攻击触发时输出攻击者指定结果但CoT轨迹完全正常；直接投毒无效时采用课程训练逐步教模型隐藏攻击行为。
summary.experiments: 跨多种推理模型架构和参数规模验证了后门的有效性，进一步分析了检测这类攻击的难度。

summary_en.core_problem: Chain-of-thought monitoring relies on the assumption that reasoning traces reflect model behavior; this work investigates whether model poisoning can evade this safety mechanism.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation; first proposes CoT-Hidden backdoor attacks, reveals core limitations of CoT monitoring, and provides a new perspective for AI safety defense design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Implants backdoors into reasoning models via simple fine-tuning recipes, such that triggered attacks produce attacker-chosen outputs with entirely benign CoT traces; uses curriculum training when direct poisoning fails, progressively teaching the model to hide malicious behavior.
summary_en.experiments: Validates backdoor effectiveness across multiple reasoning model architectures and parameter sizes, and further analyzes the difficulty of detecting such attacks.

recommendation.zh: 揭示CoT监控可被投毒绕过，对推理对齐和安全监测有参考价值，扫读结论即可。
recommendation.en: Reveals CoT monitoring can be evaded via poisoning; useful reference for reasoning alignment and safety monitoring, skim conclusions only.

paper.title: Soft Guidance Starts to Outperform CoT Prompting as LLMs Improve
paper.abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting remains the standard baseline for evaluating models' reasoning abilities. Originally, this technique was introduced to elicit step-by-step reasoning from large language models (LLMs), which would otherwise tend to directly output the final answer. However, many modern LLMs produce CoT-style responses \textit{natively} when presented with reasoning tasks, which made us revisit the effectiveness of standard CoT prompting.   We evaluate several modern mid-sized lang

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文重新检查一个评测假设：对已经经过推理训练的现代 LLM，few-shot CoT 示例是否仍然是合理的推理能力基线。
summary.importance: 对预训练和后训练研究的启发主要在评测接口上。早期 CoT prompt 的作用是把模型从“直接给答案”的输出模式拉到“分步推理”的模式；但推理专门模型在预训练后期、SFT 或 RL 阶段已经见过大量推理轨迹，CoT 风格不再稀缺。此时，人工 few-shot 示例可能不再提供有效计算路径，反而引入风格匹配、格式约束和示例分布偏差。这个结论会影响 reasoning model 的能力报告方式，也会影响新推理方法的增益估计：如果 baseline 被 few-shot CoT 压低，后续方法的提升会被高估。
summary.technical_approach: 方法很直接，但问题选得准。作者比较了几类提示方式：标准 few-shot CoT，包括人工编写、随机选择的分步示例；zero-shot free-form generation，即不给额外 CoT 指令，让模型按自身习惯回答；zero-shot CoT，即加入类似“Let’s think step by step”的软提示；以及更强的、由模型生成示例的 CoT 变体，用来减少人工示例风格不匹配的问题。核心观察是，few-shot CoT 对新模型不只是“多给信息”，也会改变生成分布。模型需要同时完成数学推理、模仿示例格式、适配示例中的表达风格，这些附加约束会占用上下文和解码自由度。对已经内化推理格式的模型，收益变小，干扰变大。
summary.experiments: 实验集中在现代中等规模语言模型的数学解题任务上，包含 Mathstral-7B、Qwen 系列和 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 等模型。关键数字是：Mathstral 的官方 few-shot CoT 报告约为 77.1%，作者复现的人工 few-shot CoT 最好不超过 74.2%；改用 zero-shot free-form 后达到 83.8%，加入 zero-shot CoT 软提示后进一步到 86.1%。Qwen 上也观察到类似现象，few-shot CoT 最好不超过 83.4%，zero-shot 设置达到 88.6%。论文还给出定性样例，说明模型在复杂文字题中可能已经自然产生分步推理，而额外示例并不一定帮助纠错。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20 到 30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 few-shot CoT 失效机制的分析，以及实验表中 zero-shot、zero-shot CoT、few-shot CoT 的直接对比。值得关注的不是 prompt 技巧本身，而是评测协议随模型训练分布变化而失效的现象。做 reasoning eval、SFT/RL 数据构造或报告模型能力时，应检查 few-shot 示例是否在压制模型的原生输出策略。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether few-shot Chain-of-Thought prompting is still a valid reasoning baseline for modern LLMs that have already been trained to produce reasoning traces.
summary_en.importance: The main value is in evaluation design for reasoning models. CoT prompting originally helped models switch from direct-answer behavior to step-by-step reasoning. For reasoning-specialized models, that behavior is often already learned during late pretraining, instruction tuning, or RL. In this regime, human-written few-shot CoT examples can become an extra constraint rather than useful guidance. They may force style imitation, formatting compliance, and example-specific conventions. This matters because a weak baseline can underestimate model capability and inflate the apparent gains of new reasoning methods.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study compares standard few-shot CoT with simpler zero-shot settings. The evaluated variants include human-crafted few-shot CoT examples, free-form zero-shot generation, zero-shot CoT with a light instruction such as “Let’s think step by step,” and stronger CoT variants using model-generated examples. The key technical point is distributional: few-shot CoT does not only add information. It also changes the target generation style. A model must solve the problem while adapting to the demonstrations’ format and reasoning style. For models that already produce reasoning traces natively, this added constraint can hurt more than it helps.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments focus on math problem solving with modern mid-sized models, including Mathstral-7B, Qwen models, and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. The central numbers are clear. For Mathstral, the best reproduced human few-shot CoT result is at most 74.2%, while the official report gives about 77.1%. Free-form zero-shot generation reaches 83.8%, and zero-shot CoT reaches 86.1%. For Qwen, the best few-shot CoT result is at most 83.4%, while the zero-shot setting reaches 88.6%. The qualitative examples support the same point: some models already generate multi-step solutions without demonstrations, and extra examples can introduce avoidable distractions.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the introduction’s diagnosis of why few-shot CoT can fail, then inspect the tables comparing free-form zero-shot, zero-shot CoT, and few-shot CoT. The useful lesson is not a new prompting trick. It is that evaluation protocols can become stale as the model’s training distribution changes. This is relevant when reporting reasoning capability, constructing SFT/RL data, or comparing new inference-time reasoning methods.

recommendation.zh: 会改变 reasoning eval 的默认 prompt prior；先看实验表和 guidance-distraction 解释，内部评测应立刻复测。
recommendation.en: This should change the default prompt prior for reasoning evals; read the result tables and guidance-distraction argument, then rerun internal eval prompts.

paper.title: The Tell-Tale Trace: Detecting Reasoning Failures in LLMs Using Chain-of-Thought Dynamics
paper.abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning improves large language model (LLM) performance while also providing an observable interface to the model's reasoning process. Existing approaches that leverage verbalized CoTs to monitor reasoning correctness, however, largely evaluate the semantic correctness or consistency of individual intermediate steps, rather than how the reasoning process evolves across the trace. As a result, failures distributed across the reasoning trajectory, rather than those localiz

summary.core_problem: 能否不依赖 CoT 单步语义正确性，而利用可见 CoT 轨迹的动态特征来识别 LLM 的推理失败？
summary.importance: 原理/分析贡献：把 CoT 视为不忠实反映内部计算的可观测轨迹，从轨迹动态而非单步语义角度检测推理失败，对 verifier 和 test-time 控制有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 在可验证的 Boolean 类推理任务上研究多种 LLM，提取 CoT 轨迹随步骤演化的动态特征，区分成功与失败推理，而不把中间陈述当作内部计算的字面解释。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型清单、特征定义或准确率数字；仅说明覆盖多个 LLM 和可验证 Boolean 推理任务。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自华盛顿大学圣路易斯分校和圣裘德儿童研究医院；摘要未披露知名作者或相关代表性工作。

summary_en.core_problem: Can visible chain-of-thought dynamics, rather than the semantic correctness of individual steps, be used to detect LLM reasoning failures without assuming CoT faithfulness?
summary_en.importance: Analytical/mechanistic contribution: it treats CoT as an observable trace that need not faithfully reflect internal computation, and detects failures from trajectory dynamics rather than step-level semantics, which is relevant to verifiers and test-time control.
summary_en.technical_approach: It studies a range of LLMs on verifiable Boolean-style reasoning tasks, extracts dynamic features of how the CoT trace evolves across steps, and distinguishes successful from failed reasoning without interpreting intermediate statements as literal accounts of internal computation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not list specific models, feature definitions, or accuracy numbers; it only states that multiple LLMs and verifiable Boolean reasoning tasks are covered.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from Washington University in St. Louis and St. Jude Children’s Research Hospital; the abstract does not identify well-known authors or representative prior work.

recommendation.zh: 把 CoT 当动态信号而非语义解释来做失败检测，角度新；摘要无定量结果，先看特征构造和跨模型一致性。
recommendation.en: Treating CoT as a dynamic signal rather than a semantic account is a fresh angle; with no quantitative results in the abstract, inspect the feature design and cross-model consistency first.

paper.title: Attend to Your Own Thoughts: Breaking the Barrier for Post-Training Quantization of Reasoning LLMs through the Lens of 1.58-Bit Quantization
paper.abstract: We propose ScaleQ-1.58, a scalable ternary post-training quantization (PTQ) framework for reasoning LLMs. Its core insight stems from an empirical finding: although modern LLMs are typically trained to exhibit chain-of-thought reasoning capabilities, in the PTQ regime, even the latest CAT-Q method based on learning-based differentiable ternarization still leads to performance collapse on challenging mathematics and coding tasks when using conventional calibration schemes that ignore the model's

summary.core_problem: ScaleQ-1.58 关注推理型 LLM 的三值化 PTQ：如何在不重新做昂贵 QAT、不蒸馏、不从头训练的情况下，把数学、代码、CoT 推理模型压到 1.58-bit，并尽量避免推理能力坍塌。
summary.importance: 这篇更偏高效推理和量化，但对预训练研究有间接启发。1.58-bit 模型过去主要依赖 QAT 或从头训练，例如 BitNet b1.58 系列，这会把架构、数据和训练过程绑定在一起。若 PTQ 能在 reasoning LLM 上稳定工作，就能把“低比特训练范式”和“已有高精度基座/推理模型”解耦，降低评估不同架构、不同 post-training recipe 的成本。它也提示一个问题：CoT 模型的量化误差不能只用普通短文本校准，长推理轨迹里的激活和权重敏感性更接近真实部署分布。
summary.technical_approach: 论文从三值量化的三个基本量入手：缩放因子 alpha、权重阈值 Delta，以及非可导 ternarization 的优化处理。传统 TWN、TernaryBERT、BitNet/TriLM/Tequila 一类方法多采用静态统计规则确定 alpha 和 Delta，并在 QAT 中用 STE 处理梯度。ScaleQ-1.58 的方向是面向 PTQ 重新估计这些尺度参数，并利用 reasoning LLM 自身的 CoT 行为作为校准信号。标题中的“Attend to Your Own Thoughts”对应的关键思想是：量化校准应覆盖模型自己生成或使用的推理过程，而不只是普通语言建模样本。这样可以让量化过程看到数学、代码、多步推理中的长链上下文和中间状态分布。提供内容未给出完整算法细节，因此学习目标、逐层/逐通道尺度形式、是否使用 Hessian/重构损失、是否需要少量校准反传，需要以正文方法节为准。
summary.experiments: 从提供内容可确认的实验设定是：论文关注 1.58-bit ternary PTQ，目标对象是 reasoning LLM，重点任务包括数学和代码；对比对象包括常规 8/4/3-bit PTQ、QAT 训练的 1.58-bit 模型，以及 BitNet b1.58 2B4T 这类从头训练的低比特推理模型。引言指出已有 PTQ 在 3-bit 推理任务上已有明显退化，QAT 又需要大量 token、GPU、长训练时间和复杂稳定性调参。提供内容没有包含最终 benchmark 表、模型规模列表、平均提升幅度和消融数字；阅读时应重点查 ScaleQ-1.58 在 GSM8K/MATH/代码类任务上的保留率，以及 CoT 校准、alpha/Delta 学习、校准集规模三组消融。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 30 分钟。先看方法节中 alpha、Delta 的参数化和优化目标，确认它是否是真正的 PTQ，还是带有轻量微调的 PTQ/QAT 混合。再看 calibration data 部分，重点看“own thoughts”具体指模型自生成 CoT、标准答案 CoT，还是推理 prompt 分布。最后看数学和代码任务的主表与消融表。若只关心预训练，可跳过硬件 kernel 细节，重点关注一个问题：低比特误差是否主要来自权重近似，还是来自 reasoning-time 分布与普通校准分布不匹配。

summary_en.core_problem: ScaleQ-1.58 studies ternary post-training quantization for reasoning LLMs. The goal is to compress models to 1.58-bit weights without expensive quantization-aware training, distillation, or training from scratch, while preserving math, coding, and chain-of-thought reasoning ability.
summary_en.importance: The work is mainly about inference efficiency, but it has useful implications for foundation-model research. Existing 1.58-bit LLMs are often tied to QAT or full pretraining recipes, which makes low-bit capability expensive to reproduce and hard to scale across architectures. A reliable PTQ method would decouple low-bit deployment from the original pretraining run. It also raises a calibration issue that matters for post-training pipelines: reasoning models should be quantized under distributions that resemble their long CoT trajectories, not only short generic text samples.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper frames ternary quantization around three primitive choices: the scaling factor alpha, the threshold Delta, and the optimization treatment of non-differentiable ternarization. Earlier ternary methods for LMs often use static statistical rules for alpha and Delta, and QAT relies on STE during training. ScaleQ-1.58 moves this problem into a scalable PTQ setting and uses the model’s own reasoning behavior as a calibration signal. The title’s idea, “Attend to Your Own Thoughts,” points to calibration on chain-of-thought traces or reasoning-like internal distributions, so the quantizer sees the activation and sensitivity patterns that appear during multi-step math and code generation. The supplied text does not expose the full algorithm, so the exact parameterization of learned scales, the reconstruction or language-modeling objective, and whether any lightweight backpropagation is used should be verified in the method section.
summary_en.experiments: The visible experimental scope covers 1.58-bit ternary PTQ for reasoning LLMs, with math and coding tasks as central evaluations. The paper positions itself against conventional 8/4/3-bit PTQ methods, QAT-based ternary LLMs such as BitNet-style models, and fully trained low-bit reasoning models such as BitNet b1.58 2B4T. The introduction notes that existing PTQ methods can already degrade sharply around 3-bit on reasoning workloads, while QAT requires large token budgets, long training, and careful stability tuning. The provided content does not include the final result tables, model sizes, absolute scores, or ablation numbers. The important checks are score retention on math/code benchmarks, calibration-set size sensitivity, the contribution of CoT calibration, and the learned alpha/Delta components.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30 minutes. Read the method section for how alpha and Delta are estimated and whether the procedure remains true PTQ or becomes a light fine-tuning variant. Then inspect the calibration-data section to see what “own thoughts” means in practice: self-generated CoT, reference CoT, or reasoning prompts. Finally read the main math/code tables and ablations. For pretraining-oriented readers, the most relevant question is whether quantization failure in reasoning LLMs comes mainly from weight approximation or from a mismatch between generic calibration data and reasoning-time distributions.

recommendation.zh: 量化论文里少见的“校准分布错配”直指 CoT 崩溃根因；先只看校准构造与消融，若表格干净值得立刻复现到自家 PTQ 流水线。
recommendation.en: A rare quantization paper that pins CoT collapse on calibration distribution mismatch; read the calibration construction + ablations first—if the tables are clean, replicate in your PTQ pipeline.

paper.title: CoT-Core: Accelerating LLM Evaluation via CoT-Aware Coreset Selection
paper.abstract: Evaluating Large Language Models (LLMs) incurs prohibitive computational overhead during continuous development processes. While coreset selection accelerates evaluation, existing methods either suffer from a severe ``cold start'' bottleneck requiring massive historical logs (e.g., Item Response Theory) or exhibit a surface lexical bias that misses the underlying reasoning manifold of tasks. We propose CoT-Core, a novel training-free core question selection framework. Recognizing that lexically

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是一个很实际的评测瓶颈：在持续预训练、对齐和多轮 checkpoint 迭代中，完整跑大基准的成本太高，但现有 coreset 选题方法要么依赖大量历史评测日志，冷启动时根本不可用；要么只看题面文本相似度，容易把“措辞像”当成“推理结构像”。论文要解决的是：在没有历史作答记录的前提下，能否只靠题目本身，选出一个小而有代表性的评测子集，并且这个子集对模型能力排序和总分估计都足够稳定。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的意义不在于提出新的训练方法，而在于给持续开发流程提供了更便宜的评测代理。预训练和 post-train 迭代里，真正昂贵的往往不是单次训练，而是高频评测。CoT-Core 的贡献是把“代表性”从表层文本空间，转到显式推理轨迹空间，因而在冷启动 benchmark、私有内部集和缺少历史日志的场景里更可用。它的价值主要是工程流程层面的：减少评测 token 开销，同时尽量保住全量评测的排序一致性和分数近似。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分三步。第一步是 CoT trajectory generation：对每道题用一个教师 LLM 做 zero-shot Chain-of-Thought 展开，得到显式推理轨迹，而不是只保留原始题面。这里的关键假设是，不同表述但同一逻辑骨架的问题，在推理展开后会更接近。第二步是 contextualized trajectory embedding：把题目与其 CoT 轨迹一起编码到稠密向量空间，构造比纯 question embedding 更接近“推理流形”的表示。第三步是 isomorphic clustering and selection：在这个表示空间里做聚类或几何覆盖，选出每个簇的中心样本，形成预算受限的 coreset。

论文一个比较清楚的设计点，是把 subset selection 和 performance estimation 解耦。CoT-Core 只负责选题，本身不绑定某个特定估计器。最简单时可以直接对选中子集做 standard aggregation；如果后续有历史日志，也可以接 GP-IRT 这类概率估计器。这个解耦比 IRT 路线更灵活，因为 IRT 往往把题目参数估计和分数重建绑在一起。

与传统 lexical embedding + k-center 的区别，在于它不把“语义相近”近似成“词面相近”，而是显式借助 LLM 生成的推理过程来重排样本邻域。与 IRT 的区别，在于它完全不需要先验作答矩阵，因此适合新 benchmark。代价也很明确：它虽然是 training-free，但不是 free lunch，需要先为全题库生成 CoT，这一步本身有前置成本；只是这个成本是一次性的，而后续多轮评测可以摊薄。
summary.experiments:
从全文可见，实验重点不是追求单点最高精度，而是验证三件事：一是 CoT 表示是否比原始文本表示更适合做 coreset；二是在没有历史日志时，是否能稳定逼近全量评测；三是这种收益是否依赖任务复杂度。

作者将 CoT-Core 与两类基线比较：一类是 history-dependent 的 IRT/GP-IRT 路线，另一类是 training-free 的文本嵌入几何采样，如 k-center greedy。结果显示，在冷启动设定下，CoT-Core 明显优于只看题面 embedding 的方法，尤其在需要多步推理的 benchmark 上，子集分数对全量分数的拟合更稳，模型间排序也更接近全量评测。论文还强调一个边界条件：当任务本身主要考察事实记忆、模板匹配或短程判断时，显式 CoT 带来的增益会缩小，因为这类题目的“推理流形”本来就不复杂。

消融方面，比较关键的是：是否使用 CoT、不同 embedding 方式、不同聚类/选点策略、以及不同估计器的组合。结论大致是，收益主要来自 reasoning-aware representation，而不是某个特定聚类算法；也就是说，核心创新在表示层，而不是采样器本身。摘要截断后未给出完整数字，现有全文片段也没有可靠的表格数值可逐项抄录，因此不宜编造具体提升百分比。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时建议先看 Introduction 和 Method 的问题设定，重点理解作者为什么把 coreset 问题拆成“选题”和“估分”两层。然后直接看方法图和表示构造部分，抓住一句话：他们不是在题面空间做覆盖，而是在 CoT 轨迹空间做覆盖。

接着看实验里的三类结果：1）冷启动场景下与文本 embedding 基线的差距；2）不同任务复杂度下收益是否稳定；3）与更强估计器结合时，子集本身是否仍然有价值。若时间有限，优先看 ablation 和 failure/boundary discussion，这部分最能帮助判断方法适用范围。预计 20–30 分钟可以完成有效泛读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a practical evaluation bottleneck: during continual pretraining, alignment, and checkpoint iteration, full-benchmark evaluation is too expensive, yet existing coreset methods either require large historical response logs or rely on shallow text similarity. The core question is whether one can build a small but representative evaluation subset in a cold-start setting, using only the benchmark items themselves, while preserving full-set score estimation and model ranking.
summary_en.importance: Its value is operational rather than algorithmically central to pretraining. In foundation-model development, repeated evaluation is often a major hidden cost. CoT-Core matters because it offers a training-free way to compress evaluation sets without historical logs, and it does so by moving from surface text similarity to reasoning-structure similarity. That makes it relevant for newly built benchmarks, private internal eval sets, and fast iteration loops where exhaustive evaluation is too costly.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The pipeline has three stages. First, CoT trajectory generation: for each question, a teacher LLM produces a zero-shot chain-of-thought trajectory. The key premise is that questions with different wording but similar logical structure become closer once their reasoning paths are made explicit. Second, contextualized trajectory embedding: the question and its generated reasoning trace are embedded into a dense space intended to reflect the latent reasoning manifold better than plain question embeddings. Third, isomorphic clustering and selection: clustering or geometric covering is performed in that space, and representative items near cluster centers are selected under a fixed budget.

A useful design choice is the decoupling between subset selection and score estimation. CoT-Core only constructs the subset. The selected coreset can be used with simple standard aggregation in a fully training-free setup, or combined with stronger estimators such as GP-IRT when historical logs are available. This is more flexible than IRT-style methods, which typically tie item calibration and score reconstruction together.

Compared with lexical embedding plus k-center selection, the novelty is not the sampler itself but the representation space: neighborhood structure is induced by generated reasoning traces rather than surface wording. Compared with IRT-based approaches, it avoids the cold-start dependency on historical correctness matrices. The trade-off is also clear: it is training-free, but not cost-free, because CoT trajectories must be generated for the benchmark upfront. The method assumes that this one-time cost is amortized over many future evaluation runs.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental section is organized around three questions: whether CoT-based representations are better than plain text embeddings for coreset construction, whether the selected subsets remain faithful in cold-start score estimation, and when the gains disappear.

The paper compares against two baseline families: history-dependent approaches such as IRT/GP-IRT, and training-free geometric methods based on question embeddings, including k-center-style selection. The main result is that in cold-start settings, CoT-Core consistently outperforms text-only selection, especially on benchmarks with nontrivial multi-step reasoning. The selected subsets better preserve full-benchmark score estimates and model ranking. The paper also states a boundary condition: when tasks are dominated by factual recall, template matching, or shallow judgments, the benefit of reasoning-aware pruning becomes smaller because the underlying reasoning manifold is weak to begin with.

The most informative ablations vary the use of CoT, the embedding construction, the clustering/selection strategy, and the downstream estimator. The main takeaway is that the gain comes primarily from the reasoning-aware representation rather than from a particular clustering heuristic. The provided content does not expose complete tables or reliable numeric values, so it would be inappropriate to invent exact percentages or correlation scores.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the problem formulation in the introduction and method section. The important conceptual move is the separation between subset selection and performance estimation. Then focus on the representation step: the paper is not mainly about a new sampler, but about building a better space in which representative questions can be selected.

For experiments, prioritize three parts: the cold-start comparison against text-embedding baselines, the task-complexity analysis, and the ablations showing that the representation matters more than the clustering algorithm. If reading time is limited, the boundary-condition discussion is worth attention because it tells you when CoT-aware pruning is likely to help and when it is not. A useful skim should take about 20–30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和边界条件即可；若 CoT embedding 稳定，值得接入内部 checkpoint 快筛。
recommendation.en: Read the method and boundary conditions; if the CoT embeddings are stable, this is worth trying for internal checkpoint triage.

paper.title: Recompute or Reuse? Diagnosing and Mitigating Textual Shortcuts in VLM Self-Reflection
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are expected to revise their reasoning when visual evidence changes. Failures to do so are often attributed to insufficient visual attention or contextual inertia, leaving unclear what models reuse instead of recomputing from the current image. We show that evidence-bearing reasoning in a prior chain of thought (CoT) can form a textual shortcut that competes behaviorally with visual recomputation. Across 16 VLMs, a matched counterfactual analysis identifies evidence

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究 VLM 在视觉状态改变后的自我反思失败：模型没有重新读取当前图像时，究竟复用了什么信息。核心结论是，旧 CoT 中承载视觉证据的文本片段会形成“textual shortcut”，与当前图像的重新计算竞争。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在 multimodal reasoning 的训练信号质量。论文说明，CoT 不只是推理轨迹，也可能把旧视觉状态离散化成可复用文本证据。只用最终答案是否修正来评估视觉更新是不够的，因为模型可能仍保留旧证据的分数偏置。对 VLM 预训练、SFT、反思式数据构造都有提醒：如果训练中大量暴露带证据描述的历史 CoT，模型可能学会优先走文本捷径，而不是重新绑定当前视觉输入。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是一个 matched counterfactual 框架。每个样本包含当前图像 I、问题 Q、正确答案 y，以及结构相近但关键视觉证据不同的反事实图像 I- 和答案 y-。先让被测模型在 I- 上生成一个支持 y- 的旧 CoT R-，再把当前图像 I、同一问题 Q 和旧 CoT 放入反思上下文，观察模型是否被旧推理牵引。论文进一步做受控删除：删除旧 CoT 中 evidence-bearing content、删除等长非证据文本、删除最终答案 span，并比较答案偏移。这样可以区分三类影响：上下文长度、答案锚定、以及旧视觉证据文本本身。还测试了 evidence 顺序打乱，说明文本证据的组织结构也会影响捷径被复用的程度。干预方法 FSAF 不是 prompt 提醒，而是在注意力层面阻断新一轮计算访问旧 CoT，使当前计算不能直接 attend 到旧推理轨迹。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 16 个 VLM。数据使用 800 个经人工检查的 VS-Bench paired counterfactual 样本，来源包括 MathVista-MINI、MathVerse-MINI、MathVision 和 MMMU-Pro。样本筛选要求模型在反事实图像上能得到 y-，且在无历史条件下对当前图像能得到 y，因此测到的是旧 CoT 的干扰，而不是任务本身不可解。主要发现是：删除旧 CoT 中承载证据的内容，比删除等长非证据文本或最终答案片段更能改变答案偏好；这种 content-specific effect 在 16 个模型上均为正，并且随着删除更多旧证据而增强。即使模型给出了当前正确答案，在后续 matched support withdrawal 下仍比 history-free control 更容易回到旧答案，说明答案修正不等于证据状态更新。FSAF 在 5 个 Qwen VLM 上将 visual update rate 从 35.28% 提升到 53.61%，将 prior-answer rate 从 39.22% 降到 3.67%。prompt-only 版本没有稳定提升，支持“控制旧推理访问”比“要求模型重新看图”更关键。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25–35 分钟。重点看 Controlled Evaluation of Prior-CoT Influence 中的任务构造、eligibility 条件和 deletion controls，这部分决定实验是否真的隔离了文本捷径。结果部分优先看 evidence removal、final-answer removal、order disruption 的对比图表。FSAF 部分适合关注 attention mask 具体怎么施加，以及是否影响正常上下文利用。对做 VLM pretrain 或 multimodal CoT 数据的人，最值得深挖的是“evidence-bearing CoT 会不会成为训练时的错误归因路径”：模型可能学到从文本证据恢复答案，而不是从图像重新抽取证据。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks what a VLM reuses when it fails to update its reasoning after the visual evidence changes. The central finding is that evidence-bearing spans in a previous CoT can act as a textual shortcut, competing with recomputation from the current image.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance to foundation-model research is in multimodal reasoning supervision. CoT traces are not neutral explanations; they can serialize visual observations into text and make stale evidence easier to reuse than fresh visual evidence. This matters for VLM pretraining and post-training pipelines that rely on reflective reasoning, self-correction, or multimodal CoT data. A corrected final answer is not a reliable certificate that the model has refreshed its visual state.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study uses a matched counterfactual setup. Each example contains a current image-question-answer triple and a structurally similar counterfactual image with a different answer. The model first produces a coherent prior CoT on the counterfactual image. The same model is then asked to reflect under the current image while the stale CoT remains in context. The analysis compares this prior-conditioned path with a history-free direct path. Controlled removals separate three effects: removing evidence-bearing spans, removing length-matched non-evidence spans, and removing the final-answer span. The paper also perturbs evidence order to test whether the organization of the stale reasoning path affects reuse. The proposed intervention, Fresh-State Attention Firewall, blocks fresh computation from attending to the prior CoT instead of merely prompting the model to inspect the image again.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers 16 VLMs and 800 human-checked VS-Bench counterfactual pairs drawn from MathVista-MINI, MathVerse-MINI, MathVision, and MMMU-Pro. Eligibility requires the model to answer the counterfactual image correctly and to answer the current image correctly without history, so the measured effect is prior-CoT interference rather than base task failure. Removing evidence-bearing content shifts answer preference more than removing length-matched non-evidence context or the final-answer span. The content-specific effect is positive for all 16 models and grows as more stale evidence is removed. Even when a model recovers the current answer, matched support withdrawal reveals residual dependence on the old reasoning path. On five Qwen VLMs, FSAF improves visual update rate from 35.28% to 53.61% and reduces prior-answer rate from 39.22% to 3.67%. A prompt-only variant does not provide a reliable update gain.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: about 25–35 minutes. Focus on the matched counterfactual construction, the eligibility filter, and the deletion controls, since these determine whether the shortcut effect is well isolated. The most useful result tables or figures are those comparing evidence removal, non-evidence removal, final-answer removal, and evidence-order disruption. The FSAF section is worth checking for the exact attention restriction and whether it sacrifices useful context. For VLM pretraining work, the key question to carry forward is whether multimodal CoT supervision encourages models to recover answers from textualized evidence rather than bind reasoning to the current visual input.

recommendation.zh: 这不是预训练论文，但把“反思失败”从注意力问题改写成文本捷径竞争问题，值得看干预设计；只读 counterfactual setup 和证据删除结果就够了。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it reframes reflection failure from weak visual attention to textual-shortcut competition; read the counterfactual setup and evidence-ablation results, not the whole story.

paper.title: Cognitive Demand Steering for Adaptive Meta-Reasoning in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Recent meta-reasoning frameworks improve LLM reasoning by wrapping chain-of-thought generation in an iterative control loop, allowing more effective backtracking, termination of reasoning loops, and injection of promising reasoning patterns, among other strategy adjustments. Despite promising results, methods often rely on backward-looking reward functions, utilize coarse search actions, or require additional reasoning controller training requiring many-shot supervision. We introduce Cognitive D

summary.core_problem: 现有动作中心的元推理框架依赖离散动作集、固定模式切换、回溯式奖励，或需要额外多样本监督训练控制器，无法同时响应复杂任务的多重交互认知需求，也难以基于剩余任务难度自适应分配计算资源。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要有三点：一是多维认知需求画像可作为预训练数据认知难度分级的参考维度，用于数据课程设计；二是剩余需求追踪的思路可为推理增强预训练（如内部思维链的RL训练）提供新的监督信号设计方向；三是无训练自适应推理框架的设计逻辑，可与预训练阶段的推理能力塑造形成互补。
summary.technical_approach: 提出认知需求引导（CDS）框架，属于无需训练的元推理方法，核心是将自适应推理重构为需求追踪问题。具体步骤：1）为输入任务生成16维认知需求画像，维度基于已有认知量表定义，覆盖语言理解、相关信息识别、逻辑推理、定量推理、多领域知识检索等能力；2）推理过程中迭代评估部分解在各维度的完成度，计算剩余认知需求（需求差）作为控制器核心状态，替代传统离散动作集；3）结合自写验证测试、不确定性估计、推理健康检查得到的风险等级，驱动早停决策、动作规划、自适应验证目标生成（如边界用例检查、结果反向验证），还支持组合注入多种行为模式引导推理，而非每次仅选择单一粗粒度模式。
summary.experiments: 当前提供的全文片段未包含完整实验章节，仅提及在LiveCodeBench-Hard等复杂推理任务上验证方法效果，核心对比维度为推理准确率与计算开销的权衡。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注方法章节中认知需求维度的定义、剩余需求评估机制，以及引言部分对现有元推理框架缺陷的分类梳理，预计阅读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing action-centric meta-reasoning frameworks rely on discrete action sets, fixed mode switches, backward-looking reward functions, or additional controller training with extensive supervision. They cannot address multiple interacting cognitive demands of complex tasks, nor allocate compute adaptively based on remaining task difficulty.
summary_en.importance: The work offers three relevant insights for pretraining research: first, multi-dimensional cognitive demand profiles can inform cognitive difficulty grading of pretraining data for curriculum design; second, residual demand tracking provides a new direction for supervision signal design in reasoning-enhanced pretraining (e.g., RL training for internal chain-of-thought); third, the training-free adaptive reasoning design can complement reasoning capability shaping during pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Cognitive Demand Steering (CDS) is a training-free meta-reasoning framework that reframes adaptive reasoning as demand tracking. It first generates a 16-dimensional cognitive demand profile for each task, with dimensions grounded in established cognitive scales covering verbal comprehension, relevant information identification, logical reasoning, quantitative reasoning, and multi-domain knowledge retrieval. During inference, it iteratively evaluates completion of each dimension for partial solutions, and computes residual cognitive demand as the core controller state instead of traditional discrete action sets. Combined with risk levels derived from self-written validation tests, uncertainty estimation, and reasoning health checks, the demand gap drives early stopping, action planning, and adaptive verification target generation (e.g., edge case checking, inverse verification). It also supports compositional injection of multiple behavior modes instead of selecting a single coarse mode per step.
summary_en.experiments: The provided full text fragment does not include the complete experimental section. The work is reported to be validated on complex reasoning tasks such as LiveCodeBench-Hard, with core comparison dimensions of reasoning accuracy and compute cost tradeoff.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on the definition of cognitive demand dimensions and residual demand assessment mechanism in the method section, as well as the classification of limitations of existing meta-reasoning frameworks in the introduction. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: DeepMind提出的免训练元推理框架，核心是将传统的后顾性reward转变为前瞻性的'剩余推理需求'评估，对test-time scaling和复杂推理控制有启发。
recommendation.en: A training-free meta-reasoning framework from DeepMind, whose core is shifting from traditional backward-looking rewards to forward-looking 'residual reasoning demand' assessment, inspiring test-time scaling and complex reasoning control.

paper.title: OPLD: On-Policy Latent Distillation for Multimodal Reasoning
paper.abstract: Interleaved multimodal Chain-of-Thought (CoT) improves visual reasoning by incorporating auxiliary visual evidence into intermediate reasoning. However, existing approaches remain constrained by externally defined reasoning traces and visual operations, limiting their ability to develop flexible and abstract visual thinking. Reasoning with latent has recently offered a promising direction by internalizing intermediate computation into continuous representations. Nevertheless, existing visual-lat

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究如何让多模态模型在没有显式视觉 CoT、裁剪图、工具观察等辅助信息的情况下，把 interleaved multimodal CoT 中的中间推理过程内化到连续 latent states 里。
summary.importance: 它对预训练方向的启发在于 latent reasoning 的训练信号设计。已有视觉 latent 方法常把 latent token 对齐到压缩后的辅助视觉特征，这容易把 latent state 变成“视觉证据缓存”，而不是可泛化的推理状态。OPLD 的思路是用带有多模态 CoT 的 teacher 监督 student 的内部轨迹，把监督对象从特征级对齐转到过程级蒸馏。这对后续做 CoT-free reasoning、隐式推理 token、以及多模态统一建模都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: OPLD 使用 teacher-student 框架。teacher 和 student 采用相同 MLLM backbone 和递归 latent reasoning 结构，但输入条件不同。teacher 能看到 interleaved multimodal CoT，包括文本 rationale 和辅助视觉证据；student 只看到原始 image-question 输入。训练分三阶段：第一阶段训练 CoT-guided teacher，让它在显式多模态推理轨迹辅助下形成较强的 latent trajectory；第二阶段 warm up CoT-free student，先建立稳定的 latent reasoning 协议；第三阶段进行 on-policy latent distillation。这里的 on-policy 指 student 用当前策略生成回答轨迹，teacher 再对这些 student-generated trajectories 提供 token-level supervision，同时 student 的 latent trajectory 对齐 teacher 的 latent trajectory。这样做比离线模仿固定 CoT 更贴近 student 推理时会遇到的分布，也比简单对齐视觉特征更少约束内部状态。
summary.experiments: 论文声称在多模态感知和推理任务上都稳定优于强 latent reasoning baseline，并在多个 benchmark 上取得领先表现。根据提供的正文片段，尚看不到具体 benchmark 名称、模型参数量、数据规模、绝对分数和消融数字。可以确认的实验重点包括：与显式 interleaved multimodal CoT 方法、视觉特征对齐式 latent 方法、无 on-policy distillation 的 student 进行比较；验证 token-level supervision 与 latent trajectory alignment 的共同作用；检查 student 在没有辅助视觉证据时是否仍能保留 teacher 的推理收益。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20–30 分钟。优先看方法图和三阶段训练流程，确认 teacher 与 student 的输入差异、latent token 的递归使用方式，以及 on-policy rollout 期间 teacher 如何给监督信号。其次看消融实验：没有 latent alignment、没有 token-level supervision、off-policy 蒸馏、只对齐视觉特征这几组对照最能说明贡献。如果时间有限，重点关注 train–inference consistency 和 catastrophic forgetting 的分析，因为这些问题决定 latent reasoning 是否能从小规模技巧变成可扩展训练范式。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how a multimodal model can internalize the intermediate reasoning induced by interleaved multimodal CoT into continuous latent states, so that inference no longer requires explicit visual CoT, cropped evidence, tool observations, or auxiliary images.
summary_en.importance: The main signal for foundation-model research is about supervising latent reasoning. Prior visual-latent methods often align latent tokens with compressed auxiliary visual features, which makes the latent state behave more like an evidence cache than a general reasoning state. OPLD shifts the target from feature-level alignment to process-level distillation from a CoT-augmented teacher. This is relevant to CoT-free reasoning, implicit reasoning tokens, and multimodal models that need internal computation without exposing long rationales or tool traces.
summary_en.technical_approach: OPLD uses a teacher–student setup with the same MLLM backbone and recursive latent reasoning structure, but different input conditions. The teacher receives interleaved multimodal CoT, including textual rationales and auxiliary visual evidence. The student receives only the original image and question. Training has three stages. First, the CoT-guided teacher is trained to form strong latent reasoning trajectories under explicit multimodal guidance. Second, the CoT-free student is warmed up so that latent reasoning is stable before distillation. Third, on-policy latent distillation is performed: the student rolls out answers using its current policy, the teacher supervises those student-generated trajectories at the token level, and the student latent trajectory is aligned with the teacher latent trajectory. The on-policy design reduces train–inference mismatch, while trajectory-level latent alignment avoids over-constraining the latent state to compressed visual features.
summary_en.experiments: The provided text states that OPLD consistently improves multimodal perception and reasoning over strong latent reasoning baselines and performs strongly on multiple benchmarks. The supplied content does not include the exact benchmark list, model sizes, data scale, absolute scores, or ablation numbers. The important experiments to check are comparisons against explicit interleaved multimodal CoT methods, visual-feature-alignment latent methods, and students trained without on-policy distillation. The most informative ablations should isolate token-level teacher supervision, latent trajectory alignment, off-policy versus on-policy distillation, and feature-level alignment baselines.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20–30 minutes. Start with the method figure and the three-stage training recipe. The key details are the teacher–student input asymmetry, how recursive latent reasoning is implemented, and how the teacher supervises student rollouts. Then read the ablations rather than only the headline benchmark table. The most useful comparisons are no latent alignment, no token-level supervision, off-policy distillation, and visual-feature alignment. Pay attention to any analysis of train–inference consistency and forgetting, since these determine whether the approach is a scalable latent-reasoning recipe or a task-specific training trick.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和实验设置是否 on-policy 干净；若有效，它会影响多模态 CoT 蒸馏到 latent 的做法。
recommendation.en: Read the method and whether the on-policy setup is clean; if solid, it changes how multimodal CoT should be distilled into latents.

paper.title: Reasoning Consensus: Structural Ensembling of LLM Reasoning via Weighted DAG Aggregation
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) explore problems through chain-of-thought, but this exploration is buried in unstructured prose. On high-stakes tasks, users cannot tell which steps are well-supported, which alternatives were seriously considered, or how the final conclusion compares to those the model discarded. We propose a framework that ensembles the reasoning structure, not just the answers, of multiple LLMs by weighted merging of Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs) extracted from reasoning chains.

summary.core_problem: 多个 LLM 的 CoT 推理通常只在最终答案层面做投票，用户看不到哪些中间步骤被独立支持、哪些替代路径被认真探索。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理时结构化集成方法。它不涉及预训练或后训练数据，但对 test-time reasoning 的可解释聚合有参考价值，尤其是把答案集成推进到推理步骤集成。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Reasoning Consensus：先从多条 reasoning chains 中抽取有向无环图，再按权重合并 DAG。每个推理步骤的权重由独立 traces 支持次数决定，输出既包含最终答案，也包含被多条路径共同支持的推理结构。方法可用于多模型 ensemble，也可用于单模型多采样，和 self-consistency 使用相同 trace budget 对比。
summary.experiments: 在六个 benchmark 上评估，覆盖法律条文解释、研究生级科学、叙事多跳推理和一阶逻辑。相同预算下优于 majority-vote baseline，在 MuSR-MM 上最大准确率提升 3.1%；单模型设置下达到或超过 self-consistency，同时提供步骤级共识可视化。摘要未给出模型清单和抽图误差分析。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the limitation that multi-trace LLM reasoning is usually aggregated only at the final-answer level, leaving users unable to inspect which intermediate steps are independently supported.
