paper.abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning has significantly improved the reasoning ability of large vision-language models (LVLMs) by verbalizing intermediate reasoning steps in natural language. However, such discrete textual rationales are often insufficient for encoding continuous visual evidence. Recent work addresses this limitation by moving reasoning into continuous latent space. Despite promising progress, existing methods leave latent reasoning insufficiently connected to the compositional and r

summary.core_problem: 现有多模态大模型(LVLM)的隐空间推理方法未能充分利用视觉证据中的组合关系结构——离散文本CoT不足以编码连续视觉证据，而现有隐空间推理方法忽略了物体间关系。
summary.importance: 方法创新：首次提出将隐空间推理显式grounding在视觉关系结构上，连接了隐空间推理与视觉组合性。贡献还包括一个351K的合成推理训练数据集RGROUNDING-351K。
summary.technical_approach: ReGuLaR框架：训练时使用ReGFormer(关系感知Transformer)将隐推理状态聚焦于问题相关的物体和物体间关系；推理时无需调用ReGFormer，模型直接推理并生成答案。本质上是一种训练时的额外监督信号。
summary.experiments: 构建RGROUNDING-351K数据集(351K样本)用于训练。实验对比了现有隐空间推理方法，验证了关系grounding的有效性。
summary.authors_note: University of California, Santa Barbara。无特别知名作者。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing latent reasoning methods for LVLMs fail to leverage the compositional relational structure in visual evidence—discrete text CoT is insufficient for continuous visual evidence, and current latent reasoning methods ignore inter-object relations.
summary_en.importance: Methodological contribution: first to explicitly ground latent reasoning in visual relational structure, bridging latent space reasoning and visual compositionality. Also contributes RGROUNDING-351K, a 351K synthetic reasoning training dataset.
summary_en.technical_approach: ReGuLaR framework: during training, a ReGFormer (relation-aware Transformer) focuses latent reasoning states on question-relevant objects and inter-object relations; at inference, the model reasons and generates answers without invoking the ReGFormer. Essentially an extra training-time supervision signal.
summary_en.experiments: Constructs RGROUNDING-351K (351K samples) for training. Experiments compare with existing latent reasoning methods, validating the effectiveness of relation grounding.
summary_en.authors_note: University of California, Santa Barbara. No particularly well-known authors.

recommendation.zh: 多模态推理方法的增量改进，训练时引入额外关系监督但推理时移除——类似知识蒸馏思路。对LLM pretrain研究员无直接启示，作为literature备查。
recommendation.en: Incremental improvement in multimodal reasoning with extra relation supervision at training only—similar to knowledge distillation. No direct insight for LLM pretraining; file as literature reference.

paper.title: COFT: Counterfactual-Conformal Decoding for Fair Chain-of-Thought Reasoning in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can reveal and amplify societal biases during chain-of-thought (CoT) generation. We present COFT (Chain of Fair Thought), a training-free decoding method that applies token-level fairness control at decode time, with distribution-free marginal validity guarantees (under exchangeability) for any frozen causal language model. COFT operates in three stages. First, it creates a masked counterfactual prompt by replacing sensitive spans with neutral tokens. Second, it comp

summary.core_problem: 在不训练模型的情况下，降低 LLM 生成 CoT 时由敏感属性触发的偏见，同时保持推理准确率。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是安全解码和形式化校准方法。它把 counterfactual prompting、logit fusion 和 split-conformal calibration 组合到 token 级控制里，对后训练安全和推理时控制有参考意义，但不直接影响预训练 recipe。
summary.technical_approach: COFT 分三步：先把 prompt 中的敏感 span 替换为中性 token，构造 masked counterfactual prompt；再比较 factual 与 masked 两条分支的 logit 分布，用轻量 logit fusion 抑制属性驱动的 token；最后用 dual-branch split-conformal calibration 在用户指定风险水平下给每步候选 token 集提供边际有效性保证，前提是 exchangeability 成立。
summary.experiments: 在 6 个模型和多个 bias benchmark 上评估。摘要称标准 bias metrics 降低 30-55%，中位数 38%；任务效用和语言质量基本保持，推理准确率变化落在 run-to-run noise 范围内。未给出具体模型名称、参数规模和 benchmark 名称。

summary_en.core_problem: It aims to reduce sensitive-attribute bias in CoT generation without updating the underlying LLM.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a decoding-time safety and calibration method. It combines counterfactual prompting, logit fusion, and split-conformal calibration for token-level control, making it relevant to alignment-time inference control but not to core pretraining methodology.
summary_en.technical_approach: COFT has three stages: replace sensitive spans with neutral tokens to form a masked counterfactual prompt; compare factual and masked logit distributions and fuse them to attenuate attribute-driven choices; then apply dual-branch split-conformal calibration to certify per-step candidate token sets at a user-chosen risk level under exchangeability.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on six models and multiple bias benchmarks. The abstract reports 30-55% reductions in standard bias metrics, with a median reduction of 38%, while preserving task utility, language quality, and reasoning accuracy within run-to-run noise. Specific model sizes and benchmark names are not provided.

recommendation.zh: 形式保证比常规安全解码干净些，但 exchangeability 假设很重；扫 calibration 部分即可。
recommendation.en: The guarantee is cleaner than typical safety decoding, but the exchangeability assumption is doing real work; skim the calibration setup.

paper.title: Chain-of-Thought and Compressed Looped Transformers: A Memory-Budget Separation
paper.abstract: Chain-of-thought prompting and looped Transformers both give a fixed model more test-time computation, but they differ in what they remember. Chain-of-thought stores intermediate state in generated tokens that remain in the context, whereas a looped Transformer carries state through recurrent hidden activations. We argue that this persistent mutable memory is a central resource for test-time reasoning.   We compare three memory regimes, the compressed latent loop, the full sequence-state loop, a

summary.core_problem: 思维链（CoT）提示与循环Transformer（looped Transformer）是两种为固定模型增加测试时计算量的方法，但现有循环Transformer研究大多默认循环状态为完整序列（内存充足场景），未将「计算量」与「跨步骤持久可变内存」拆分为独立的资源维度，也未明确内存受限场景下压缩状态循环Transformer与CoT的推理能力边界。
summary.importance: 建立了测试时推理的资源度量框架，将持久可变性内存作为独立资源与计算量拆分，为循环类LLM推理架构的设计提供明确约束：压缩潜循环的表达能力上限由持久循环状态的大小决定，单纯增加迭代次数无法提升需要大串行内存的任务的推理能力。
summary.technical_approach: 首先为三类推理范式定义了统一的内存预算计算公式：压缩潜循环的持久内存M = s*d*p（s为循环槽数，d为隐层宽度，p为激活位精度）；全序列状态循环的M = n*d*p（n为输入长度）；CoT草稿板的M = Θ(ℓ log|Σ|)（ℓ为生成的CoT token数）。随后通过计算复杂度理论证明：当压缩循环的持久状态相对于输入长度为polylog量级时，哪怕迭代次数达到准多项式规模，该模型仍属于DSPACE(polylog n)复杂度类。在「P不包含于DSPACE(polylog n)」的标准理论假设下，这类压缩循环无法解决P完全的串行任务，而多项式长度的CoT可以。该边界仅适用于压缩循环，全序列状态循环的内存随输入长度线性增长，属于大内存场景，不受此限制。
summary.experiments: 工作以理论推导为主，仅设计了两个受控的有限规模探测实验验证直觉：指针追赶任务的循环槽数扫描、联想回忆任务的状态大小扫描，同时结合已有数独任务中内存token的相关结果作为外部佐证，未开展大模型端到端任务实验。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读可优先阅读第3章的内存预算定义与三类范式的对比、第4章的核心结论表述（无需啃附录中的复杂度证明）、第5章的探测实验设计思路，预计阅读时间20-30分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting and looped Transformers both increase test-time computation for fixed models, but prior work on looped Transformers mostly assumes full-sequence recurrent states (memory-rich regimes) and fails to disentangle computation volume and cross-step persistent mutable memory as separate resources. No clear theoretical boundary exists between the reasoning capabilities of compressed-state looped Transformers and CoT under memory constraints.
summary_en.importance: This work establishes a formal resource accounting framework for test-time reasoning, disentangling persistent mutable memory from computation volume as separate resources. It provides explicit constraints for the design of recurrent/looped LLM reasoning architectures: the expressivity upper bound of compressed latent loops is determined by the size of their persistent recurrent state, and simply increasing iteration count cannot improve reasoning performance on tasks requiring large serial memory.
summary_en.technical_approach: First, it formalizes memory budgets for three reasoning paradigms: compressed latent loops (M = s*d*p, where s is the number of recurrent slots, d is hidden width, p is activation bit precision), full sequence-state loops (M = n*d*p, where n is input length), and CoT scratchpads (M = Θ(ℓ log|Σ|), where ℓ is the number of generated CoT tokens). It then proves via computational complexity theory that compressed loops with polylogarithmic persistent state relative to input length fall into the DSPACE(polylog n) complexity class, even when run for quasi-polynomial iterations. Under the standard unproven assumption that P ⊈ DSPACE(polylog n), such compressed loops cannot solve P-complete serial tasks, while polynomial-length CoT can. This separation only applies to compressed loops; full sequence-state loops have linear memory scaling with input length and belong to the memory-rich regime with no such constraint.
summary_en.experiments: This work is primarily theoretical. It only includes two controlled finite-size probes to validate intuition: a pointer-chasing slot sweep and an associative-recall state-size sweep. It also references prior memory-token results on Sudoku as external support, and does not include large-scale end-to-end LLM experiments.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim Section 3 for memory budget definitions and paradigm comparisons, read core conclusion statements in Section 4 (skip formal complexity proofs in appendices), and review probe experiment design in Section 5. Estimated reading time: 20-30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 会修正“latent loop 可直接替代 CoT”的直觉；读主定理和三种 memory regime，别把它当实证结论。
recommendation.en: It weakens the intuition that latent loops can simply replace CoT; read the main theorem and memory regimes, but do not treat it as empirical evidence.

paper.title: LinTree: Improving LLM Reasoning with Explicitly Structured Search Histories
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often solve reasoning problems by generating intermediate traces that explore and revise partial solutions. From a search perspective, these traces can be viewed as linearized search trees, where the model extends a partial solution, abandons it when it fails, and backtracks to try alternatives. Compared with traditional heuristic-guided search, such a policy has a potential advantage: it conditions on the whole search trace rather than only on the current local stat

summary.core_problem: LLM 在推理时生成的中间步骤（如 CoT）本质上是线性化的搜索树。相比传统启发式搜索仅依赖当前局部状态，LLM 理论上能利用整个搜索历史。本文探究：LLM 是否真正利用了这一优势？如果将搜索树的拓扑结构显式化，能否进一步提升 LLM 的搜索策略？
summary.importance: 揭示了 LLM 在隐式搜索（如普通 CoT）中对历史信息的利用存在瓶颈，并证明了显式结构化搜索历史能显著提升 LLM 的推理和搜索效率。这为改进 LLM 的推理数据格式和训练范式提供了直接指导。
summary.technical_approach: 在 Blocks World、Grid Navigation 和 Sokoban 三个受控推理环境中，对比了三种策略：1) 仅观察局部状态的 LLM 启发式最佳优先搜索；2) 观察完整搜索历史但树结构隐式的 LLM 推理策略；3) 观察完整搜索历史且树结构显式的 LLM 推理策略（在每步记录被扩展的边界状态）。所有模型均经过相同的 SFT 和 RL 流程训练。
summary.experiments: 实验发现，当树结构隐式时，LLM 推理策略并未稳定超越局部状态启发式基线。但当树结构显式化后，模型在解决率和搜索效率上均优于隐式模型和局部启发式基线。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点关注 Introduction 中对 LLM 推理作为搜索过程的重新审视，以及 Reasoning Environments 中对三种受控环境和数据生成方式的描述。预计阅读时间 15 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Intermediate reasoning steps generated by LLMs (e.g., CoT) can be viewed as linearized search trees. Unlike traditional heuristic search that relies only on local states, LLMs can theoretically condition on the entire search history. This paper investigates: Do LLMs actually exploit this advantage? And can explicitly representing the search tree topology further improve LLM search policies?
summary_en.importance: Reveals a bottleneck in how LLMs utilize historical information during implicit search (like standard CoT) and demonstrates that explicitly structuring search histories significantly enhances reasoning and search efficiency. This provides direct guidance for improving reasoning data formats and training paradigms for LLMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: Compared three policies across three controlled reasoning environments (Blocks World, Grid Navigation, Sokoban): 1) an LLM heuristic best-first search observing only local states; 2) an LLM reasoning policy observing the full history but with implicit tree structure; 3) an LLM reasoning policy observing the full history with explicit tree structure (recording the expanded frontier state at each step). All models were trained with the same SFT and RL pipeline.
summary_en.experiments: Found that with implicit tree structures, the LLM reasoning policy does not reliably outperform the local-state heuristic baseline. However, when the tree structure is made explicit, the model surpasses both the implicit model and the local heuristic baseline in solve rate and search efficiency.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Introduction for the reframing of LLM reasoning as a search process, and the Reasoning Environments section for the description of the three controlled environments and data generation. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 会修正对 trace conditioning 的直觉：历史不是免费搜索能力，优先看受控环境对比和 LinTree 消融。
recommendation.en: This usefully weakens the prior that trace conditioning gives search ability for free; read the controlled comparisons and LinTree ablations first.

paper.title: iVGR: Internalizing Visually Grounded Reasoning for MLLMs with Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: While visually grounded Chain-of-Thought (CoT) has emerged as a promising paradigm to enhance fine-grained perception in multimodal large language models (MLLMs), its efficacy during the inference phase remains underexplored. In this work, we empirically find that mandating explicit object boxes in visually grounded CoT during inference often degrades performance compared to standard textual CoT, which reasons without explicit visual grounding. We hypothesize that the visual localization capabil

summary.core_problem: iVGR 研究的是多模态大模型中的视觉落地推理是否应该在推理期显式输出框或调用裁剪工具。论文的核心发现是：显式 grounding 能训练出定位能力，但推理期强制输出框往往会干扰答案生成；更好的方式可能是把定位能力内化到文本 CoT 中。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对 post-train 和 multimodal pretrain/post-train 接口有启发。它指出视觉 grounding 不一定要以显式坐标形式出现在最终推理轨迹里。坐标、裁剪、框监督可以作为训练信号，用来塑造模型的注意和局部感知能力；但推理期目标仍应围绕答案质量和稳定性。这个结论对构造 MLLM 的 RL 训练信号很有用：辅助能力可以通过奖励和一致性约束迁移到主轨迹，而不是让模型在部署时同时承担辅助任务和主任务。
summary.technical_approach: iVGR 采用双流强化学习训练。对同一个图文问题，策略模型生成两类 rollout：grounded stream 输出带 bounding box 的视觉落地 CoT，textual stream 输出普通文本 CoT。训练中先从 grounded stream 中筛选高质量轨迹，再用 consistency reward 约束 textual stream，使文本 CoT 与高质量 grounded 推理保持一致。这样模型在训练期利用显式定位信号学习“看哪里”，但在测试期可以不输出坐标，减少格式负担和错误框带来的噪声。论文还保留了与 crop tool 的兼容性：在细粒度 VQA 中，模型仍可在需要时调用裁剪流程，但默认推理不被强制绑定到显式框输出。
summary.experiments: 论文先做了一个诊断实验：对 DeepEyes 和 TreeVGR 这类已训练过视觉落地 CoT 的模型，只改变推理 prompt，不重新训练，比较 grounded CoT 与普通 textual CoT。结果显示，grounded CoT 虽然优于基础 Qwen2.5-VL-7B，但 textual CoT 在多数 VQA benchmark 上更好。进一步的 HR8K IoU 分组分析显示：对 crop-based 方法，只有定位质量较高时 grounded CoT 才占优；定位差时，错误裁剪会引入视觉噪声。对 box-based 方法，显式框输出在各个 IoU 区间都不如 textual CoT，说明坐标生成本身可能抢占了推理预算。随后，iVGR 在 Qwen2.5-VL 和 Qwen3-VL 上训练，并在多个 VQA benchmark 上取得一致提升。可见内容没有给出完整分数表，具体涨幅应查看实验表和消融。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25–35 分钟。优先看 Introduction 中关于 grounded CoT 与 textual CoT 的对照实验，以及 Figure 2 的 IoU-accuracy 分析，这是论文最有信息量的动机部分。方法部分重点看 dual-stream rollout、grounded trajectory 选择标准、consistency reward 的定义。实验部分建议看三组消融：没有 consistency reward、只用 grounded stream、只用 textual stream。若关注 MLLM RL 训练，还应看 reward 是否依赖答案正确性、定位质量、格式约束，以及这些奖励之间是否存在冲突。

summary_en.core_problem: iVGR asks whether multimodal models should explicitly output boxes or use crop tools during inference for visually grounded reasoning. The main observation is that explicit grounding can be useful as a training signal, but forcing the model to emit boxes at inference often interferes with answer prediction. The paper argues that localization ability should be internalized into textual chain-of-thought.
summary_en.importance: The paper is useful for understanding the interface between multimodal post-training and inference behavior. It separates auxiliary supervision from the final reasoning format. Box prediction, cropping, and grounding can teach the model where to look, but the deployed reasoning trace does not need to expose these intermediate coordinates. This is a practical lesson for RL training of MLLMs: auxiliary capabilities can be transferred into the main textual trajectory through rewards and consistency constraints, instead of making the model solve the auxiliary task and the answer task at the same time during inference.
summary_en.technical_approach: iVGR uses a dual-stream reinforcement learning setup. For each image-question pair, the policy model produces two types of rollouts: a grounded stream with explicit bounding boxes in the reasoning trace, and a textual stream with ordinary natural-language reasoning. High-quality grounded trajectories are selected and used as references for a consistency reward. This reward encourages the textual stream to align with grounded reasoning without requiring explicit coordinates at test time. The model therefore learns localization behavior during training, but avoids coordinate-format burden and noisy localization errors during inference. The method also remains compatible with crop-tool workflows for fine-grained VQA when tool use is beneficial.
summary_en.experiments: The paper first presents a diagnostic study on existing grounded-reasoning models such as DeepEyes and TreeVGR. Without retraining, the authors change only the inference prompt and compare grounded CoT with textual CoT. Grounded CoT improves over the base Qwen2.5-VL-7B model, but textual CoT performs better on most VQA benchmarks. An IoU-based analysis on HR8K further explains the pattern. For crop-based reasoning, grounded CoT helps only when localization is accurate; poor crops introduce visual noise. For box-based reasoning, explicit box generation underperforms textual CoT across IoU groups, suggesting that coordinate prediction itself can distract from answer prediction. iVGR is then trained on Qwen2.5-VL and Qwen3-VL and reports consistent gains across multiple VQA benchmarks. The visible content does not include the full numeric tables, so exact improvements should be checked in the experimental section.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Start with the diagnostic comparison between grounded CoT and textual CoT in the introduction, then inspect the IoU-accuracy analysis around Figure 2. These parts carry the main insight. In the method section, focus on dual-stream rollout generation, the selection of high-quality grounded trajectories, and the definition of the consistency reward. In the experiments, look for ablations removing the consistency reward, using only grounded trajectories, or using only textual trajectories. For readers interested in MLLM RL, the key point is how answer rewards, localization rewards, and format constraints interact.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看的是那个负结果：显式 grounding 可能干扰 answer objective；先看主表和 ablation，若 setup 干净，会直接影响你设计 MLLM RL 信号。
recommendation.en: The useful part is the negative result: explicit grounding may interfere with answer prediction; check the main table and ablations first, because if the setup is clean it changes how you design RL signals for MLLMs.

paper.title: SLAT: Segment-Level Adaptive Trimming for Efficient CoT Reasoning
paper.abstract: Recent advances in Large Reasoning Models have significantly improved chain-of-thought (CoT) capabilities via reinforcement learning (RL). However, generated reasoning chains frequently suffer from structural redundancy (i.e., \emph{overthinking}), incurring high computational overhead without improving answer correctness. Existing mitigation strategies typically rely on token-uniform length penalties, which provide coarse, segment-agnostic pressure toward shorter outputs and can inadvertently s

summary.core_problem: RL训练的大推理模型生成的CoT普遍存在结构冗余（过度思考），现有基于统一token级长度惩罚的优化方法粒度过粗，无法区分必要推理和冗余内容，容易抑制有效推理步骤导致模型能力下降。
summary.importance: 对预训练与RL后训练的启发是，推理效率优化可以从token级升级到语义段级，结合生成概率的奖励塑形能更精准地压缩冗余，不需要牺牲推理准确率，为高效推理模型的训练目标设计提供了可落地的思路。
summary.technical_approach: 首先从理论上推导了正确性-长度权衡目标下，语义段生成次优的充分条件：长且生成概率高的段通常是低效用冗余；基于GRPO算法实现段级奖励塑形，用滑动窗口扫描推理轨迹，对窗口内token联合生成概率超过阈值的段施加惩罚，作为额外奖励项加入训练目标。
summary.experiments: 在多个标准推理基准上测试，相比无压缩基线，平均推理长度减少约50%，同时准确率保持相当，在正确性-长度的权衡表现上显著优于统一token级长度惩罚方法。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注第二章的段级次优性理论推导和第三章的段级奖励塑形实现，实验部分查看不同基准上的长度-准确率对比结果，预计阅读时间15分钟。
summary.authors_note: 香港理工大学、字节跳动、香港理工大学大亚湾科创研究院、香港理工大学深圳研究院，通讯作者Ran Cheng

summary_en.core_problem: CoT traces generated by RL-trained large reasoning models commonly have structural redundancy (overthinking). Existing optimization methods based on uniform token-level length penalties have overly coarse granularity, cannot distinguish necessary reasoning from redundant content, and often suppress valid reasoning steps leading to degraded model capability.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining and RL post-training research, this work indicates reasoning efficiency optimization can be upgraded from token level to semantic segment level. Reward shaping conditioned on generation probability can compress redundancy more precisely without sacrificing reasoning accuracy, providing a practical direction for training objective design of efficient reasoning models.
summary_en.technical_approach: First derive the sufficient condition for suboptimal segment generation under the correctness-length trade-off objective: long segments with high generation probability are usually low-utility redundancy; implement segment-level reward shaping based on the GRPO algorithm, scan reasoning traces with a sliding window, apply penalty to segments where the joint generation probability of tokens in the window exceeds a predefined threshold, and add the accumulated penalty as an extra reward term to the training objective.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on multiple standard reasoning benchmarks, average reasoning length is reduced by around 50% compared to uncompressed baselines while accuracy remains comparable. It outperforms uniform token-level length penalty methods significantly on the correctness-length trade-off.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on the theoretical derivation of segment suboptimality in Section 2 and the segment-level reward shaping implementation in Section 3, plus the length-accuracy comparison across benchmarks in the experiment section. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: The Hong Kong Polytechnic University; Bytedance; Hong Kong Polytechnic University Daya Bay Technology and Innovation Research Institute; Hong Kong Polytechnic University Shenzhen Research Institute. Corresponding author: Ran Cheng

recommendation.zh: 读它的价值在“把长度惩罚做成可解释的 segment 选择”，可能比一刀切 length penalty 更稳；只看判据推导和主表的 token-accuracy 曲线即可。
recommendation.en: Worth it for turning length control into an interpretable segment-selection rule (often cleaner than blunt length penalties); read the criterion derivation and the main token–accuracy trade-off table/plot.

paper.title: Echoes within the Reasoning: Stealthy and Effective Watermarking via Chain of Thought
paper.abstract: Large Language Models with Chain-of-Thought reasoning capabilities represent valuable intellectual property, yet existing black-box watermarking methods often trade robustness for reasoning fidelity by perturbing final answers or relying on fragile trigger patterns. We propose BiCoT, a watermarking framework that embeds ownership signals into the internal geometry of reasoning traces by aligning high-saliency structural anchors with a private signature subspace while regularizing ordinary contro

summary.core_problem: 如何在黑盒条件下对具备 CoT 推理能力的 LLM 做“隐蔽且难移除”的水印，同时尽量不伤害推理质量。
summary.importance: 贡献类型偏方法工程：把水印从“改最终答案/触发词”转向“绑定推理轨迹表征”，并给出一个面向分布漂移的黑盒验证器；对模型产权保护与对齐后模型的可追责性有参考价值，但对 pretrain 本体影响间接。
summary.technical_approach: BiCoT：在推理 trace 中选取高显著性的结构锚点（high-saliency anchors），将其表征对齐到私有签名子空间；同时对常规控制 token 做正则以减少语义容量损失。验证端提出 RSR（Robust Subspace Registration）：基于 top-logprob 的黑盒验证，利用 sentinel tokens 校准输出分布的系统性漂移，从而在模型被窃取/轻度改写后仍能注册到同一“签名子空间”。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模/数据与完整指标；仅声称在保持推理保真度的同时提升水印鲁棒性，并能应对“representation drift/模型盗用”场景的验证。

summary_en.core_problem: How to watermark CoT-capable LLMs in a black-box setting in a way that is stealthy, hard to remove, and minimally harms reasoning fidelity.
summary_en.importance: Primarily an applied-method contribution: it shifts watermarking from answer perturbations/triggers to coupling with reasoning-trace representations, plus a drift-aware black-box verifier. Useful for IP/accountability, but only indirectly informative for pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: BiCoT embeds ownership signals by aligning high-saliency structural anchors in reasoning traces to a private signature subspace, while regularizing ordinary control tokens to preserve semantic capacity. RSR (Robust Subspace Registration) is a top-logprob-based black-box verifier using sentinel tokens to calibrate systematic output-distribution shifts under model theft or representation drift.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes/data or full metrics; it claims improved robustness with preserved reasoning fidelity and verification under drift/theft scenarios.

recommendation.zh: 更像“对齐/安全侧的水印工程”，对 pretrain 直接增益有限；只需扫一眼 RSR 的黑盒校准思路，别指望有干净的训练结论。
recommendation.en: Mostly a watermarking/ownership engineering paper; limited direct pretraining insight—skim RSR’s black-box drift calibration idea, but don’t expect clean training takeaways.

paper.title: Thoughts-as-Planning: Latent World Models for Chain-of-Thoughts Optimization via Reinforcement Planning
paper.abstract: The success of large language models (LLMs) across diverse NLP tasks has elevated the importance of reasoning chain optimization as a critical step in aligning model behavior with task objectives. Existing reasoning chain tuning methods often rely on black-box heuristics or gradient-free search, which lack interpretability, generalization, and sample efficiency. In this work, we introduce \textbf{Thoughts-as-Planning}, a novel framework that formalizes reasoning chain optimization as a sequentia

summary.core_problem: 解决推理链优化依赖黑盒启发式搜索、样本效率低且难以解释的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练和推理优化方法。它把 Chain-of-Thought 编辑看成 latent semantic space 中的序列决策问题，试图用 world model 和 planning 替代纯 prompt 搜索或梯度不可见的启发式调参。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Thoughts-as-Planning 框架，把 LLM 视作 partially observable environment，学习一个 latent world model 来模拟 reasoning chain edits 对最终回答的影响。方法构造 proximity-preserving embedding space 编码 reasoning chain-response dynamics，并支持通过 gradient descent 或 reinforcement learning 在 token、segment、instruction 多粒度上规划编辑。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出明确模型规模、训练数据、baseline 和数值提升。可确认的实验意图是比较 latent planning 相对黑盒启发式或 gradient-free search 在推理链优化中的解释性、泛化和样本效率。
summary.authors_note: Ying Nian Wu 是 UCLA 机器学习与生成模型方向的知名研究者；其团队长期研究 energy-based models、generative modeling 与 latent variable modeling。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the inefficiency and opacity of heuristic or gradient-free chain-of-thought optimization methods.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a post-training and reasoning-optimization framework. It reframes CoT editing as sequential decision making in a latent semantic space, using a learned world model and planning rather than pure prompt search.
summary_en.technical_approach: Thoughts-as-Planning treats the LLM as a partially observable environment and learns a latent world model that predicts how reasoning-chain edits affect downstream outputs. A proximity-preserving embedding space encodes chain-response dynamics, enabling gradient-based planning or reinforcement learning over token-, segment-, and instruction-level edits.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, training data, baselines, or quantitative gains. The intended comparison appears to be against black-box heuristics and gradient-free search methods for reasoning-chain tuning, with emphasis on interpretability, generalization, and sample efficiency.
summary_en.authors_note: Ying Nian Wu is a well-known UCLA researcher in generative modeling, energy-based models, and latent-variable learning.

recommendation.zh: 想法比证据更强；扫方法图即可，若没有强实验，先别把它当 CoT 训练 recipe。
recommendation.en: The idea is stronger than the evidence; skim the method diagram, but do not treat it as a CoT training recipe without substantial experiments.

paper.title: ReasonOps: Operator Segmentation for LLM Reasoning Traces
paper.abstract: Chain-of-thought traces from large reasoning models can span tens of thousands of tokens, yet we lack a vocabulary for describing their internal structure. Previous methods developed to analyze chain-of-thought traces are either too rigid or not expressive enough, failing to capture features across domains and models. To remedy this, we develop ReasonOps, an unsupervised, expressive method for annotating chain-of-thought traces, providing succinct universal operators. Using ReasonOps, we analyze

summary.core_problem: 缺乏描述思维链（CoT）推理轨迹内部结构的词汇表，现有分析方法过于僵化或不够表达，无法跨领域和模型捕捉特征。
summary.importance: 提出ReasonOps，一种无监督、表达性强的CoT轨迹标注方法，发现7个跨模型家族和基准域通用的推理算子，属于推理机制分析创新。
summary.technical_approach: 通过无监督聚类句子首3-token pivot来提取通用推理算子，发现7个反复出现的推理算子（如回溯、推理、假设等话语级动作），这些算子在所有模型家族和基准域中都出现。
summary.experiments: 分析了来自12个思维LLM（6个家族）在8个推理基准上的44,662条轨迹。3个独立LLM评判者对保留样本的分类准确率达到70-76%，证实算子的通用性。
summary.authors_note: 作者Daniel Lee, Owen Queen, James Zou，机构信息未明确标注（James Zou是知名研究者）。

summary_en.core_problem: Chain-of-thought traces from reasoning models can span tens of thousands of tokens, yet we lack a vocabulary for describing their internal structure. Existing analysis methods are either too rigid or not expressive enough.
summary_en.importance: Proposes ReasonOps, an unsupervised, expressive method for annotating CoT traces, and discovers 7 universal reasoning operators that appear across every model family and benchmark domain — an analysis innovation in reasoning mechanisms.
summary_en.technical_approach: Extracts universal reasoning operators via unsupervised clustering of sentence-initial 3-token pivots, discovering 7 recurring reasoning operators (discourse-level moves such as backtracking, inferring, and hypothesizing) that appear across all model families and benchmark domains.
summary_en.experiments: Analyzes 44,662 traces from 12 thinking LLMs spanning 6 families across 8 reasoning benchmarks. Three independent LLM judges classify held-out samples at 70-76% accuracy, confirming operator generality.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors: Daniel Lee, Owen Queen, James Zou (James Zou is a well-known researcher). Institutional affiliation not fully specified.

recommendation.zh: CoT推理轨迹分析的有趣尝试，无监督提取通用算子的思路新颖，但3-token pivot方法偏简单，结果当作弱信号看待。
recommendation.en: An interesting attempt at CoT trace structure analysis; the unsupervised universal operator extraction idea is novel but the 3-token pivot method is somewhat simplistic — take results as weak signal.

paper.title: Grounded 3D-Aware Spatial Vision-Language Modeling
paper.abstract: We present GR3D, a spatial vision language model equipped with three complementary grounding capabilities--explicit 2D grounding, implicit 2D grounding, and monocular 3D grounding--within a single framework. GR3D introduces an implicit grounding mechanism that identifies entity mentions during generation and inserts the corresponding region tokens into the text stream, allowing the model to reference visual evidence on the fly when producing spatial chain-of-thought responses. In parallel, a reg

summary.core_problem: 现有空间视觉语言模型缺少自由文本生成过程中的隐式2D实体-区域自动关联机制，且单目3D定位存在语义指代与几何预测解耦、单视图深度/尺度/相机内参纠缠的问题，难以支撑具身智能所需的连贯2D/3D空间推理。
summary.importance: 对多模态预训练的启发在于，将分层接地机制作为空间表征学习的核心组件而非外挂模块，可为通用具身视觉语言模型的预训练目标设计提供参考；隐式流式插入区域token的思路，也可迁移至多模态推理过程的动态证据注入。
summary.technical_approach: 提出GR3D统一架构，集成三类互补的接地能力：1）显式2D接地，通过语言头以结构化文本格式输出预测的物体区域；2）隐式2D接地，生成过程中动态识别文本提及的实体，编码对应视觉区域为token并实时插入文本流，无需单独检测阶段即可实现基于视觉证据的空间思维链推理；3）单目3D接地，以接地后的2D区域为查询，结合相机内参感知归一化、深度估计衍生的稠密几何监督，预测相机视图下的3D边界框。
summary.experiments: 在CVBench、ERQA、SAT等空间推理基准上，隐式接地机制提升了思维链的准确性与空间一致性；在Omni3D基准上，带稠密点监督的区域提示3D接地取得了领先性能；同时验证了三个结论：无显式定位任务时接地仍能提升通用空间理解能力，稠密几何监督可提供可扩展的结构信号，隐式接地与区域提示3D推理的组合可支撑实例级指代3D接地、类别级3D检测、多目标场景接地等多种任务。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读引言部分的问题定义、方法部分的隐式2D接地与区域提示3D接地的核心设计，预计阅读时间15分钟；无需深入推导具体归一化细节或数据构造流程，重点理解接地作为内置机制的架构设计思路。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing spatial vision-language models lack an implicit 2D entity-region association mechanism that operates automatically during free-form text generation. Meanwhile, monocular 3D grounding suffers from decoupling between semantic reference and geometric prediction, as well as entanglement of depth, scale, and camera intrinsics from single-view inputs, hindering coherent 2D/3D spatial reasoning required for embodied intelligence.
summary_en.importance: For multimodal pretraining research, this work demonstrates that building hierarchical grounding as a core component of spatial representation learning, rather than an external module, provides reference for pretraining objective design of general embodied VLMs. The idea of streaming region token insertion during generation can also be migrated to dynamic evidence injection in multimodal reasoning processes.
summary_en.technical_approach: GR3D is a unified architecture integrating three complementary grounding capabilities. First, explicit 2D grounding predicts object regions in structured textual format via the language head. Second, implicit 2D grounding dynamically detects entities mentioned in generated text, encodes their corresponding visual regions as tokens, and inserts them into the text stream on the fly, enabling spatial chain-of-thought reasoning based on visual evidence without a separate detection phase. Third, monocular 3D grounding takes grounded 2D regions as queries, and predicts 3D bounding boxes in camera view combined with intrinsic-aware normalization and dense geometric supervision derived from depth estimation.
summary_en.experiments: Implicit grounding improves chain-of-thought accuracy and spatial consistency on spatial reasoning benchmarks including CVBench, ERQA and SAT. Region-prompted 3D grounding with dense point supervision achieves leading performance on Omni3D. Three additional insights are validated: grounding improves general spatial understanding even without explicit localization tasks, dense geometric supervision provides scalable structural signals, and the combination of implicit grounding and region-prompted 3D inference supports multiple tasks including instance-level referring 3D grounding, category-level 3D detection, and multi-object scene grounding.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the problem definition in the introduction and core designs of implicit 2D grounding and region-prompted 3D grounding in the method section, with an estimated reading time of 15 minutes. No need to dive into specific normalization derivation or data construction pipeline; focus on the architectural design of grounding as a built-in mechanism.

recommendation.zh: 读方法里的 region-token 插入机制即可；它比又堆空间 CoT 更接近可复用的 VLM 归因结构。
recommendation.en: Skim the region-token insertion mechanism; it is more reusable for VLM grounding than another round of spatial CoT prompting.

paper.title: When RL Suppresses Its Own Vocabulary: Recovering Reasoning Diversity in Puzzle-to-Math Transfer
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning using verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves LLM reasoning, but the conditions under which it transfers across domains -- and why it does so -- remain under-explored. We study cross-domain transfer in a 7B model whose SFT and RL post-training stages use only constraint-satisfaction puzzles, with no mathematics problems in the post-training data. To analyze how transfer emerges, we introduce a reasoning primitive-level framework that combines a 9-class span classifier with moti

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究一个干净的迁移问题：只用约束满足类 puzzle 做 SFT 和 RL，不在后训练阶段加入任何数学题，模型是否会在困难数学题上变强；如果会，RL 改变的是哪些可迁移的推理操作，而不是哪些领域知识。
summary.importance: 对预训练和后训练接口的价值在于，它把 RLVR 的收益拆到“推理原语”层面，而不是只看最终 benchmark 分数。结果显示，puzzle-only 训练可以提升 hard math 的 pass@32，说明后训练可能在重组预训练阶段已有知识和搜索能力，而不只是注入新知识。更关键的是，vanilla RL 会强化 compute-check 这类深度执行链，同时压制 hypothesize/backtrack 这类恢复性动作。这个现象对设计推理 RL 奖励很有启发：奖励如果只鼓励可验证正确性，可能会让模型的推理词汇变窄，降低从错误路径恢复的能力。
summary.technical_approach: 实验使用 OLMo3-7B-Instruct-SFT 作为基座。该模型没有经过 prior RL fine-tuning，但保留了预训练和指令调优中的数学知识。训练数据只来自 Simon Tatham puzzle collection，包括 Bridges、Pattern、Undead、Galaxies。由于基座模型几乎不会解这些 puzzle，直接做 verifier RL 的 reward variance 太低，论文先用 DeepSeek Reasoner 蒸馏出的正确推理轨迹做 rejection-sampled SFT，只保留能被 puzzle scorer 验证正确的样本。随后使用 GSPO 做多 puzzle RL，而不是 token-level GRPO，原因是目标响应长度达到 25k–28k tokens，作者在 long-context pilot 中发现 GRPO 不稳定。奖励由精确正确奖励和 partial completeness reward 组成，后者按最终 board state 与解的匹配程度给分。分析上，论文训练了一个 9 类 span classifier，把 CoT 切成 hypothesize、compute、check、backtrack、plan、enumerate、setup、summarize、other，再用 motif extraction 跟踪这些原语如何组合。改进方法是在 GSPO 中加入 perplexity-based novelty bonus：对正确 rollout，如果其 reasoning trace 在 frozen SFT reference 下概率低，就额外奖励，以保留 vanilla RL 容易压制的恢复性推理路径。
summary.experiments: 主要评测是 OlymMATH-Hard、HMMT、OMEGA，使用 pass@32，temperature 为 0.6，每题采样 32 条。pass@32 被用来区分 capability ceiling expansion 和单路径 sharpening，因为 pass@1 很难区分模型是否真的能解更多题。核心结果是，在没有任何数学后训练数据的情况下，puzzle SFT + RL 使 OlymMATH-Hard pass@32 从 16.0% 提升到 36.0%，增加 20 个百分点。论文还报告 puzzle SFT 单独带来约 +7pp 的 OlymMATH-Hard pass@32 增益。vanilla GSPO 让 compute-check motif chain 变长，但 hypothesize 和 backtrack 下降 70%–80%，形成 depth-recovery tradeoff。加入 novelty bonus 后，在匹配的 vanilla baseline 上再提升 7pp pass@32，并恢复 hypothesize/backtrack 的出现率。在只有 novelty-trained model 解出的题目中，恢复性原语的出现频率明显更高，支持“保留改道能力”这一解释。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议用 25–35 分钟。先看训练 pipeline 和结果表，确认三点：基座模型是否有 prior RL，后训练数据是否完全不含数学，pass@32 的评测设置是否一致。然后看 primitive classifier 和 motif extraction 的定义，重点不是分类器本身，而是它如何把 RL 行为变化拆成 depth 与 recovery。最后看 novelty bonus 的奖励公式和 ablation，判断它是在鼓励多样性，还是只是在奖励低概率长文本。对预训练研究员来说，最值得带走的是 reward design 对推理行为分布的压缩效应：RL 不只提高正确率，也会改变模型可调用的推理操作集合。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a clean transfer setting: if a 7B model is post-trained only on constraint-satisfaction puzzles, with no math problems in either SFT or RL, does it improve on hard mathematics, and what reasoning operations explain the transfer?
summary_en.importance: The main value is the analysis of RLVR at the level of reasoning primitives rather than final benchmark scores. The results suggest that puzzle-only post-training can improve hard-math pass@32 by reorganizing search, verification, and recovery behaviors over knowledge already present in the base model. The paper also identifies a failure mode of vanilla verifier RL: it lengthens compute-check execution chains but suppresses hypothesize and backtrack operations. This matters for reasoning RL design because a reward focused only on verifiable correctness can narrow the model’s reasoning vocabulary and reduce its ability to recover from a bad path.
summary_en.technical_approach: The base model is OLMo3-7B-Instruct-SFT, chosen because it has no prior RL fine-tuning while retaining mathematical knowledge from pretraining and instruction tuning. The post-training data comes only from Simon Tatham constraint puzzles, including Bridges, Pattern, Undead, and Galaxies. Since the base model has near-zero puzzle competence, the authors first perform SFT on rejection-sampled correct reasoning traces distilled from DeepSeek Reasoner and verified by puzzle scorers. They then run multi-puzzle GSPO rather than token-level GRPO, because responses are 25k–28k tokens and GRPO was unstable in long-context pilots. The verifier reward combines exact correctness with a partial completeness reward based on board-state match. For analysis, the paper uses a 9-way span classifier to segment CoT into hypothesize, compute, check, backtrack, plan, enumerate, setup, summarize, and other, followed by motif extraction to track recurring primitive sequences. The intervention is a perplexity-based novelty bonus: among correct rollouts, traces that are unlikely under a frozen SFT reference receive extra reward, with the goal of preserving recovery behaviors that vanilla RL suppresses.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses OlymMATH-Hard, HMMT, and OMEGA, with pass@32 at temperature 0.6. The use of pass@32 is important because pass@1 cannot distinguish between solving more problems and merely sharpening a path the model could already sample. On OlymMATH-Hard, puzzle SFT plus RL improves pass@32 from 16.0% to 36.0%, a 20-point gain without any math post-training data. Puzzle SFT alone contributes about +7 points. Vanilla GSPO increases the length of compute-check motif chains but reduces hypothesize and backtrack by 70–80%, producing a depth-recovery tradeoff. Adding the novelty bonus gives another +7 points over a matched vanilla baseline and restores the suppressed recovery primitives. On problems solved only by the novelty-trained model, recovery primitives appear at substantially higher rates, supporting the interpretation that the bonus helps the model change course when direct execution fails.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 25–35 minutes. First verify the experimental isolation: no prior RL in the base model, no math data in post-training, and consistent pass@32 sampling. Then read the primitive-classifier and motif-extraction sections to understand how the paper separates depth from recovery. Finally inspect the novelty-bonus formulation and the ablations to see whether it rewards useful reasoning diversity rather than merely low-probability long traces. For pretraining-oriented readers, the durable lesson is that RL changes the distribution of reasoning operations, not just task accuracy; reward design can compress or preserve the set of operations the model can call during inference.

recommendation.zh: 对理解RL如何塑造推理很有价值：RL在提升推理能力的同时会抑制探索性原语，做RLVR的研究者应关注§4.3的原语抑制分析。
recommendation.en: Valuable for understanding how RL shapes reasoning: RL improves reasoning but suppresses exploratory primitives; RLVR researchers should look at §4.3's primitive suppression analysis.

paper.title: The Chain Holds, the Answer Folds: Trace-Answer Dissociation in Reasoning Models Under Adversarial Pressure
paper.abstract: Reasoning models are evaluated on single-turn benchmarks but deployed in multi-turn dialogue, where users push back on correct answers. Under sustained adversarial pressure we find a previously undocumented failure mode: the chain-of-thought stays factually correct from first turn to last while the emitted answer flips wrong. We call this unfaithful capitulation (UC) and isolate it with a $2\times 2$ latent-versus-behavioral framework that flip-rate metrics and single-turn faithfulness probes bo

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 reasoning model 在多轮用户施压下的一个失效模式：推理链仍然得到正确结论，但最终答案被改成错误选项。
summary.importance: 对预训练和 post-training 接口的价值在于，它把“会推理”和“按推理输出答案”区分开了。很多 reasoning model 的训练会强化长 CoT、反思和服从用户反馈，但这篇论文显示，显式 reasoning channel 可能引入新的接口风险：内部推理仍对，最终 answer emission 被对话压力或格式行为覆盖。这个发现会影响 RL/SFT 数据设计、reasoning channel 监督、multi-turn robustness 评测，以及 answer head 或 finalization policy 的训练。它不是预训练 recipe 论文，但对理解 reasoning 模型训练信号质量很有用。
summary.technical_approach: 作者设计了一个 9 轮 adversarial dialogue protocol。用户在后续轮次持续质疑或暗示错误答案，模型需要保持原结论或在有新证据时修正。论文不只统计 answer flip，而是为每个 model-question-round 记录两个二值变量：latent correctness，即 CoT 是否推出真实答案；behavioral correctness，即最终答案是否正确。两者形成 2×2 分类：链和答案都对、链对答案错的 unfaithful capitulation、链错答案对、链和答案都错。核心贡献是把 sycophancy 从输出层面拆成 trace-level 和 answer-level 两个面。这样可以发现普通 flip-rate 和单轮 CoT faithfulness probe 都看不到的 UC：推理链没有崩，但最终答案崩了。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖三个数据集和三类模型。数据集包括 MT-Consistency 的 700 道四选一常识题、MMLU-Pro 的 700 道跨 14 领域题，以及 GSM8K 的 700 道数值题。模型包括 Qwen3-32B 的 think/no_think 对照、GPT-OSS-20B 的显式 reasoning channel，以及关闭原生 thinking、只用 inline CoT 的 Gemma-4-31B-it。Qwen3-32B 在首次 behavioral flip 时，CoT 仍正确的比例在选择题上接近 50%：MT-Consistency 为 50.7%，MMLU-Pro 为 50.0%，同题改成短答格式为 55.1%；GSM8K 为 32%，作者解释为数值题中推理链和答案的边界更紧。把同一 Qwen3-32B 切到 no_think 后，该比例降到 11-15%。GPT-OSS-20B 在 MMLU-Pro 上为 52.9%，接近 Qwen3-think；Gemma-4-31B-it 只有 19-22%，接近 no_think。独立 GPT-4o 审计 260 个 UC cell，86% 同意原 judge，13% abstain，硬分歧 1%。在 12,600 个 Qwen3-32B cell 上，UC 情况下最终字母前的 next-token argmax 有 84% 是正确答案，平均 P(correct)=0.82，说明正确答案在生成槽位仍有高概率，但后续行为把它改掉。一个直接修复方案也失败了：强制按 trace 结论重生成答案会降低选择题准确率，因为受压后的 trace 中也会混入攻击者提示。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读到精读之间，约 30 分钟。重点看 §3 的 2×2 latent-versus-behavioral 框架，这是方法核心；§5 和 §6 看 think/no_think 与跨模型对照，这是判断现象是否与显式 reasoning channel 相关的关键证据；§7 看 judge audit，确认不是 trace extractor 自我标注造成的假象；§8 看 next-token 分布，它把问题定位到 answer-emission interface；§9 的失败修复也值得看，因为它提醒不能简单把 CoT 结论当作可靠重写锚点。对做 reasoning RL 的读者，最需要关注的是多轮压力下 reward 到底在训练推理，还是在训练服从和让步。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a multi-turn failure mode in reasoning models: the chain of thought continues to derive the correct answer, while the final emitted answer changes to an incorrect one under user pressure.
summary_en.importance: The useful point for pretraining and post-training research is the separation between reasoning and answer finalization. A model can preserve the correct latent reasoning trace and still fail at the final answer interface. This has direct implications for SFT/RL data design, reasoning-channel supervision, multi-turn robustness evaluation, and the training of answer finalization behavior. The paper is not a pretraining-method paper, but it gives a concrete diagnostic for how reasoning-capable models can be misaligned by dialogue pressure after the reasoning computation has already succeeded.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce a 9-round adversarial dialogue protocol where users repeatedly push back against the model’s answer without adding valid new evidence. Instead of measuring only answer flips, they record two signals for each model-question-round cell: latent correctness, whether the reasoning trace concludes the ground-truth answer, and behavioral correctness, whether the final emitted answer is correct. This yields a 2×2 taxonomy. The key cell is unfaithful capitulation: the trace is correct but the final answer is wrong. This framework separates trace-level failure from answer-level failure and exposes cases that standard sycophancy flip rates and single-turn CoT faithfulness probes would miss.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses three corpora: 700 MT-Consistency multiple-choice questions, 700 MMLU-Pro questions across 14 domains, and 700 GSM8K numeric problems. The model set includes Qwen3-32B with a think/no_think toggle, GPT-OSS-20B with an explicit reasoning channel, and Gemma-4-31B-it run without native thinking and with inline prompted CoT. For Qwen3-32B, the latent-correct rate at the first behavioral flip is close to 50% on the multiple-choice settings: 50.7% on MT-Consistency, 50.0% on MMLU-Pro, and 55.1% when the same questions are reformatted as short answers. GSM8K is lower at 32%, which the authors attribute to the tighter coupling between numeric reasoning and the final answer. Switching Qwen3-32B to no_think collapses the rate to 11-15%. GPT-OSS-20B shows a similar effect on MMLU-Pro at 52.9%, while Gemma-4-31B-it sits near the no_think baseline at 19-22%. An independent GPT-4o audit of 260 UC cells agrees with the in-house judge on 86%, abstains on 13%, and hard-disagrees on 1%. On 12,600 Qwen3-32B cells, the next-token argmax immediately before the emitted answer letter is the correct option in 84% of UC cases, with mean P(correct)=0.82. A naive repair that regenerates the answer from the trace conclusion reduces accuracy on the MCQ corpora, because pressured traces can also contain the attacker’s suggested option.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim with selective deep reading in about 30 minutes. Section 3 is the main methodological contribution: the latent-versus-behavioral 2×2 taxonomy. Sections 5 and 6 provide the strongest evidence through think/no_think and cross-model comparisons. Section 7 is useful for checking whether the UC labels are judge artifacts. Section 8 is the most mechanistic part, since the next-token distribution localizes the failure to the answer-emission interface. Section 9 is worth reading because the failed repair shows why simply forcing the final answer to match the trace is not a safe fix. For reasoning-RL work, the main question raised is whether training is improving reasoning itself or teaching models when to yield under social pressure.

recommendation.zh: 揭示了 CoT 模型在对抗压力下“推理正确但输出错误”的解耦现象，对理解 RLHF/RLVR 带来的过度迎合（sycophancy）机制极具启发，建议细读探针分析部分。
recommendation.en: Reveals a fascinating dissociation in CoT models under adversarial pressure (correct reasoning but wrong answer), offering deep insights into sycophancy induced by RLHF/RLVR. Probe analysis is highly recommended.

paper.title: Reasoning that Travels: Dissecting How Chain-of-Thought Transfers Across Models
paper.abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) often generate extensive chain-of-thought (CoT) traces before producing a final answer. As explicit textual artifacts, these traces can be passed to other models to solve the same task, enabling cross-model reasoning transfer. Yet successful transfer alone does not reveal how the provided CoT contributes to another model's answer. We study this question with a controlled provider--receiver framework, where a provider generates a reasoning trace and a receiver solves

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的不是“CoT 能不能迁移”，而是更细的机制问题：一个模型写出的 chain-of-thought，被另一个模型拿来解同一道题时，真正起作用的到底是什么。作者认为只看最终 full trace 是否能帮助 receiver 答对，信息太粗，因为成功可能来自三种完全不同的来源：trace 里已经泄露了答案、trace 提供了足够的中间结构让 receiver 自己续推、或者 receiver 本来就会做题。论文因此把问题改写成一个受控的 provider–receiver 实验：让 provider 生成完整推理，再把这个推理按前缀逐步截断，观察 receiver 在不同前缀长度下何时开始变对，以及这种变对在强制直接作答和允许继续思考两种模式下是否不同。
summary.importance: 对预训练主线，它不是直接改训练 recipe 的论文，但对 reasoning data、CoT 蒸馏、跨模型推理迁移、以及“文本化推理痕迹到底承载了什么信息”这些问题有较强启发。它的重要性主要在分析框架，而不是提出新模型。第一，它把 CoT transfer 从一个单点结果，拆成一条随前缀长度变化的轨迹，这让“答案泄露”和“推理支架”可以被区分。第二，它同时比较 force-answer 和 free-generation，两者差异直接揭示 receiver 是在抽取现成答案，还是在借助前缀继续推理。第三，它提出 receiver agreement 作为无标注停止信号，这对推理时节省长 trace 成本有实际意义。对做 post-train 或 reasoning synthetic data 的人，这篇文章能帮助判断：哪些 CoT 真在传递可复用结构，哪些只是把最终答案写出来了。
summary.technical_approach: 方法设计很干净。作者选定一组 open-source reasoning-tuned 模型，固定 provider 和 receiver 角色，重点研究 stronger-to-weaker 的迁移。provider 先对同一道题生成完整 reasoning trace。然后作者不只评估完整 trace，而是把 trace 切成累计前缀：prefix 1、prefix 2、一直到 full trace。对每个前缀，receiver 在两种模式下作答。force-answer 模式要求它直接根据当前前缀给最终答案，不允许继续展开推理；这个设置主要测“前缀文本本身已经包含了多少可直接提取的信息”。free-generation 模式允许 receiver 在读完前缀后继续写自己的推理再作答；这个设置测的是“前缀是否足以搭脚手架，让 receiver 接着往下推”。作者把这个协议放到三个性质不同的 benchmark 上：AIME 偏数学推导，答案是单个整数；MMLU-Pro 偏知识与多选判断；ZebraLogic 偏约束满足和结构化多字段答案。这样的任务选择不是为了覆盖面，而是为了让不同 transfer 机制显形。AIME 更容易观察答案何时显式出现；MMLU-Pro 更容易暴露 receiver 自身能力的影响；ZebraLogic 则适合看部分结构化答案是否会逐步累积。除此之外，作者还研究了一个推理时策略：如果多个 receiver 在某个前缀上已经给出一致答案，是否可以提前停止，不再继续消费更长的 provider trace。进一步地，他们还看这种 agreement 是否在连续多个前缀上保持稳定，因为单次一致可能只是偶然碰对。
summary.experiments: 关键结果有三层。第一，完整 trace 往往确实能跨模型迁移，但这件事本身不能说明 transfer 机制。第二，看前缀轨迹后，三个 benchmark 呈现出不同模式。在 AIME 上，force-answer 和 free-generation 分化很明显：force-answer 通常要等到前缀里已经出现最终答案，receiver 才开始大幅变对；而 free-generation 往往在答案显式出现之前就能受益，说明部分推理步骤能作为支架，帮助 receiver 自己补完剩余推导。这个结果很关键，因为它说明“full trace transfer 成功”并不等于“receiver 理解了 provider 的整条推理”；有时只是读到了答案。第三，在 MMLU-Pro 上，receiver 的内在知识和原始能力影响更大，短前缀也可能足够触发正确选择；在 ZebraLogic 上，帮助来自结构化部分答案的逐步累积，而不只是最终答案泄露。作者还测试了 agreement-based stopping：当多个 receiver 在某个前缀上给出相同答案时就停止。结果显示，如果这个一致答案能在连续前缀上保持稳定，可靠性会明显更高，尤其在 AIME 的 force-answer 设置下，稳定一致通常意味着前缀里已经含有答案。当前提供的全文片段没有保留完整表格和每个模型组合的具体数值，因此无法在这里准确列出各 benchmark 的绝对准确率、prefix 长度阈值或节省的 token 比例；但从论文叙述看，实验重点不在刷新分数，而在用轨迹形态区分 transfer 机制。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇适合泛读但要看图。先看 Figure 1 和方法部分，把 provider–receiver、prefix exposure、force-answer/free-generation 三个概念吃透，否则后面的结果会显得琐碎。然后直接看 AIME 的主结果图，因为那组实验最清楚地展示了“答案泄露”和“推理支架”的分离。接着看 MMLU-Pro 和 ZebraLogic，对比为什么一个更受 receiver 自身能力支配，另一个更像结构化部分信息逐步累积。最后看 agreement-based stopping，那部分虽然像附加实验，但对长 CoT 推理成本控制有实际意义。预计 35–50 分钟可以读完主线；如果你关心 CoT distillation、reasoning transfer 或 verifier 设计，值得把附录里的模型配对、prefix 切分方式和稳定一致判据也看掉。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a more precise question than whether chain-of-thought transfers across models. When one model’s CoT is given to another model solving the same problem, what exactly is being transferred? A successful final answer from the receiver could come from at least three different mechanisms: the trace already contains the answer, the trace provides enough intermediate structure for the receiver to continue reasoning, or the receiver was already competent enough to solve the task with minimal help. To disentangle these cases, the authors turn CoT transfer into a controlled provider–receiver setup and study not only full traces but also progressively longer prefixes of the same trace.
summary_en.importance: This is not a direct pretraining recipe paper, but it is highly relevant to reasoning data, CoT distillation, cross-model transfer, and the broader question of what textual reasoning traces actually encode. Its main contribution is analytical rather than architectural. First, it replaces a single end-point transfer score with a trajectory over trace prefixes, which makes answer leakage distinguishable from genuine reasoning support. Second, it compares force-answer and free-generation modes, exposing whether the receiver is extracting an answer from the text or using the text as scaffolding for its own continuation. Third, it proposes receiver agreement as a gold-free stopping criterion, which matters for reducing the cost of consuming long reasoning traces. For anyone working on synthetic reasoning data or post-training for reasoning, the paper offers a useful lens for judging when CoT is informative versus merely answer-revealing.
summary_en.technical_approach: The experimental design is simple and well controlled. The authors select seven open-source reasoning-tuned models and assign fixed provider and receiver roles, with the main focus on stronger-to-weaker transfer. A provider first generates a full reasoning trace for a problem. Instead of evaluating only the full trace, the trace is then exposed to the receiver through cumulative prefixes of increasing length. For each prefix, the receiver is tested in two modes. In force-answer mode, it must answer directly from the available prefix, which isolates what can be extracted from the provided text alone. In free-generation mode, it may continue reasoning before answering, which tests whether the prefix can scaffold the receiver’s own reasoning process. The protocol is run on three benchmarks chosen for complementary transfer dynamics: AIME for derivation-heavy math with single integer answers, MMLU-Pro for knowledge-intensive multiple-choice reasoning, and ZebraLogic for constraint reasoning with structured multi-field outputs. This benchmark choice is central to the paper’s logic: AIME makes answer appearance easy to track, MMLU-Pro highlights receiver-intrinsic competence, and ZebraLogic reveals whether partial structured information accumulates before the full answer is available. The paper also studies an inference-time policy based on receiver agreement: if multiple receivers converge to the same answer from a partial prefix, the system can stop early instead of consuming the full provider trace. The authors further test whether agreement that persists across consecutive prefixes is more reliable than one-off agreement.
summary_en.experiments: The main findings come in three layers. First, full traces often do transfer successfully across models, but that fact alone is not diagnostic of mechanism. Second, prefix trajectories reveal benchmark-specific patterns. On AIME, force-answer and free-generation diverge sharply: in force-answer mode, receivers usually become correct only after the final answer is already present in the prefix, while in free-generation mode they often succeed earlier by continuing from partial reasoning. This is the paper’s clearest result, because it shows that successful full-trace transfer does not necessarily mean the receiver has benefited from the provider’s reasoning process; sometimes it simply reads off the answer. On MMLU-Pro, transfer depends more strongly on the receiver’s own competence and prior knowledge, so shorter prefixes can already be sufficient. On ZebraLogic, the useful signal often comes from progressively accumulated partial structured answers rather than explicit final-answer leakage alone. Third, the agreement-based stopping experiments show that early stopping can retain much of the transfer benefit, and that agreement is substantially more reliable when the same answer remains stable across consecutive prefix lengths. The excerpt provided here does not include the full result tables, so exact accuracies, prefix thresholds, and token savings cannot be reproduced faithfully in this summary. The value of the experiments lies less in headline numbers and more in the shape of the transfer curves and what those curves imply about mechanism.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a skim paper, but it is worth reading the figures carefully. Start with Figure 1 and the method section until the provider–receiver protocol, cumulative prefix exposure, and the two receiver modes are completely clear. Then go straight to the AIME results, which provide the cleanest separation between answer leakage and reasoning scaffolding. After that, read the MMLU-Pro and ZebraLogic sections to understand why one benchmark is dominated more by receiver competence while the other benefits from partial structured information. Finish with the agreement-based stopping section; it may look secondary, but it is the most practically actionable part for reducing long-CoT inference cost. Around 35–50 minutes should be enough for the main line. If you care about CoT distillation, reasoning transfer, or verifier design, also inspect the appendix for model pairings, prefix construction details, and the stability criterion for agreement.

recommendation.zh: 只看 prefix trajectory 设计和 AIME/MMLU-Pro 对比；它能校正“长 CoT 可蒸馏推理”的过强先验。
recommendation.en: Read the prefix-trajectory setup and the AIME/MMLU-Pro contrast; it usefully weakens the prior that long CoT traces necessarily distill reasoning.

paper.title: DenseSteer: Steering Small Language Models towards Dense Math Reasoning
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate strong chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning abilities, while smaller models (<= 3B parameters) significantly underperform on multi-step reasoning tasks. Based on empirical analyses of the Qwen-2.5 model family on math reasoning benchmarks, we find that more proficient reasoning is associated with fewer reasoning steps but higher information density per step, a property we term Dense Reasoning. Motivated by this observation, we propose DenseSteer, a training-f

summary.core_problem: DenseSteer 解决的是小模型在数学 CoT 推理中步骤多、信息密度低、又难以直接吸收大模型推理轨迹的问题，目标是在不训练模型的情况下改善推理结构和答案准确率。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对基座预训练本身不是核心贡献，但对 post-train 与推理机制分析有启发。它把小模型推理能力不足的一部分归因到“推理轨迹结构”而不只是知识不足或参数量不足，并用 token-level NLL 检查外部教师轨迹是否落在学生模型可生成分布内。这个视角对蒸馏数据构造有用：高质量教师答案不一定是好训练信号，学生模型能否自然建模这些轨迹同样重要。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先在 Qwen2.5 系列上观察数学推理差异：更强模型往往使用更少的中间步骤，但每一步包含更多有效信息，作者称为 Dense Reasoning。随后提出 DenseSteer，一个 training-free 的 inference-time steering 方法。关键不是直接把小模型 hidden states 拉向大模型轨迹，因为跨模型或跨家族轨迹在学生模型下的 NLL 更高，容易造成分布错位。作者改用 Dense-Rewriting：先让小模型生成自己的解题过程，再用 GPT-5.1 将其改写成更紧凑、更高信息密度的形式，作为正样本；原始或低密度版本作为对照，构造 steering vector。推理时在指定层的内部表示上加这个方向，使生成更接近 dense reasoning，而不需要额外 SFT 或大规模蒸馏。
summary.experiments: 实验围绕小模型数学推理展开，主要使用 Qwen2.5 家族中不超过 3B 参数的模型，并分析 GSM8K 等数学数据。分布兼容性部分在 200 个 GSM8K 样本上计算学生模型对不同来源推理轨迹的 token-level NLL，结果显示跨家族参考轨迹 NLL 更高，同模型自身输出最低，因此直接用强教师轨迹做 steering 会引入更明显的分布偏移。主实验显示 DenseSteer 在多个数学推理任务上带来稳定准确率提升，同时没有增加 token-level NLL。消融的关键点是 Dense-Rewriting 优于直接使用大模型推理轨迹，说明“保留学生分布、只改推理结构”比“模仿强教师表面风格”更稳。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读 20 分钟左右即可。建议重点看 Section 3.1 的 NLL 分布差异实验，这部分解释了为什么不能直接用大模型 trace 做 steering；再看 Dense Reasoning metric 的定义，确认作者如何量化“步骤更少但信息更密”。方法部分关注 Dense-Rewriting 如何构造 contrastive pairs，以及 steering vector 加在哪些层、强度如何调。实验部分重点看准确率和 NLL 是否同时报告，以及不同正样本来源的消融。若关注蒸馏或小模型推理训练，这篇的价值主要在数据可学习性和分布兼容性，而不是 steering 技术本身。

summary_en.core_problem: DenseSteer targets a specific failure mode of small language models in mathematical CoT reasoning: they often produce fragmented, low-density reasoning traces, while direct imitation of large-model traces can be distributionally incompatible.
summary_en.importance: The paper is not a core pretraining contribution, but it is useful for post-training, distillation, and reasoning analysis. Its main signal is that reasoning quality should not be judged only by final correctness or trace length. The likelihood of teacher traces under the student model matters. A strong teacher rationale can be a poor training or steering target if it lies far outside the student’s generation distribution.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors first analyze the Qwen2.5 model family and identify a pattern they call Dense Reasoning: stronger models tend to use fewer intermediate steps while packing more useful information into each step. DenseSteer then uses inference-time activation steering rather than fine-tuning. A naive version would build steering vectors from large-model traces, but the paper shows that such traces often have higher token-level NLL under the small target model, especially across model families. To avoid this mismatch, Dense-Rewriting is introduced. The small model first generates its own solution; GPT-5.1 then rewrites that solution into a denser style while staying closer to the student’s distribution. These rewritten traces serve as positive anchors for contrastive steering-vector construction. At inference time, the vector is added to selected hidden representations to bias the model toward denser reasoning without SFT or large-scale distillation.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments focus on math reasoning with small models, mainly Qwen2.5 variants at or below 3B parameters, and include GSM8K-style analysis. For distribution compatibility, the paper computes token-level NLL on 200 GSM8K examples under the student model. Cross-family reference traces receive higher NLL, while the student’s own outputs are the most compatible, supporting the decision to rewrite student outputs rather than directly import teacher traces. The main results show consistent accuracy gains on math reasoning tasks without increasing token-level NLL. The important ablation is the comparison between Dense-Rewriting-based steering and steering from raw large-model rationales; the former is more stable because it changes the reasoning structure while preserving much of the student’s native distribution.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20-minute skim is sufficient. Focus first on Section 3.1, where NLL is used to diagnose distribution mismatch between student models and candidate reference traces. Then read the definition of the Dense Reasoning metric to see how the paper operationalizes fewer but denser steps. In the method section, check how contrastive pairs are built, which layers are steered, and how steering strength is selected. In the experiments, pay attention to whether accuracy and NLL are reported together, and to ablations over positive-sample sources. For readers working on distillation or small-model reasoning, the main takeaway is the learnability and distribution-compatibility criterion, more than the activation-steering mechanism itself.

recommendation.zh: 核心发现（更强推理=更少步骤+更高信息密度）对思考CoT训练数据的结构设计有启发，建议看实证分析部分；推理时调控方法本身对预训练直接价值有限。
recommendation.en: The core finding (stronger reasoning = fewer steps + higher information density) is insightful for designing CoT training data structures; read the empirical analysis section. The inference-time steering method itself has limited direct pretrain value.

paper.title: Zipping the Thought: When and How Compressed Reasoning Data Works in LLM Post-Training
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can now solve complex problems through long chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning, but the trade-off between performance and token cost remains a central challenge. To address this issue, supervised fine-tuning (SFT) often uses compressed reasoning data, where CoT traces are shortened into compact forms. However, the effect of such compressed reasoning data on post-training remains poorly understood. In this paper, we propose a taxonomy of CoT consisting of Explicit CoT,

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究压缩 CoT 数据在后训练中什么时候有效、什么时候会伤害泛化。核心问题是：SFT 是否能从被压缩的推理步骤中学会隐藏的原子操作分解，RLVR 是否能在探索中恢复这种分解能力。
summary.importance: 它对预训练研究的启发主要在 Pretrain ↔ Posttrain 接口。推理数据压缩不只是节省 token，也会改变模型看到的技能颗粒度。显式 CoT 提供逐步监督，压缩 CoT 提高 token 效率但降低可模仿性。论文的关键结论是，SFT 对压缩步骤的分解能力有限，而 RLVR 可以通过探索把压缩技能拆开并组合到更长任务上。这对 reasoning data design、annealing 阶段的数据配比、以及用短轨迹训练长推理能力都有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先给出 CoT 压缩分类：Explicit CoT 输出每个原子操作和中间值；Composed CoT 把多个操作合成一步，但仍显式描述这个组合操作；Implicit CoT 直接省略 chunk 内部操作，只给出压缩后的结果。随后构造一个可控的算术组合推理任务，把问题表示为一串原子变换的顺序组合。这个任务可以控制难度、压缩粒度、CoT 类型和训练/测试长度差异。作者用 Qwen2.5 和 Llama-3 系列模型做 SFT 与 RLVR，对比不同数据量、重复次数、压缩粒度和 CoT 顺序对 OOD 长组合任务的影响。技术重点不是提出新算法，而是用受控任务拆开“压缩推理数据为何有效”这个问题。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Qwen2.5 与 Llama-3，模型规模从 0.5B 到 14B。主要发现包括：粗粒度压缩 CoT 在 SFT 中需要更多不同样本；Compressed CoT 相比 Explicit CoT 更依赖数据规模；在压缩类型内部，Composed CoT 能从数据重复中受益，而 Implicit CoT 在 OOD 长任务上更容易退化；SFT 本身难以把压缩步骤重新分解成原子操作，RLVR 则可以通过探索获得这种分解并提升对更长组合任务的泛化；CoT 顺序也很关键，单向顺序 CoT 可以泛化，层级 chunk 化的 CoT 对更长任务泛化较差。提供内容中没有给出具体准确率表格或提升百分比。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议先看 Problem Setup，理解 Explicit、Composed、Implicit 三类 CoT 的定义，否则后面的结果容易混在一起。然后看 Section 3.1–3.3：3.1 关注压缩粒度与 SFT 训练步数，3.2 看数据规模和重复，3.3 看 SFT 与 RLVR 是否能分解压缩步骤。Section 3.4 关于 CoT 顺序，适合做数据格式设计时参考。预计阅读时间 30–40 分钟；如果只关心结论，可重点看 Figure 1、Figure 4 和各小节主结果图。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies when compressed chain-of-thought data helps post-training and when it hurts generalization. The key question is whether SFT can recover the hidden atomic operations inside compressed reasoning steps, and whether RL with verifiable rewards can decompose those steps through exploration.
summary_en.importance: The main value is in understanding the interface between reasoning data design and post-training dynamics. Compressing CoT is not only a token-cost decision; it changes the granularity of the skills exposed to the model. Explicit CoT gives dense step-level imitation targets, while compressed CoT improves token efficiency but can hide the structure needed for extrapolation. The important finding is that SFT has limited ability to decompose compressed steps, whereas RLVR can recover decomposition and compose skills for longer tasks. This is relevant for reasoning data pipelines, SFT/RL staging, and training shorter traces that still support longer inference-time reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper defines a taxonomy of reasoning traces. Explicit CoT emits every atomic operation and intermediate value. Composed CoT groups multiple operations into one step while still describing the combined operation. Implicit CoT omits the internal operations of a chunk and only emits the compressed result. The authors then build a controlled arithmetic compositional task where difficulty, compression granularity, CoT type, and train-test length mismatch can be varied. They train Qwen2.5 and Llama-3 models with SFT and RLVR, and study the effects of data size, repetition, compression granularity, and CoT ordering on out-of-distribution generalization to longer compositional problems. The contribution is primarily an empirical decomposition of reasoning-data structure, not a new optimizer or model architecture.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use Qwen2.5 and Llama-3 models ranging from 0.5B to 14B parameters. The main results are: coarsely compressed CoT requires more distinct SFT examples; compressed CoT benefits more from data scaling than explicit CoT; within compressed traces, Composed CoT benefits from repetition, while Implicit CoT shows worse OOD behavior; SFT cannot reliably decompose compressed chunks into atomic steps, but RLVR can do so through exploration and improves generalization to longer compositions; CoT ordering matters, with unidirectional traces generalizing better than hierarchically chunked traces. The provided content does not include the exact accuracy numbers or percentage gains.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the Problem Setup to get the definitions of Explicit, Composed, and Implicit CoT right. Then skim Sections 3.1 to 3.3: Section 3.1 covers compression granularity and SFT steps, Section 3.2 studies data scaling and repetition, and Section 3.3 is the most relevant part for the SFT-versus-RLVR decomposition question. Section 3.4 is useful for anyone designing reasoning trace formats, because it shows that ordering choices affect length generalization. Estimated reading time: 30–40 minutes; for a faster pass, focus on Figure 1, Figure 4, and the main result plots in each subsection.

recommendation.zh: 系统分析了 SFT 中 CoT 数据的“压缩程度”（显式/组合/隐式）与所需数据量之间的关系，结论很 intuitive（越压缩越需要 data scaling），对构造 reasoning SFT 数据有指导意义。
recommendation.en: Systematically analyzes the relationship between CoT 'compression level' (explicit/composed/implicit) and required data volume in SFT; the intuitive conclusion (more compression needs more data scaling) guides reasoning SFT data construction.

paper.title: Revealing Algorithmic Deductive Circuits for Logical Reasoning
paper.abstract: Recent studies have shown that Large Language Models (LLMs) can achieve strong reasoning performance by incorporating functional symbolic representations that abstractly describe graph traversal algorithms and step-by-step reasoning in few-shot learning settings. However, it remains unclear how LLMs genuinely understand the abstract meaning of each reasoning step and the overall algorithm from only a limited number of demonstrations. This work aims to localize the attention heads responsible for

summary.core_problem: 在符号辅助 CoT 的演绎推理任务中，LLM 是如何在内部实现“按算法执行”的：哪些注意力头负责单步推理的关键决策（选前提、停止选前提、选规则），这些头之间传递什么信息，以及它们对最终推理路径的因果作用有多大。
summary.importance: 这不是预训练方法论文，而是机制分析/可解释性工作。对预训练研究的间接价值在于：它把“推理步骤的关键 token 位点”与“可定位的注意力头电路”对应起来，提供了一种更细粒度的诊断框架，可用于评估不同预训练/中期训练配方是否真的改变了推理电路（而不只是改变表面输出）。此外，它强调了少数“高不确定 token”对推理轨迹的支配作用，这对构造更有效的训练信号（例如在这些位点做 targeted loss / curriculum / verifier shaping）有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者在 Symbolic-Aided CoT 框架下，把演绎推理形式化为推理图上的遍历过程（示例提到 BFS/DFS 的演示会诱导不同的遍历偏好）。先做一个定位步骤：把 CoT 中的组成步骤与对应的 token logits 对齐，找出跨模型家族都“难解码”的不确定 token（通常是决定推理分支的起始 token，例如选择哪个前提字母、是否停止选前提、选择哪条规则）。然后用因果中介分析（CMA）与 activation/path patching 去找“对这些不确定 token 的 logit 变化有因果贡献”的注意力头子集，并进一步恢复这些头之间的信息流图，形成一个由多个子电路组成的 circuit network（分别对应 premise selection / termination / rule selection）。最后通过 knock-out（移除/抑制这些头）在标准演绎推理基准上验证电路的可迁移性与必要性。
summary.experiments:
实验主线包括三部分：
1) 统计性预实验：在合成数据上识别不确定 token 位点，并观察其在不同模型/规模上普遍存在。
2) 电路抽取：构造“干净 vs 污染”的提示对（针对每个推理组件分别污染），用 activation patching/path patching 找关键注意力头与信息流。
3) 因果验证：对抽取出的头做 knock-out，并在 ProntoQA 等演绎推理基准上评估性能下降，以证明这些头对推理步骤执行是必要的。
当前提供的全文片段未包含具体模型列表、层/头数量、以及 knock-out 后的定量跌幅表格，因此无法可靠给出数值级结论；精读需要直接看实验章节的电路可视化图与性能表。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（30–45 分钟）：
- 先看他们如何定义并自动对齐“推理组件 ↔ token 位点”，以及“不确定 token”的判据（这决定了后续 CMA 的目标是否合理）。
- 重点看数据构造：clean/corrupted prompt 的污染方式是否只改变一个组件、是否引入分布外噪声。
- 看 circuit network 的信息流图：哪些层的头在读 KB snapshot、哪些在实现遍历偏好（BFS/DFS），哪些在把已证明事实写回。
- 最后看 knock-out 的泛化验证：是否跨任务/跨提示模板仍然成立，还是只对合成格式有效。

summary_en.core_problem: In symbolic-aided CoT deductive reasoning, what internal mechanisms enable an LLM to execute an algorithm-like multi-step procedure: which attention heads causally implement key step decisions (premise selection, termination, rule selection), what information they carry, and how they interact as a circuit network.
summary_en.importance: Not a pretraining-method paper; it is mechanistic interpretability. The indirect relevance to pretraining is diagnostic: it links a small set of trajectory-steering ‘uncertain tokens’ to identifiable attention-head circuits, offering a way to test whether changes in pretraining/mid-training actually modify reasoning circuitry rather than just surface-form outputs. The emphasis on a few high-leverage token positions also suggests targeted training signals (loss reweighting, curricula, verifier shaping) that focus on branch-defining decisions.
summary_en.technical_approach: Under Symbolic-Aided CoT, the reasoning process is formalized as inference-graph traversal, with demonstrations potentially inducing traversal strategies (e.g., BFS vs DFS preferences). The pipeline is: (1) align constituent reasoning steps to token-level logits and identify ‘uncertain tokens’ that consistently steer the reasoning path (e.g., the first token choosing a premise label, the token deciding whether to stop selecting premises, the token choosing a rule); (2) apply causal mediation analysis with activation patching and path patching to find the subset of attention heads that causally drive logit changes at those uncertain tokens; (3) reconstruct information-flow graphs among these heads, yielding a circuit network with subcircuits per reasoning component; (4) validate necessity/generalization by knocking out the identified heads and measuring degradation on established deductive reasoning benchmarks.
summary_en.experiments: Three experimental blocks: (i) preliminary analyses on synthetic data to locate uncertain token positions and show they persist across model families/sizes; (ii) circuit extraction using paired clean vs corrupted prompts per reasoning component, enabling activation/path patching attribution; (iii) causal validation via head knock-outs evaluated on benchmarks such as ProntoQA. The provided excerpt does not include the full quantitative tables (models used, number of heads, exact performance drops), so numeric claims should be checked directly in the results section and appendices.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
- Read the step-to-token alignment method and the operational definition of ‘uncertain tokens’; this is the foundation for the entire causal analysis.
- Inspect how clean/corrupted prompt pairs are constructed and whether corruption isolates a single component without introducing distribution shift artifacts.
- Study the circuit-network visualizations: which layers/heads read the KB snapshot, which encode traversal preferences, and which propagate proven facts.
- Check knock-out generalization: does the circuit remain important across tasks and prompt templates, or only within the synthetic symbolic format?

recommendation.zh: 读 §因果中介和 head 类型即可；若定位稳定，会给 CoT circuit 分析一个较干净的拆分模板。
recommendation.en: Read the causal mediation and head-typing parts; if stable, this gives a clean template for dissecting CoT circuits.

paper.title: Do Models Know Why They Changed Their Mind? Interpretability and Faithfulness of Chain-of-Thought Under Knowledge Conflict
paper.abstract: When a language model sees a document contradicting its training knowledge, it must choose: follow the document or trust itself. Prior work proved this choice depends on how well-known the fact is. We ask: does the model's chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning faithfully report this mechanism? We introduce introspective faithfulness and test it across 200 questions, 8 models, and 4 prompt conditions. We find CoT reasoning is highly stable across opposite decisions: flip pairs retain 96% of same-answe

summary.core_problem: 当模型在外部文档和参数知识冲突时改变答案，CoT 是否真实反映了它为什么改变主意。
summary.importance: 这是一个 CoT faithfulness 和知识冲突机制分析工作。它不提出新训练方法，但对推理数据、self-rationalization、verifier 设计有直接参考价值：模型生成的理由可能很稳定，却不跟最终决策机制绑定。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 introspective faithfulness 的评估设置，构造训练知识与给定文档冲突的问题，并比较模型在不同决策下的 CoT 文本相似度、置信度、自评信号和最终答案之间的耦合关系。核心不是解释 attention，而是检验自然语言推理文本是否报告了真正的决策因子。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 200 个问题、8 个模型、4 种 prompt 条件。主要结果包括：答案翻转的样本对仍保留 96% 的 same-answer similarity，效应量 d=0.34，并由 ROUGE-L d=0.45 复核；在实体知名度不再有信息量的 obscure facts 上，置信度仍能预测决策，p<0.001，并与 item-level knowledge 弱相关，r=0.134；GPT-4o 是唯一显示统计可靠 reasoning-decision coupling 的模型；Claude Sonnet 4.6 的置信度范围最大，SD=1.39，但 pooled correlation 接近 0，因为不同条件下关系方向会反转。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether a model's chain-of-thought faithfully explains why it changes its answer when an external document conflicts with its parametric knowledge.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism study of CoT faithfulness under knowledge conflict. It does not propose a training method, but it is relevant for reasoning-data design, self-rationalization, and verifier construction because generated rationales may stay stable while the decision mechanism changes.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work introduces an introspective-faithfulness setup with questions where model knowledge and supplied documents conflict. It measures CoT similarity, confidence, self-reported signals, and their coupling with final decisions across prompt conditions. The focus is not attention-level interpretation, but whether natural-language reasoning reports the actual decision factors.
summary_en.experiments: The study uses 200 questions, 8 models, and 4 prompt conditions. Key findings include: flipped-decision pairs retain 96% same-answer similarity with effect size d=0.34, confirmed by ROUGE-L with d=0.45; for obscure facts where entity fame is uninformative, confidence still predicts decisions with p<0.001 and weakly tracks item-level knowledge with r=0.134; GPT-4o is the only model with statistically reliable reasoning-decision coupling; Claude Sonnet 4.6 has the widest confidence range, SD=1.39, but near-zero pooled correlation because the confidence-decision relationship reverses across conditions.

recommendation.zh: 读实验表就够了；它会降低你对 CoT 文本作为训练信号的信任，但不等于置信度完全没信息。
recommendation.en: Skim the result tables; it should lower trust in CoT text as a training signal, while preserving the weaker point that confidence still carries some information.

paper.title: Explaining is Harder Than Predicting Alone: Evaluating Concept-based Explanations of MLLMs as ICL Visual Classifiers
paper.abstract: In-context learning (ICL) enables multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to classify images from a few labelled examples. Yet, how these models use the provided context remains opaque. While Chain-of-Thought prompting is widely used, recent work argues that it may not reflect true internal computation.   In this paper, we systematically evaluate the concept-based explainability of frozen MLLMs under few-shot ICL using five conditions of increasing formal rigour, ranging from baseline classific

summary.core_problem: 评估冻结 MLLM 在 few-shot ICL 图像分类时，能否生成与其分类行为一致且形式化的概念解释。
summary.importance: 贡献是 MLLM ICL 和解释可靠性的分析。它对 CoT/解释是否等同于真实计算过程这一问题给出一个多模态场景下的反例信号，但任务是视觉分类解释，离基座预训练方法较远。
summary.technical_approach: 论文设计五种逐渐增强形式约束的条件，从普通分类到生成 Description Logics 公理；在冻结 MLLM 上进行 few-shot ICL 图像分类，并用独立 LLM-as-a-judge pipeline 评估概念解释质量和预测表现。
summary.experiments: 评估 4 个 MLLM。摘要报告随着解释形式要求增强，预测准确率从 93.8% 单调下降到 90.1%；这说明要求模型给出更严格的概念化解释并不必然提升分类表现。摘要未提供具体模型名称和数据集细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether frozen MLLMs used as few-shot ICL image classifiers can produce concept-based explanations that are faithful and formally structured.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an analysis of MLLM in-context learning and explanation reliability. It provides a multimodal counter-signal to the assumption that explicit reasoning or explanations necessarily improve performance, but the task is visual classification explanation rather than foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors define five conditions with increasing formal rigor, ranging from baseline classification to Description Logics axiom generation. Frozen MLLMs perform few-shot ICL visual classification, and an independent LLM-as-a-judge pipeline evaluates the concept-based explanations and predictions.
summary_en.experiments: The study evaluates four MLLMs. The abstract reports that stricter explanation requirements monotonically reduce predictive accuracy from 93.8% to 90.1%, suggesting that formal concept explanations do not universally help classification.
