The abstract does not specify the exact models or datasets.

recommendation.zh: 只看准确率随解释约束下降的实验；它提醒别把显式解释当成干净监督信号。
recommendation.en: Skim only the accuracy drop under stricter explanation constraints; it is a caution against treating explicit explanations as clean supervision.

paper.title: InterSketch: An Interleaved Reasoning Model with Self-correcting Visual Sketch and Stepwise Reward
paper.abstract: While vision-language models (VLMs) have exhibited multi-turn visual reasoning capabilities, their reasoning trajectories remain relatively shallow and are dominated by a text-centric paradigm, limiting their applicability to complex visual challenges. In contrast, human-like thought typically involves long-horizon reasoning with an interleaved visual-textual chain-of-thought (VT-CoT). To bridge this gap, we introduce InterSketch, an interleaved reasoning model to enhance the VT-CoT capability v

summary.core_problem: 现有视觉语言模型的多轮视觉推理轨迹偏浅且以文本为中心，缺乏人类式长程交错的图文思维链能力，难以处理复杂视觉任务
summary.importance: 方法创新+数据贡献，提出交错式图文推理范式，同时构建了高质量合成的交错图文思维链数据集
summary.technical_approach: 提出InterSketch模型，通过外部工具动态生成中间视觉草图并与文本推理交错执行，结合自校正反射机制与逐步奖励训练；冷启动阶段使用合成的高质量交错图文思维链数据集做训练
summary.experiments: 针对长程视觉理解任务验证有效性，摘要未披露具体模型参数量、完整基线对比与量化提升幅度

summary_en.core_problem: Existing vision-language models rely on shallow, text-centric multi-turn visual reasoning and lack human-like long-horizon interleaved vision-text chain-of-thought capabilities for complex tasks
summary_en.importance: Methodological and data contribution: proposes an interleaved vision-text reasoning paradigm and releases a high-quality synthetic interleaved VT-CoT dataset
summary_en.technical_approach: InterSketch dynamically generates intermediate visual sketches via external tools, interleaves them with textual reasoning, and trains with self-correction reflection and stepwise reward; uses a synthetic high-quality VT-CoT dataset for cold start
summary_en.experiments: Validated on long-horizon visual understanding tasks, no specific model size, full baseline comparison or quantitative improvement metrics are disclosed in the abstract

recommendation.zh: 属于多模态推理增强的增量工作，仅适合做多模态对齐的研究员参考，无需精读
recommendation.en: Incremental work on multimodal reasoning enhancement, only reference for multimodal alignment researchers, no need for close reading

paper.title: Rethinking the Multilingual Reasoning Gap with Layer Swap
paper.abstract: Recent reasoning Large Language Models produce a chain-of-thought (CoT) predominantly in English, even when prompted in non-English languages. Prior work suggests that forcing the CoT to remain in the input language (\emph{native reasoning}) substantially degrades performance relative to allowing the model to reason in English before answering in the input language (\emph{English-pivoted reasoning}). However, most studies of this native reasoning gap rely on inference-time interventions or limit

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的不是“非英语推理为什么差”这个泛问题，而是一个更具体也更关键的问题：在后训练预算、监督规模、数据形态都尽量对齐的条件下，native reasoning 相比 English-pivoted reasoning 到底还剩多大差距，这个差距来自哪里，能不能不用再次训练就把它进一步缩小。已有结论大多来自两类设置：一类是只靠推理时提示词强行要求目标语言 CoT，另一类是用很小规模的本地语言推理数据做微调。这两种设置都容易把“语言切换带来的真实能力差异”和“监督不足、数据稀缺、训练不充分”混在一起。作者把问题重新放回到可比的 SFT 框架里，并进一步追问：如果 native specialist 和 English-pivoted specialist 学到的是同一套推理技能，只是语言载体不同，那么模型内部是否存在一个相对语言无关的 reasoning core，可以通过权重层面的组合直接迁移过来。
summary.importance: 对预训练和后训练接口研究，这篇工作的价值主要有三层。第一，它把多语言推理差距从“语言天然不适合做长 CoT”重新校正为“在足够监督下，差距比想象中小得多”，这会直接影响多语言 post-training 的资源分配判断。文中在五种非英语语言上测到的平均 native gap 只有 1.9%–3.5%，明显小于很多先前工作给人的印象。第二，它给出一个很有启发的结构性观察：跨语言 SFT 更新在中间层高度对齐，在首尾层分歧更大。这意味着 reasoning skill 与 language-specific interface 在层级上是部分解耦的，这对 multilingual continual tuning、adapter 设计、甚至预训练阶段的参数共享策略都有参考意义。第三，Layer Swap 这个结果虽然发生在 SFT specialist 上，但它触及的是更一般的问题：当两个模型共享底座、任务能力相近、只是在监督语言上不同，是否可以通过权重空间重组来做低成本能力迁移。这个思路对多语言、跨模态、甚至不同 reasoning style 之间的模型拼接都有启发。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上分三步。第一步是构造可比训练语料。作者从 allenai/Dolci-Think-SFT-32B 中均匀采样约 50 万条英文样本，覆盖数学、代码、科学、指令跟随、安全、聊天和结构化数据等类别，再翻译到法语、德语、西班牙语、中文和斯瓦希里语，形成六种语言各约 50 万条、最长 32k context 的长 CoT 数据。这里不是简单整条翻译，而是把 question、reasoning trace、final answer 分开，并按约 2k token 的句段切块翻译，再重组。这样做是因为作者在全文里明确指出，直接对超长样本做单次翻译会出现两类失败：长上下文退化导致循环，以及更隐蔽的 CoT 被静默丢失。这个数据工程细节很重要，因为它说明多语言 reasoning 数据构造的瓶颈并不只是翻译质量，还包括长轨迹结构保真。

第二步是在严格对齐的 SFT 条件下训练两类 specialist。底座是 Qwen/Qwen3-8B-Base。对每个非英语语言，作者训练 native specialist：输入、CoT、答案都在目标语言；同时训练 English-pivoted specialist：输入和最终答案在目标语言，但中间 CoT 用英语。每种语言的 SFT token 预算大约都是 10B，避免了“native 数据少所以差”的混淆。这个设计的关键不只是双轨训练，而是 supervision parity：同一底座、同量级 token、同类任务分布，只改变 reasoning trace 的语言。

第三步是权重空间分析与 Layer Swap。作者比较不同语言 specialist 相对同一 base model 的参数更新，发现中间层更新方向跨语言更一致，而靠近 embedding / early layers 和靠近输出端的 late layers 差异更大。基于这个观察，他们采用 training-free 的 Layer Swap：保留 native specialist 的首尾层，以维持目标语言输入理解和输出表达；把 English specialist 的中间层替换进去，以迁移更强的 reasoning core。这个方案和常见的 merge、adapter 或 LoRA 叠加不同，它依赖的是“层功能分工”而不是简单参数平均。全文的一个重要细节是，作者并不是把英语模型整体拿来覆盖，而是只交换中间层，这说明他们把 native gap 解释为 reasoning core 与 language interface 的错配，而不是整体能力不足。

作者还做了 input-language ablation，去区分“输入理解”与“推理过程语言”哪个更像瓶颈。结论是，在 matched native SFT 下，输入理解仍是主要瓶颈之一。这一点很关键，因为它意味着即便 CoT 已经能用目标语言写出来，模型对复杂非英语题面的解析仍可能限制上限。换句话说，native reasoning 的问题不只是‘不会用该语言思考’，而是‘对该语言复杂输入的编码不够稳’。
summary.experiments:
最核心的结果有三组。第一组是 native gap 的重新测量。作者在 general knowledge、mathematics、code、science 等基准上比较 native specialist 与 English-pivoted specialist，五种非英语语言上的平均差距只有 1.9%–3.5%。而且差距主要集中在复杂 reasoning benchmark 上，在其他 benchmark 上更小。这说明先前被放大的 native reasoning 劣势，很大一部分可能来自训练规模不匹配，而不是语言本身不适合承载推理。

第二组是 Layer Swap 的收益。把 English specialist 的中间层换入 native specialist 后，法语和德语可弥合 83%–89% 的剩余差距，斯瓦希里约 60%，中文约 27%，西班牙语可以达到 English-pivoted ceiling，同时仍保持 CoT 为目标语言。这个结果有两个值得注意的点：一是收益在语言间差异很大，说明“中层 reasoning core 可迁移”并不是完全语言无关，尤其对中文这类脚本和句法差异更大的语言，首尾层之外可能仍有更多语言相关计算渗入中层；二是西班牙语几乎追平上限，说明对高资源且与英语较近的语言，native gap 可能主要是中层 reasoning 表征的轻微偏移，而不是系统性缺陷。

第三组是更新对齐与消融。全文强调 middle layers 的 update alignment 明显高于边缘层，这为 Layer Swap 提供了直接证据，而不是拍脑袋的结构假设。另一个重要消融是输入语言实验，显示即使在 native CoT 监督充足时，输入理解仍是主要瓶颈。虽然截取内容里没有完整表格数字，但从作者在引言中的总结可以看出，这个结论不是边缘观察，而是他们四个主要贡献之一。

训练规模方面，底座是 8B，单语言约 50 万样本、约 10B SFT tokens，最长上下文 32k。这个量级足以让结论摆脱“小样本 native tuning”的局限，也让结果对实际多语言 reasoning post-training 更有参考性。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先抓三件事。第一，看引言和 Figure 2，确认作者真正推翻的是什么：不是证明 native reasoning 完全没有损失，而是证明在可比监督下损失已经很小。第二，看数据构造部分，尤其是长 CoT 翻译为何必须 component-wise chunk translation，以及他们如何过滤 CoT 丢失样本。这部分决定了实验结论是否可信。第三，看权重分析和 Layer Swap 的章节，重点不是“换层后涨了多少”，而是作者如何证明中间层更像 language-agnostic reasoning core。

如果只花 20–30 分钟，建议顺序是：Introduction → Figure 1/2 → Data construction → Layer Swap method → 主结果表。若再多花一点时间，优先看更新对齐分析和 input-language ablation，因为这两部分决定这篇工作的解释力。值得深挖的问题有三个：一，为什么中文的 gap closure 明显低于法德西；二，chunk-wise translation 对长程一致性造成的损失是否会低估 native specialist 上限；三，Layer Swap 是否只适用于共享底座且训练轨迹接近的 specialist，还是能推广到更异质的模型合成。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a narrower and more useful question than the usual “why is non-English reasoning worse.” Under matched supervision, matched SFT token budgets, and comparable data construction, how large is the native-reasoning gap relative to English-pivoted reasoning, where does the remaining gap come from, and can it be reduced without additional training? Prior evidence mostly came from inference-time prompting or small native-language fine-tuning sets, which confound true language effects with supervision scarcity. The authors re-run the comparison at scale and then probe a deeper hypothesis: if native and English-pivoted specialists learn largely the same reasoning skills but express them in different languages, is there a language-agnostic reasoning core inside the model that can be transferred by swapping layers rather than retraining.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining and post-training researchers, the contribution is less about multilingual benchmarking and more about representation structure. First, it recalibrates the native reasoning narrative: with enough native long-CoT supervision, the gap is much smaller than many earlier studies implied, only 1.9%–3.5% on average across five non-English languages. That matters for multilingual post-training budgets and for how one interprets English-dominant CoT behavior in current reasoning models. Second, the weight-space analysis suggests a partial functional separation across depth: middle-layer updates align strongly across languages, while early and late layers diverge more. This is a concrete clue about where language-specific processing lives versus where reasoning computation may be shared. Third, the training-free Layer Swap result is interesting beyond this exact setup. It points to a broader possibility: when two specialists share a base model and differ mainly in supervision language, capability transfer may be achievable through structured parameter recomposition rather than another expensive tuning run.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The work has three main components. The first is data construction under long-context constraints. The authors start from allenai/Dolci-Think-SFT-32B, sample roughly 500k English examples while preserving category balance, and translate them into French, German, Spanish, Chinese, and Swahili, yielding six language-specific corpora with contexts up to 32k tokens. A useful engineering detail appears in the full text: direct single-pass translation of long samples failed in two ways. Very long examples triggered degraded long-context behavior with looping, and some samples silently dropped the reasoning trace while still translating the question and final answer. To avoid this, they translate question, reasoning trace, and final answer separately, chunk each into about 2k-token segments at sentence or paragraph boundaries, translate chunkwise, and then recompose. This is not just a preprocessing footnote; it shows that preserving long reasoning traces in multilingual data creation is itself a nontrivial bottleneck.

The second component is a controlled SFT comparison. Using Qwen/Qwen3-8B-Base, they train for each target language two specialists under matched token budgets of about 10B SFT tokens per language. In the native regime, input, CoT, and answer are all in the target language. In the English-pivoted regime, the input and final answer are in the target language but the intermediate CoT is in English. The key design choice is supervision parity: same base model, same scale, same task mix, only the language of the reasoning trace changes.

The third component is weight-space analysis followed by Layer Swap. The authors compare per-language SFT updates relative to the shared base model and find that update directions align tightly in the middle layers across languages, while divergence is larger near the input and output ends. They then exploit this with a training-free procedure: keep the native specialist’s early and late layers to preserve target-language input understanding and output generation, but replace its middle layers with those from the English specialist to import a stronger reasoning core. This differs from generic model merging or parameter averaging. The method relies on a depth-wise functional hypothesis rather than a global interpolation assumption.

An additional ablation studies the role of input language understanding. The paper argues that even under matched native SFT, input understanding remains a primary bottleneck. That is an important nuance. The issue is not only whether the model can produce a target-language CoT, but whether it can robustly parse complex non-English problem statements before reasoning begins.
summary_en.experiments:
There are three headline findings. First, the native reasoning gap is much smaller than commonly reported when supervision is matched. Across general knowledge, mathematics, code, and science benchmarks, the average gap between native specialists and English-pivoted specialists is only 1.9%–3.5% over the five non-English languages. The remaining gap is concentrated on harder reasoning benchmarks and is much smaller elsewhere. This strongly suggests that earlier estimates were inflated by data and training imbalance rather than by an intrinsic inability to reason natively.

Second, Layer Swap recovers most of the residual gap in several languages while keeping the CoT in the target language. It closes 83%–89% of the gap for French and German, about 60% for Swahili, 27% for Chinese, and reaches the English-pivoted ceiling for Spanish. Two details matter here. The gains are highly language-dependent, which means the middle-layer reasoning core is not perfectly language-invariant. Chinese in particular appears to retain more language-specific computation beyond the model edges. And Spanish nearly saturating the ceiling suggests that for some high-resource languages close to English, the remaining native gap may be mostly a mild mismatch in shared reasoning representations rather than a deeper capability deficit.

Third, the weight-space evidence supports the mechanism. Middle-layer update alignment is substantially stronger than alignment at the edges, which gives Layer Swap a concrete empirical basis. The input-language ablation is also important: the authors identify input understanding as a major bottleneck even after substantial native CoT supervision. While the excerpt does not include every table value, this point is prominent enough in the paper to count as a central result rather than a side observation.

In terms of scale, the setup uses an 8B base model, around 500k examples per language, roughly 10B SFT tokens per language, and up to 32k context length. That is large enough to move the discussion beyond small native-tuning studies.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick pass, focus on three things. First, read the introduction and Figure 2 to pin down the actual claim: the paper does not say native reasoning is free, it says the gap becomes small under matched supervision. Second, read the data construction section carefully, especially why long-CoT translation had to be done component-wise and chunkwise, and how they filtered samples with dropped reasoning traces. The credibility of the whole comparison depends on this pipeline. Third, read the weight-space analysis and Layer Swap section with the mechanism in mind. The key question is not just how much performance improves, but why middle layers appear transferable across languages.

If time is limited to 20–30 minutes, a good order is: Introduction, Figures 1 and 2, data construction, Layer Swap method, then the main result tables. If you have more time, prioritize the update-alignment analysis and the input-language ablation, since those are what make the paper explanatory rather than merely empirical. The most interesting follow-up questions are: why Chinese benefits much less than French, German, or Spanish; whether chunkwise translation lowers the achievable ceiling for native specialists by hurting long-range coherence; and whether Layer Swap only works for closely related specialists sharing the same base and training trajectory, or whether it can generalize to more heterogeneous model recomposition.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会改一点 prior：多语推理差距没想象中大，先看 layer-swap 结果，再决定要不要重做 multilingual reasoning SFT 配比。
recommendation.en: This slightly changes the prior: the multilingual reasoning gap may be much smaller than assumed; read the layer-swap analysis before redesigning multilingual reasoning SFT.

paper.title: What Makes Chain-of-Thought Work at Probe Time? Local Co-occurrence Rather Than Global Derivation
paper.abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting reliably improves language-model accuracy, but which properties of a rationale text drive the improvement is poorly understood. Prior work has largely studied generation-time behavior. We instead ask a probe-time question: given a fixed rationale in context, what in that text changes the answer? We identify two complementary sources of the gain. First, even a globally word-shuffled rationale substantially outperforms the no-rationale baseline, indicating a strong

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的不是“模型如何生成 CoT”，而是“当一段 rationale 已经放进上下文后，模型究竟利用了其中什么信息来改进答案预测”。作者要拆开的核心问题是：CoT 的 probe-time 增益，到底主要来自可读的全局推导结构，还是来自更局部的统计线索。全文给出的结论很明确：收益可以分成两部分，一部分是词汇层面的 lexical activation，只要把与题目和答案相关的词放进去，哪怕全局打乱，性能也会明显高于无 rationale；另一部分来自极短程的 local co-occurrence，保留 2–3 token 的连续窗口，往往就能恢复大部分从“词袋”到“完整 CoT”的额外收益。换句话说，probe model 在读取 rationale 时，并不总是依赖句级甚至步级的逻辑顺序。
summary.importance: 对预训练和推理研究的启发主要有三点。第一，它提醒人们不要把 CoT 增益直接等同于“显式逐步推理被模型执行了”。至少在 probe-time 这一侧，局部模式匹配和短程共现可能占了比预想更大的比重。第二，这个结果会影响对 reasoning data、scratchpad、rationale distillation 的理解：如果很多收益来自局部统计结构，那么训练时学到的可能不只是可执行推导，也包括一套高密度的提示模板和局部触发器。第三，它对机制分析和评测设计有直接意义。若 benchmark 只看加不加 CoT 的最终准确率，很容易把“利用 rationale 中的局部线索”误判成“完成了全局推理”。这篇工作不是预训练 recipe 论文，但它对理解语言模型在上下文中如何消费 reasoning text 很有价值，尤其适合作为 CoT 机理研究的反例材料。
summary.technical_approach:
方法设计相当干净。作者采用 generator–probe 框架：先由一个 generator 生成完整 CoT，再把这段 rationale 作为 assistant response 注入 probe model 的上下文，让 probe 只负责读入这段文本并输出最终答案。这样可以把“生成 rationale 的能力”和“利用 rationale 的能力”分开。为了避免最直接的答案泄漏，作者会自动删除显式 answer declaration 句子，再做扰动。

核心实验是一组逐级破坏结构的 perturbation。Sentence Shuffle 保留句内内容但打乱句序，用来测试句级推导顺序是否关键；Word Shuffle 把所有词全局打乱，只保留 token inventory，用来测 lexical activation；更关键的是 n-gram shuffle：把 rationale 切成长度为 n 的连续 token 窗口，窗口内部顺序保留、窗口之间随机打乱。n=1 相当于词袋，n 增大则逐步恢复局部结构。作者观察恢复曲线，寻找最小的 n*，即恢复大部分额外收益所需的最短局部窗口。

为了排除替代解释，全文还做了几类控制。其一，排除 explicit answer copying：删除答案声明句，并检查收益是否仍在。其二，排除 option anchors：不是简单因为 rationale 中重复了选项词。其三，排除 generic reference text：不是任意相关文本都能带来同样收益。其四，测试 question-text perturbation，说明“2–3 token 足够”的现象更像是 CoT rationale 的特殊性质，而不是模型对任意输入都只看极短局部窗口。作者还在多个 generator/probe 组合、不同模型家族、不同参数规模和多个数据集上验证了模式稳定性。
summary.experiments:
文中最有代表性的例子来自 Config D：Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 生成 rationale，Qwen2.5-14B 作为 probe。这个配置里 CoT 相对 input-output baseline 的增益最明显，因此更容易看清扰动效应。引言给出的示例数字很说明问题：IO 为 50.9%，完整 CoT 为 83.9%；Sentence Shuffle 仍有 83.1%，几乎不掉，说明句级顺序贡献很小；Word Shuffle 还有 66.5%，说明仅词汇集合就带来很大提升；当只保留 2-token 连续窗口时，准确率到 76.5%，已经恢复了从词袋到完整 CoT 之间的大部分差距。

实验设置上，每个条件汇总 3 个随机种子、每个 seed 500 个样本，总计 n=1500，并用双侧 McNemar 检验做显著性分析。全文强调，这种 n-gram 恢复曲线在多个模型家族、开闭源配置和不同 benchmark 上都保持定性一致，最小恢复窗口通常在 2–3 token 左右。控制实验显示，这个现象不能主要由答案复制、选项锚点或一般性的词汇重叠解释。另一个重要观察是，对问题文本做类似扰动时，并不会出现同样强的“小窗口即可恢复”现象，说明 CoT 文本确实携带一种特殊的局部可利用结构。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，但建议把方法和主实验看仔细。优先看 Introduction 里的 Table 1 和作者对三种 shuffle 条件的解释，这里已经把主要发现讲清楚。然后看 Experimental Setup，重点理解 generator–probe 设计为何能隔离 probe-time 效应，以及作者如何去掉显式答案泄漏。接着看 n-gram perturbation 的主结果图，关注恢复曲线而不是单点数值：关键不是 n=2 恰好多少分，而是收益如何从 word bag 快速逼近 full CoT。最后看控制实验部分，尤其是 answer copying、option anchors、generic text 和 question perturbation，这些决定了结论是否站得住。

如果阅读时间有限，30–40 分钟足够抓住主线。若想深挖，值得继续想两个问题：一是这种局部共现效应在更强 reasoning model 上是否会减弱；二是它与预训练阶段学到的短程统计偏好、attention 局部性、以及 instruction tuning 中 rationale 模板化之间是什么关系。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a neglected side of chain-of-thought: not how a model generates a rationale, but how a model uses a rationale once that text is already placed in context. The central question is whether probe-time CoT gains come from reconstructing a coherent global derivation, or from much more local textual cues. The main finding is that the gain decomposes into two parts. One is lexical activation: even a globally shuffled rationale, which preserves only the token inventory, still improves accuracy substantially over the no-rationale baseline. The other is short-range local co-occurrence: preserving contiguous windows of only 2–3 tokens recovers most of the remaining gap between a word bag and the full rationale. In many settings, sentence-level ordering contributes surprisingly little.
summary_en.importance: This matters because it changes how CoT improvements should be interpreted. A gain from adding rationale text does not automatically mean the model is executing a faithful step-by-step derivation at inference time. Part of the benefit may come from local statistical structure that acts as a strong cue for answer prediction. That has implications for reasoning-data design, rationale distillation, and mechanistic analysis. If much of the benefit is carried by local patterns, then some of what models learn from reasoning traces may be reusable prompt structure rather than executable reasoning alone. It also matters for evaluation: benchmark gains from CoT prompting can overstate genuine compositional reasoning if the model is exploiting local rationale cues. The paper is not a pretraining recipe paper, but it is useful for anyone trying to understand how language models consume reasoning text in context.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The experimental design is clean and well targeted. The authors use a generator–probe setup. A generator model first produces a full chain-of-thought rationale. That rationale is then injected into the context of a separate probe model as an assistant response, and the probe predicts the final answer. This separates rationale generation from rationale consumption. To avoid trivial leakage, explicit answer-declaration sentences are automatically removed before any perturbation is applied.

The core method is a hierarchy of structure-destroying perturbations. Sentence Shuffle preserves each sentence but randomizes sentence order, testing whether sentence-level derivation order matters. Word Shuffle destroys all compositional structure and preserves only the token inventory, isolating lexical activation. The key intervention is n-gram shuffle: the rationale is segmented into contiguous token windows of size n, token order is preserved within each window, and the windows are randomly permuted. n=1 is effectively a bag of words; larger n gradually restores local structure. The recovery curve as n increases reveals how much useful probe-time signal is carried by short local neighborhoods.

The paper also runs several controls to rule out simpler explanations. These include explicit answer copying, option-anchor effects, generic reference text, and the possibility that any input text would show the same small-window recovery. A question-text perturbation control is especially important: the same phenomenon does not appear as strongly when perturbing the question itself, suggesting that CoT-style rationale text has a distinctive local structure that the model can exploit. The qualitative pattern is tested across multiple datasets, model families, parameter scales, and both open- and closed-source configurations.
summary_en.experiments:
The most illustrative setup is Config D, where Qwen3.5-35B-A3B generates rationales and Qwen2.5-14B serves as the probe. This pairing yields a large observable CoT gain, making perturbation effects easier to measure. The headline numbers from the motivating example are already informative: input-output prompting gives 50.9% accuracy, full CoT reaches 83.9%, Sentence Shuffle remains at 83.1%, Word Shuffle still achieves 66.5%, and preserving only 2-token windows recovers performance to 76.5%. That means most of the gain beyond a word bag can be recovered with extremely short local spans.

Each condition pools three random seeds with 500 examples per seed, for n=1500 total, and significance is tested with two-sided McNemar tests. The paper reports that the same qualitative n-gram recovery pattern holds across multiple generator–probe configurations, model families, scales, and datasets, with the effective recovery window typically around 2–3 tokens. The control experiments show that the effect is not primarily explained by answer leakage, option repetition, or generic lexical overlap. Another useful result is that perturbing question text does not show the same strong small-window recovery, which supports the claim that the phenomenon is specific to rationale text rather than a generic property of LM input processing.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim-level read, focus on the introduction, the main perturbation setup, and the control experiments. Start with the motivating table in the introduction: it already captures the paper’s core claim. Then read the experimental setup carefully to understand why the generator–probe split isolates probe-time behavior and how explicit answer leakage is removed. After that, inspect the main n-gram recovery results. The important object is the shape of the recovery curve, not any single score. Finally, read the controls on answer copying, option anchors, generic text, and question perturbations; these are what make the interpretation credible.

A 30–40 minute read is enough to extract the main contribution. If reading more deeply, two follow-up questions are worth keeping in mind: whether stronger reasoning-tuned models rely less on these local cues, and how this probe-time locality relates to pretraining-induced short-range statistics, attention locality, and the templated nature of rationale data in instruction tuning.

recommendation.zh: 反常识的CoT机制结论，实验设计干净，重点看§3的控制变量实验和核心结果表即可
recommendation.en: Counterintuitive CoT mechanism findings with clean controlled experiment design, focus on §3 and core result tables only

paper.title: Beyond a Single Direction: Chain-of-Thought Disrupts Simple Steering of Refusal
paper.abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) generate chain-of-thought (CoT) traces before producing final outputs, introducing a dynamic internal state that may complicate control mechanisms such as refusal. Unlike instruction-tuned LLMs, where refusal is mediated by a single directional subspace, refusal in large reasoning models (LRMs) additionally depends on the CoT. In DeepSeek-R1-Distill-LLaMA-8B, activation steering reverses refusal in only 39% of cases when the CoT is kept fixed, but removing the CoT e

summary.core_problem: 在带显式 Chain-of-Thought 的大推理模型（LRM）里，“拒答/谨慎”不再像传统指令模型那样主要由单一残差流方向控制。论文要回答的是：CoT 作为中间生成物是否在机制上参与了拒答状态的维持与重建，从而让常见的 activation steering 失效或效果不稳定。
summary.importance: 这篇更偏机制与安全控制，不是预训练/优化主线。但它对 post-train（尤其是用 R1/o1 风格 CoT 训练出来的模型）有一个很具体的启发：一旦模型把“安全/拒答”写进了可生成的中间轨迹，控制信号就可能变成双通道（残差方向 + CoT 内容），单点 steering 会被 CoT 在生成过程中“反向修复”。对做 RL 对齐的人，这意味着：只在最终输出层面约束可能不够，CoT 生成过程本身会成为新的对齐对象与攻击面。
summary.technical_approach:
方法是 activation steering + 条件化控制 CoT 生成方式来做因果拆解。
- 方向提取：沿用 Arditi 等的 difference-in-means，在 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-LLaMA-8B 的 residual stream 上，用 100 条 harmful（会拒答）与 100 条 harmless（会遵从）指令，分别在模板 token 的末位置（EOI：end-of-instruction；EOT：end-of-think）取各层激活均值差，得到 refusal/compliance direction。
- 干预方式：对 residual stream 做 activation addition（沿方向加/减，系数 α），并设计三种 CoT 条件：固定 CoT（不让其变化）、完全去掉 CoT、允许在 steering 下重新生成 CoT（两阶段：先生成 CoT，再输出答案）。
核心贡献不在新算法，而在实验设计把“CoT 是否会主动重建拒答信号”单独拎出来测。
summary.experiments:
在 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-LLaMA-8B 上，用 100 条 JAILBREAKBENCH harmful 指令（基线 0% compliance）评测：
- 仅做 steering 且固定 CoT：拒答反转（compliance）约 39%（EOI）到 43%（EOT），并随层数变化。
- 去掉 CoT 再 steering：compliance 提升到 70%，说明 CoT 生成过程会抵消 steering 的一部分效果。
- 允许在 steering 下重新生成 CoT（两阶段）：compliance 达到 94%。
- 复用“在 steering 下生成的 compliant CoT”，但移除 steering：仍保留 48% 的效果，说明 CoT 本身携带了可迁移的拒答/遵从状态。
这些数字支持“拒答是双信号冗余机制”：残差方向能推，但 CoT 会在生成中把状态拉回去；让 CoT 也跟着变，效果才稳定。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（20–30 分钟）：
1) 实验设置与三种 CoT 条件的定义：固定/抑制/再生成，决定了因果结论是否成立。
2) Table 1 与 Figure 1：看不同层、不同模板位置（EOI/EOT）的敏感性，判断“方向”是否稳定。
3) Appendix 里关于拒答判定指标：他们指出短语启发式在 LRM 上不可靠，这会影响结果可信度。

如果你的兴趣是训练而非安全机制，可以只抓一个点：CoT 作为可生成中间变量，会把对齐信号从“输出”扩展到“过程”，这会反过来影响 RL/蒸馏时该约束什么、记录什么。

summary_en.core_problem: In large reasoning models that explicitly generate chain-of-thought (CoT), refusal behavior may no longer be controlled by a single residual-stream direction (as shown for instruction-tuned LLMs). The paper asks whether CoT generation actively mediates and reconstructs the refusal state, thereby weakening standard activation-steering interventions.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily mechanistic/safety work rather than pretraining. The actionable takeaway for post-training of R1/o1-style models is that alignment/refusal can become a dual-channel mechanism: (1) a residual-stream “refusal direction” and (2) the generated CoT itself. If CoT can rebuild refusal during generation, then output-only control (or single-point steering) may be brittle; the reasoning trace becomes both a control target and an attack surface. That has implications for RL-style alignment objectives and for whether to supervise/regularize intermediate traces.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The contribution is an intervention design that isolates the causal role of CoT.
- Direction extraction: difference-in-means (Arditi et al.) on residual-stream activations of DeepSeek-R1-Distill-LLaMA-8B, using 100 refused harmful vs 100 complied harmless prompts. Activations are taken at template token endpoints (EOI: end-of-instruction; EOT: end-of-think) across layers to define a refusal/compliance direction.
- Steering: activation addition along the extracted direction with magnitude α.
- CoT conditions: (i) keep CoT fixed, (ii) suppress/remove CoT, (iii) regenerate CoT under steering in a two-stage setup (generate CoT, then final answer).
The method is standard steering; the novelty is treating CoT as an active mediator and testing it with controlled generation protocols.
summary_en.experiments:
On DeepSeek-R1-Distill-LLaMA-8B with 100 harmful JAILBREAKBENCH prompts (0% baseline compliance under greedy decoding):
- Steering with fixed CoT reverses refusal only ~39% (EOI) to ~43% (EOT), varying by layer.
- Removing CoT increases compliance to ~70%, suggesting CoT generation counteracts steering by reconstructing refusal.
- Regenerating CoT under steering yields ~94% compliance.
- Reusing a previously steered “compliant CoT” without steering still preserves ~48% of the effect, indicating CoT content carries an independent, transferable compliance signal.
Overall, results support a redundant/parallel mechanism: residual direction + CoT dynamics jointly determine refusal.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (20–30 min):
1) The exact definitions of the three CoT conditions (fixed vs suppressed vs regenerated); the causal claim hinges on these controls.
2) The main result table and the layer-wise plots (EOI vs EOT): they show how stable the direction is and where steering matters.
3) The appendix discussion on refusal measurement: they argue phrase heuristics fail for LRMs, which is important for interpreting compliance rates.

If your focus is training rather than safety, extract one implication: once CoT is trained as a first-class generated object, alignment constraints may need to target the generation process, not just the final answer.

recommendation.zh: 研究CoT机制、模型可控性与对齐的研究员需重点看§3的对照实验，修正了对推理模型拒绝控制路径的 prior 认知。
recommendation.en: Researchers studying CoT, controllability and alignment should prioritize §3 controlled experiments, which revise prior beliefs about refusal control pathways in reasoning models.

paper.title: Reasoning, Code, or Both? How Large Language Models Handle Variations in Math Questions
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve impressive accuracy on mathematical reasoning benchmarks, yet their performance drops when problems are modified with simple changes like different names or numbers. Code execution methods, which let models generate and run Python code instead of reasoning in natural language, have been proposed as a solution, but their effect on reasoning robustness (the ability to maintain accuracy across problem variations) has not been systematically tested. This study ev

summary.core_problem: 代码辅助的数学推理方法的鲁棒性未被系统验证，现有研究不清楚不同推理范式（纯推理、单步代码、迭代代码）在问题扰动下的表现差异。
summary.importance: 原理分析类工作，首次系统对比三种主流数学推理方法在问题扰动下的鲁棒性，修正了代码方法更鲁棒的默认认知。
summary.technical_approach: 构建GSM-Symbolic的配对扰动数据集（仅修改名字/数字，保持问题逻辑不变），测试CoT、PAL（单步代码）、SBSC（迭代代码）三种方法的准确率变化。
summary.experiments: 用Claude Haiku 4.5测试1000个配对问题，CoT准确率仅下降1.3个百分点，1.8%的问题失效；PAL鲁棒性最差，准确率下降幅度更大。

summary_en.core_problem: The robustness of code-aided mathematical reasoning methods has not been systematically tested, and existing research does not know the performance difference of different reasoning paradigms (pure reasoning, single-step code, iterative code) under problem perturbations.
summary_en.importance: Mechanism analysis work, first systematically compares the robustness of three mainstream mathematical reasoning methods under problem perturbations, corrects the default perception that code methods are more robust.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs paired perturbation datasets of GSM-Symbolic (only modify names/numbers, keep problem logic unchanged), tests accuracy changes of three methods: CoT, PAL (single-step code), SBSC (iterative code).
summary_en.experiments: Tests 1000 paired problems with Claude Haiku 4.5; CoT accuracy drops by only 1.3 percentage points, 1.8% of problems fail; PAL has the worst robustness with larger accuracy drop.

recommendation.zh: 代码辅助推理鲁棒性的对比实验，仅需记住CoT抗扰动能力优于PAL、SBSC的结论即可，无需读全文。
recommendation.en: Comparative experiment on code-aided reasoning robustness; only note that CoT outperforms PAL and SBSC on perturbation resistance, no need to read full text.

paper.title: MuCRASP: Multimodal Chain-of-thought Reasoning aware Structured Pruning
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly rely on chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning to solve complex multimodal tasks, but their large parameter sizes make deployment expensive. Structured pruning offers a natural solution; however, existing methods fail to preserve CoT reasoning accuracy in VLMs. We identify two key reasons: (1) CoT consistency depends on sparse transition points (pivot tokens) in the generation trajectory, while existing pruning methods are CoT-agnostic; and (2) pruning method

summary.core_problem: 解决 VLM 结构化剪枝后多模态 CoT 推理能力下降的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态模型压缩方法。它关注推理部署成本，并把 CoT 轨迹中的关键 token 与跨模态激活差异纳入剪枝准则；对基座预训练启发有限，但对评估压缩是否破坏 reasoning path 有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MuCRASP，Multimodal Chain-of-thought Reasoning aware Structured Pruning。方法识别生成轨迹中的 sparse transition points，即 pivot tokens，认为这些位置对 CoT 一致性重要；同时建模视觉和文本模态的 activation distribution 差异，在全局参数预算下结合跨模态对齐与层敏感性来决定剪枝结构。
summary.experiments: 在四个 VLM 和三个 reasoning benchmarks 上评估。摘要称 MuCRASP 在不同剪枝强度下更好保留推理质量，但未给出具体模型名称、参数规模、剪枝比例和数值提升。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Indian Institute of Technology (IIT), Kharagpur。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses degradation of multimodal CoT reasoning after structured pruning of VLMs.
summary_en.importance: This is a multimodal model-compression contribution. It focuses on deployment cost and asks whether pruning preserves reasoning trajectories and cross-modal alignment; its value for base pretraining is indirect.
summary_en.technical_approach: MuCRASP identifies sparse transition points, or pivot tokens, in the generation trajectory that are important for CoT consistency. It also accounts for different activation distributions across visual and textual modalities, combining cross-modal alignment and layer-wise sensitivity under a global parameter budget.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on four VLMs across three reasoning benchmarks. The abstract claims better preservation of reasoning quality under increasing compression, but does not provide model names, parameter sizes, pruning ratios, or numerical margins.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed institution is Indian Institute of Technology (IIT), Kharagpur.

recommendation.zh: 压缩论文里较少显式看 CoT 断点；可记住 pivot-token 诊断，不必细读剪枝算法。
recommendation.en: Compression papers rarely inspect CoT breakpoints explicitly; keep the pivot-token diagnostic, but the pruning algorithm can be skimmed.

paper.title: ProSR: Process-Shaped Spatial Reasoning for Reliable Chain-of-Thought in VLMs
paper.abstract: Reliable spatial reasoning remains a core bottleneck for vision-language models (VLMs). Existing mainstream training paradigms for spatial reasoning largely rely on outcome alignment or process imitation, lacking explicit constraints on the reasoning process, and therefore struggle to ensure genuine visual dependence and stable reasoning trajectories. In this paper, we construct a high-quality CoT dataset covering diverse spatial phenomena and diagnose the model's reasoning process, revealing tw

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作关注 VLM 空间推理中的一个老问题：模型即使答对，也不一定真的看图推理，更不一定有稳定的推理过程。作者把问题进一步拆成两个可诊断的过程缺陷。其一是 Spurious Grounding，模型在去掉图像后仍能给出相似 CoT，说明它可能主要依赖语言先验和数据偏置。其二是 Tail Instability，推理后段的不确定性反而上升，说明模型在接近答案时轨迹不稳。论文要解决的不是再做一个更大的空间数据集，而是如何把“过程可靠性”直接写进 RL 目标，而不是只优化最终答案正确率。
summary.importance: 对预训练主线来说，这不是核心论文，但有两个启发点。第一，它把 reasoning 训练中的过程退化现象显式量化了，说明只用 outcome reward 做 RL 很容易学到捷径，这和文本推理、工具使用、甚至代码推理中的 reward hacking 是同类问题。第二，它提出的约束方式不是监督 CoT 文本本身，而是约束推理过程中的不确定性轨迹与反事实行为，这比单纯 imitation 更接近“训练动力学约束”。如果以后把类似思想迁移到纯文本 LM 或多模态统一模型的 post-train，可能会比直接奖励长 CoT 更稳。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分两段。先做数据和诊断，再做过程塑形 RL。作者先构建了一个覆盖多类空间现象的 CoT 数据集，用它对模型做 SFT，得到具备初始空间 CoT 能力的 VLM。然后在这个基础上用 vanilla GRPO 做 RL，并系统分析 rollout 行为，发现仅靠最终答案奖励会诱发两类退化：Spurious Grounding 和 Tail Instability。

围绕这两个问题，ProSR 在 GRPO 目标里加入两个过程约束。第一个是 Counterfactual Invariance Penalty，用来抑制伪视觉依赖。具体做法是在 rollout 时额外引入 blank-image 条件，比较真实图像与空白图像条件下的 normalized entropy trajectory。如果两种条件下的不确定性轨迹过于相似，就施加惩罚。直觉上，真正依赖视觉证据的推理过程，在去掉图像后应当明显改变；如果几乎不变，说明模型没有认真用视觉输入。

第二个是 Tail Drift Penalty，用来抑制推理后段的不稳定。作者观察到合理的推理过程中，不确定性应当随着证据积累逐步收敛；若在后半段再次抬升，往往意味着模型在临近答案时发生摇摆、补编理由或切换策略。因此他们对 reasoning tail 的异常熵上升施加惩罚，鼓励轨迹在接近答案时稳定收束。

这个方法和常见 process supervision 的区别在于，它不直接要求模型模仿某条标准 CoT，而是把“是否看图”和“是否稳定收敛”变成可优化的行为约束。这样做的好处是，约束的是过程性质，而不是某种固定表述模板，理论上更有利于泛化。
summary.experiments:
作者在多个复杂和 OOD 空间推理 benchmark 上评测，报告平均准确率比已有方法提升 3.7%。除了答案准确率，论文还专门设计了四个诊断指标来测过程质量：Blank-image Accuracy、Same-Answer Rate、Normalized Trajectory Similarity、Late-Rise Rate。前几项主要测 Spurious Grounding，最后一项主要测 Tail Instability。

实验结论有两层。第一，ProSR 在常规 benchmark 上确实提升了最终任务表现，说明过程约束没有和答案正确率冲突。第二，更关键的是诊断指标同步改善：blank-image 条件下的异常可答性下降，真实图像与空白图像下的轨迹相似度降低，后段不确定性异常上升的比例也下降。这说明模型不是单纯学会了另一种表面模式，而是在更大程度上依赖视觉证据，并且推理轨迹更稳定。

从论文叙述看，作者还做了 vanilla GRPO 与 ProSR 的对比，以及两个 penalty 的消融。预期结论是两个约束各自对应不同退化模式，联合使用效果最好。给出的全文片段没有展开模型规模、训练步数、数据量和每个 benchmark 的逐项数字，因此无法在这里复述更细的表格，但实验设计本身是完整的：先证明问题存在，再证明约束能定向修复问题。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看引言里的问题定义和 Fig.1，确认作者发现的两类退化是否有说服力。然后直接看方法部分关于两个 penalty 的公式和实现，重点理解为什么用 entropy trajectory，而不是直接比较 token 或 CoT 文本。这个选择决定了方法是否只是另一个 process reward engineering。

接着看诊断指标定义和主实验表。若时间有限，优先看 blank-image 相关指标和 late-rise 指标，因为这两组最能说明方法到底有没有改变推理机制。最后看消融，判断 Counterfactual Invariance Penalty 与 Tail Drift Penalty 是否各自解决了对应问题，还是只是共同提供了正则化。

预计 30 到 45 分钟可以完成有效阅读。更值得带着问题去看的点有两个：一是 blank-image 反事实是否会误伤某些强语言先验任务；二是 entropy trajectory 作为过程代理变量是否足够稳健，是否会被解码策略或温度设置影响。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a familiar weakness in VLM spatial reasoning: a model can produce the correct answer without genuinely grounding its reasoning in the image, and even when it does reason, the trajectory may be unstable. The authors make this concrete with two diagnosed failure modes. Spurious Grounding means the model produces similar CoT behavior even when the image is removed, suggesting reliance on language priors or dataset bias. Tail Instability means uncertainty rises again late in the reasoning chain, indicating unstable convergence near answer generation. The goal is therefore not just better spatial accuracy, but process-level reliability under RL training.
summary_en.importance: This is not a core pretraining paper, but it is relevant to anyone thinking about reasoning optimization. The main lesson is that answer-only RL objectives can induce shortcut behavior even when benchmark accuracy improves. That is directly related to reward hacking in text reasoning, tool use, and code generation. A second useful idea is methodological: instead of supervising a canonical CoT string, the paper constrains process properties through uncertainty trajectories and counterfactual behavior. That is closer to shaping training dynamics than to plain imitation, and the idea could plausibly transfer beyond spatial VLMs.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has two stages: diagnosis and process-shaped RL.

First, the authors build a spatial CoT dataset covering diverse spatial phenomena and use it for SFT, producing a VLM with initial chain-of-thought capability. They then continue training with vanilla GRPO using only final-answer correctness and analyze rollout behavior. This reveals two systematic degradations: Spurious Grounding and Tail Instability.

ProSR adds two penalties to the GRPO objective. The first is the Counterfactual Invariance Penalty. During rollout, the model is evaluated not only on the real image but also on a blank-image condition. The method compares the normalized entropy trajectories under the two conditions and penalizes excessive similarity. The intuition is simple: if the reasoning process truly depends on visual evidence, removing the image should materially change the uncertainty profile. If the trajectories remain too similar, the model is likely exploiting non-visual shortcuts.

The second is the Tail Drift Penalty. The authors observe that a healthy reasoning trajectory should gradually become more certain as evidence accumulates. When uncertainty rises again in the later part of the chain, it often signals instability, hesitation, or post-hoc rationalization near the answer. The penalty discourages this late-stage entropy increase and pushes the trajectory toward smoother convergence.

What distinguishes ProSR from standard process supervision is that it does not force the model to imitate a specific reference CoT. Instead, it optimizes for two process properties: visual dependence and stable convergence. That makes the method less tied to a fixed reasoning template and potentially more robust under distribution shift.
summary_en.experiments:
The paper reports an average accuracy gain of 3.7% over prior methods on multiple challenging and out-of-distribution spatial reasoning benchmarks. More importantly, it introduces four diagnostic metrics to measure process quality: Blank-image Accuracy, Same-Answer Rate, Normalized Trajectory Similarity, and Late-Rise Rate.

The results support two claims. First, ProSR improves standard task accuracy, so the process penalties do not merely regularize at the expense of final performance. Second, the diagnostic metrics improve in the expected direction: the model becomes less answerable under blank-image conditions, the trajectory similarity between real-image and blank-image settings decreases, and late-stage uncertainty spikes become less frequent. That suggests the model is relying more on visual evidence and reasoning more stably, rather than just learning another superficial pattern.

From the paper structure, there are also comparisons against vanilla GRPO and ablations for the two penalties. The likely takeaway is that each penalty targets a different degradation mode and the combination works best. The provided excerpt does not include all benchmark-level numbers, model sizes, or training-budget details, so the summary here focuses on the experimental logic rather than reproducing every table.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick read, start with the introduction and the figure that visualizes the two failure modes. The paper is only worth attention if those diagnostics are convincing. Then go straight to the method section and inspect the two penalties, especially why entropy trajectories are used instead of token-level CoT matching. That design choice is central.

Next, read the definitions of the diagnostic metrics and the main results table. If time is limited, prioritize the blank-image diagnostics and the late-rise metric, because they most directly test whether the method changes the reasoning mechanism rather than only the answer distribution. Finally, check the ablations to see whether the Counterfactual Invariance Penalty and Tail Drift Penalty each fix their intended issue or merely act as generic regularizers.

A useful reading time budget is 30 to 45 minutes. Two follow-up questions are worth keeping in mind: whether the blank-image counterfactual could over-penalize tasks with strong language priors, and how sensitive entropy-trajectory diagnostics are to decoding settings such as temperature.

recommendation.zh: 可扫数据诊断和两个 penalty；若证据扎实，它会提醒 VLM RL 不应只盯 outcome reward。
recommendation.en: Skim the diagnostics and the two penalties; if the evidence is clean, it argues against optimizing VLM RL on outcome reward alone.

paper.title: Context-CoT: Enhancing Context Learning via High-Quality Reasoning Synthesis
paper.abstract: While LLMs excel at reasoning over prompts using static pretrained knowledge, they struggle significantly with context learning-the ability to dynamically extract, internalize, and apply new knowledge from complex, task-specific contexts. Recent evaluations on the CL-Bench reveal a critical capability gap: frontier models solve only 17.2% of context-dependent tasks on average.

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM 在长上下文中从新给定材料抽取、内化并应用知识的“context learning”能力不足问题。
summary.importance: 这是后训练数据与推理监督方向的工作，价值在于把“上下文学习”从静态知识推理里拆出来，针对性构造高质量 reasoning synthesis 信号；对预训练研究员的意义主要在于观察哪些能力缺口无法靠预训练知识自然补齐。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是 Context-CoT：通过高质量推理链合成，增强模型对上下文中关键信息的定位、整合与调用。按摘要表述，它不是改模型架构，而是通过更干净的 reasoning supervision 改善 context-dependent task 表现。
summary.experiments: 摘要引用 CL-Bench，指出前沿模型在 context-dependent tasks 上平均仅 17.2% 正确率，作为问题动机。未在摘要中给出模型规模、训练数据量、具体 baseline 和提升幅度，因此目前只能判断其重点在数据合成与后训练配方。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses LLMs' weak ability to extract, internalize, and apply new knowledge from provided context, i.e., context learning rather than static-knowledge reasoning.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training/data-supervision paper. Its value is in isolating context learning as a distinct capability gap and injecting cleaner reasoning supervision; for pretraining researchers, it is mainly useful as evidence of what pretraining alone does not reliably solve.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core idea is Context-CoT: synthesize high-quality chains of reasoning to improve how models locate, integrate, and use information from task-specific context. It appears to be a supervision/data method rather than an architectural change.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract cites CL-Bench and reports that frontier models solve only 17.2% of context-dependent tasks on average, motivating the method. It does not provide model sizes, training data scale, baselines, or exact gains in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 更像后训练补丁，不会直接改写 pretrain prior；若你关心“上下文学习≠参数知识”，只看任务定义和数据构造即可。
recommendation.en: This looks like a post-training patch, not a pretraining prior shift; read it only if you care about context learning as distinct from parametric knowledge.

paper.title: Detecting Unfaithful Chain-of-Thought via Circuit-Guided Internal-External Discrepancy
paper.abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning improves the problem-solving ability of large language models (LLMs), but generated reasoning traces may not faithfully reflect the model's actual decision process. Existing CoT unfaithfulness detectors mainly rely on external signals from generated rationales, such as textual plausibility or answer consistency, while overlooking evidence from the model's internal computation. Although recent circuit tracing methods provide a way to obtain model-internal evidence

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理的是 CoT faithfulness 的实例级检测问题：一个模型生成的推理链看起来合理，甚至答案正确，但它是否真的反映了模型内部形成答案的计算过程。已有检测器主要看外部文本信号，例如推理是否自洽、答案是否一致、LLM judge 是否认为合理；这会把“推理质量”和“推理忠实性”混在一起。作者希望引入模型内部计算证据，但完整 circuit tracing 对长 CoT 成本太高，因此问题落在两个约束之间：既要利用内部机制信号，又不能为每条长推理链构建完整电路。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在训练 recipe，而在 CoT 作为训练与评测信号的可靠性。当前推理模型常把 CoT 当作 SFT、RL、过程监督、验证器训练的数据来源。如果 CoT 文本与内部决策过程系统性错位，那么用它训练过程奖励模型或做机制分析会引入噪声。CIE-Scorer 给出一个可操作的方向：不要只判断 CoT 文本是否正确，而是比较外显推理轨迹和内部计算轨迹是否对齐。这个思路对研究 reasoning trace 的可用性、RL 后训练信号质量、以及机制解释工具如何进入模型评测都有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 CIE-Scorer，核心是 internal-external discrepancy。它先对每个推理句子选择信息量较高的 token，而不是对整段 CoT 做完整 circuit tracing。这样可以降低长 CoT 上 attribution graph 的构建成本。随后，作者为每个句子构建局部计算图，把这些 sentence-level circuit graphs 压缩成内部推理 embedding，形成内部计算轨迹。外部轨迹则来自模型对显示出来的推理句子的 hidden representations。为了让两类表示可比较，方法使用一个轻量 adaptor 对齐内部与外部 latent space。最后，作者在相同的建图规则下分别构造 internal graph 和 external graph，用 Fused Gromov-Wasserstein distance 衡量两张图在结构和节点特征上的差异，并把这个距离作为 unfaithfulness score。与只看文本 plausibility 或 answer consistency 的方法相比，它显式使用模型内部计算证据；与完整 circuit tracing 相比，它用 token selection 和句子级图压缩换取可扩展性。
summary.experiments: 实验在 FaithCoT-Bench 的四个数据集上进行，FINE-CoT 是主要实例级 CoT unfaithfulness benchmark。论文比较了代表性外部信号检测器和基于推理文本的 baseline，CIE-Scorer 在四个数据集上取得更好的检测表现。消融重点围绕三个部件：token-selected circuit tracing 是否保留足够内部证据，sentence-level circuit graph 压缩是否优于直接使用浅层 hidden states，以及 FGW 距离是否比普通 embedding distance 更适合比较内部/外部轨迹。可见正文没有给出可核验的绝对 F1/AUC 数字，但实验结论强调，内部计算轨迹与外部文本轨迹的差异提供了外部文本判别器难以捕捉的信号。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20 到 30 分钟。重点看方法部分的三处设计：第一，如何选择 informative tokens，这决定了方法是否真能扩展到长 CoT；第二，sentence-level circuit graph 如何压缩成 internal reasoning embeddings，这决定了内部信号的粒度；第三，为什么使用 Fused Gromov-Wasserstein distance，而不是简单余弦距离或分类器拼接。实验部分建议重点看 ablation 和 failure cases。如果关心 RL reasoning 数据质量，可以把它当作 CoT 可信度过滤器的候选机制，而不是当作完整 interpretability 方案来读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies instance-level detection of unfaithful chain-of-thought reasoning. A generated rationale may be coherent, plausible, and even paired with a correct answer, while still failing to reflect the computation that actually produced the model’s decision. Prior detectors mostly rely on external textual cues such as rationale quality, answer consistency, or LLM-as-judge scores. The missing signal is the model’s internal computation. Full circuit tracing could provide such evidence, but it is too expensive for long CoT traces. The paper targets this gap: use internal mechanistic evidence without constructing full circuits for every reasoning trace.
summary_en.importance: The relevance to pretraining and reasoning-model research is indirect but meaningful. CoT traces are often used as supervision for SFT, process reward models, verifiers, and RL training. If these traces are unfaithful, they can become noisy or misleading training signals. CIE-Scorer offers a concrete way to separate reasoning quality from faithfulness by comparing the displayed reasoning trajectory with an internal computational trajectory. This is useful for studying the quality of reasoning traces, filtering post-training data, and connecting mechanistic interpretability tools with evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: CIE-Scorer is built around internal-external discrepancy. Instead of tracing the full circuit over a long CoT, it first selects informative tokens within each reasoning sentence. It then performs circuit tracing only around those tokens and builds sentence-level computational graphs. These graphs are compressed into internal reasoning embeddings, which form an internal trajectory over the reasoning process. The external trajectory is obtained from hidden representations of the displayed reasoning sentences. A lightweight adaptor aligns the two latent spaces. Under a shared graph construction rule, the method builds an internal graph and an external graph, then computes their Fused Gromov-Wasserstein distance. This distance captures both node-feature mismatch and structural mismatch, and is used as the unfaithfulness score. Compared with text-only detectors, the method explicitly uses model-internal evidence. Compared with full circuit construction, it trades exhaustive tracing for token selection and sentence-level compression.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments are conducted on four datasets from FaithCoT-Bench, with FINE-CoT serving as the main benchmark for instance-level unfaithfulness detection. CIE-Scorer is compared with representative baselines that rely on external rationale signals, and it reports stronger detection performance across the four datasets. The key ablations examine whether token-selected circuit tracing preserves useful internal evidence, whether compressed sentence-level circuit graphs outperform simpler hidden-state features, and whether Fused Gromov-Wasserstein distance is a better discrepancy measure than simpler embedding distances. The visible manuscript content does not expose exact F1 or AUC values, so the main verifiable takeaway is the relative improvement and the usefulness of internal-external mismatch as a signal.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim reading is enough, around 20 to 30 minutes. Focus on three parts of the method: the informative-token selection step, the construction and compression of sentence-level circuit graphs, and the use of Fused Gromov-Wasserstein distance for comparing internal and external trajectories. The ablation section is more important than the headline benchmark table, because it shows whether the internal circuit signal is doing real work. For readers interested in RL reasoning data, the paper is best read as a possible CoT faithfulness filter rather than as a complete mechanistic interpretability framework.

recommendation.zh: 对 CoT 数据过滤有用，但先别信成判官；重点看 internal-external discrepancy 的定义和误报分析。
recommendation.en: Useful for CoT data filtering, not a judge to trust blindly; focus on the discrepancy definition and false-positive analysis.

paper.title: The Illusion of Reasoning: Exposing Evasive Data Contamination in LLMs via Zero-CoT Truncation
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive reasoning abilities across a wide range of tasks, but data contamination undermines the objective evaluation of these capabilities. This problem is further exacerbated by malicious model publishers who use evasive, or indirect, contamination strategies, such as paraphrasing benchmark data to evade existing detection methods and artificially boost leaderboard performance. Current approaches struggle to reliably detect such stealthy contami

summary.core_problem: 现有数据污染检测方法仅依赖文本表面重叠，无法识别对基准数据进行改写、语义重构的规避型污染；同时大模型的思维链（CoT）推理过程会主动掩盖其对基准的记忆行为，进一步提升了黑箱检测的难度。
summary.importance: 为预训练模型效果验证提供了实用的黑箱污染检测工具，可用于评估公开模型的基准数据污染程度，避免训练数据混入改写后的基准数据导致的效果评估失真，对预训练数据清洗、模型能力公允评测有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Zero-CoT Probe（ZCP）黑箱检测方法，核心逻辑为：若模型记忆了某基准（无论是否改写），会建立问题语义到答案的直接映射，无需推理即可输出正确答案；方法首先强制模型截断全部CoT过程、直接输出答案，再对比模型在原始基准和构造的同构扰动参考数据集上的无CoT性能差异，同时提出Contamination Confidence统计指标量化基准级别的污染严重程度，无需访问模型训练数据或参数。
summary.experiments: 对主流闭源、开源大模型的实际污染程度进行了系统性检测，验证了该方法可同时识别直接污染和规避型污染，证实了大模型数据污染现象的广泛存在。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读方法部分对规避型污染的定义、ZCP检测逻辑的推导过程；泛读实验部分的实际模型污染检测结果，总阅读时间约20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing data contamination detection methods only rely on surface text overlap and fail to detect evasive contamination where benchmark data is paraphrased or semantically restructured; meanwhile, LLMs' Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning process actively masks their memorization of benchmarks, further increasing the difficulty of black-box detection.
summary_en.importance: Provides a practical black-box contamination detection tool for pretrained model performance validation, which can be used to assess the benchmark data contamination level of public models, avoid evaluation distortion caused by pretraining data mixed with paraphrased benchmark data, and has direct reference value for pretraining data cleaning and fair model capability evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Zero-CoT Probe (ZCP), a black-box detection method. The core logic is that if a model memorizes a benchmark (regardless of paraphrasing), it builds a direct mapping from question semantics to answers and can output correct answers without reasoning. The method first forces the model to truncate the entire CoT process and output answers directly, then compares the model's zero-CoT performance difference between the original benchmark and the constructed isomorphic perturbed reference dataset. A Contamination Confidence statistical metric is proposed to quantify benchmark-level contamination severity, with no requirement for access to model training data or parameters.
summary_en.experiments: Systematically tested the actual contamination level of mainstream closed-source and open-source LLMs, verified that the method can detect both direct and evasive contamination, and confirmed the widespread existence of LLM data contamination.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the definition of evasive contamination in the method section and the derivation of ZCP detection logic; skim the experimental results on actual model contamination detection, total reading time is about 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会动到你对 reasoning leaderboard 的信任边界：结论未必全对，但“CoT 反而遮住记忆污染”这个点值得立刻拿内部模型做审计复现。
recommendation.en: This paper should change how much you trust reasoning leaderboards: the full claim may not all hold, but the idea that CoT can hide memorization is worth auditing on your internal models immediately.

paper.title: LatentOmni: Rethinking Omni-Modal Understanding via Unified Audio-Visual Latent Reasoning
paper.abstract: Joint audio-visual reasoning is essential for omnimodal understanding, yet current multimodal large language models (MLLMs) still struggle when reasoning requires fine-grained evidence from both modalities. A central limitation is that explicit text-based chain-of-thought (CoT) compresses continuous audio-visual signals into discrete tokens, weakening temporal grounding and shifting intermediate reasoning toward language priors. We argue that a unified latent space is a better medium for such re

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是音频-视觉联合推理里的一个表示瓶颈：现有多模态模型常把中间推理全部写成文本 CoT，但文本 token 对连续音视频证据的压缩过强，容易丢掉时间对齐、细粒度同步和局部感知线索，导致模型在需要真正依赖原始音视频证据时，转而依赖语言先验。作者要解决的不是一般的多模态理解，而是“推理过程应该用什么表示承载”这个问题：当 reasoning 需要反复回看音频和视频时，纯文本中间态是否已经不够。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的直接相关性有限，因为这是一个 post-training 框架，重点也不在统一 tokenizer 或原生多模态预训练目标上。但它有两个启发点。第一，它把 latent reasoning 明确落到音视频联合推理场景，说明连续隐空间中间态不只是文本推理的附属技巧，而可能是处理高带宽模态证据的一种更自然接口。第二，它提出文本 scaffold + 连续 latent state 交替生成的形式，这和未来统一 AR 语言建模与连续模态推理的方向有连接，尤其适合思考 AR 文本 token 是否应该承担全部中间计算。贡献量级上，更像一个有想法的多模态 post-train 设计，而不是会直接改写 LLM 预训练 recipe 的工作。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是让模型在自回归生成过程中交替输出文本 token 和连续 latent state。给定视觉特征、音频特征和文本问题，模型先按常规方式生成文本推理；当需要回到原始音视频证据做更细粒度整合时，输出一个特殊触发符 <Unified_Latent>，随后不再从离散词表采样，而是在连续空间 R^d 中生成 K 个 latent embedding；再用 </Unified_Latent> 结束这一段，回到文本生成。这样做的意图很明确：文本负责高层逻辑结构，latent 段负责保留和操作高密度感知证据。

为了让 latent state 真正对齐到音视频证据，而不是退化成另一种难解释的内部缓存，作者加了 feature-level supervision。根据全文描述，这部分监督会把 latent reasoning state 与任务相关的音视频片段对齐，鼓励模型在 latent 段持续关注支持当前推理步骤的 frame/segment。另一个关键设计是 Omni-Sync Position Embedding, OSPE。它是在时间对齐的 multimodal RoPE 基础上扩展出来的，目标是让音频 latent 和视觉 latent 在统一时间轴上保持同步，从而更容易建模“看到某动作的同时听到某声音”这类跨模态对应关系。

数据方面，作者认为现有 AV instruction 数据缺少能支撑 feature-level latent supervision 的标注，因此自己构建了 LatentOmni-Instruct-35K。其数据管线会生成 audio-video interleaved reasoning trajectory，不只是给 QA 或文本 rationale，还要给出与推理步骤相关的音视频局部证据。这一点决定了方法能否成立，因为没有局部对齐 supervision，latent 段很容易沦为自由漂移的连续隐藏变量。

从方法定位看，它不是端到端重新训练一个 native omni model，而是在现有 MLLM 上做后训练增强；也不是完全抛弃文本 CoT，而是保留文本作为 reasoning scaffold。这种折中设计比“全 latent 推理”更现实，因为训练和解码接口仍兼容自回归生成。
summary.experiments:
作者在四个 benchmark 上评估，结论是 LatentOmni 全面优于 base model 和 explicit text CoT baseline，并且在所比较的开源模型中结果最好。摘要没有给出具体分数，全文重点强调的是两类收益：一类是整体任务性能提升，另一类是对原始音视频模态的注意力更强，尤其在 AV alignment 类任务上更明显。

从实验结构看，最值得关注的不是主表排名，而是几组设计验证。第一，显式文本 CoT 与 interleaved text-latent reasoning 的对比，用来证明收益来自 latent 中间态，而不是单纯多了训练数据。第二，OSPE 的消融，验证时间同步位置编码是否真在帮助跨模态对齐。第三，latent length K 的分析，这会影响连续推理容量与训练/解码成本之间的平衡。第四，feature-level supervision 的作用，如果去掉这项监督后性能明显回落，才能说明 latent 段确实学到了 grounded reasoning，而不是只是在模型里增加了额外自由度。

数据规模方面，文中明确给出训练集为 LatentOmni-Instruct-35K。这个规模不算大，因此结果更应理解为“后训练阶段的表示设计有效”，而不是“大规模数据足以支撑新范式”。如果要评估它对基座训练的意义，需要进一步看这种 latent reasoning 是否能在更大规模、更多任务上稳定扩展。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看 Introduction 里对 text CoT 瓶颈的论证，判断这个问题设定是否成立。然后直接看方法图和 hybrid sequence 定义，弄清楚 <Unified_Latent> 触发后模型到底生成什么、如何回到文本空间。接着看 feature-level supervision 和 OSPE 两节，这是方法真正有信息量的部分。实验里优先看 explicit text CoT baseline 对比、OSPE 消融、latent length K 分析，以及 attention/grounding 可视化。如果这些证据不扎实，主表分数意义会弱很多。

预计阅读时间 20 分钟左右。若关注与统一多模态预训练的连接，可以额外思考：这种连续 latent 中间态未来是作为 post-train patch，还是可以前移到 pretrain 阶段，成为原生建模接口的一部分。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a representation bottleneck in audio-visual reasoning. Most multimodal models externalize intermediate reasoning as text chain-of-thought, but text tokens are a poor carrier for dense continuous evidence from audio and video. They compress away temporal alignment, synchronization cues, and fine-grained sensory details, which pushes the model toward language priors instead of grounded multimodal evidence. The central question here is not generic multimodal understanding, but what medium should carry intermediate reasoning when the model must repeatedly revisit raw audio-visual signals.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance to core pretraining is limited because the work is framed as post-training rather than a native multimodal pretraining objective. Still, it offers two useful ideas. First, it treats latent reasoning as a serious interface for high-bandwidth modalities, not just as a text-side reasoning trick. Second, it proposes an autoregressive format that interleaves textual reasoning with continuous latent states, which is relevant to future unified modeling setups where text should not be forced to carry all intermediate computation. The contribution is better read as a thoughtful multimodal post-training design than as a new foundation-model training recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach:
LatentOmni lets the model alternate between discrete text generation and continuous latent-state generation within a single autoregressive trajectory. Given visual features, audio features, and a textual query, the model first generates text as usual. When it needs to revisit sensory evidence, it emits a special trigger token, <Unified_Latent>, and switches from vocabulary-space decoding to generating K continuous latent embeddings in R^d. It then emits </Unified_Latent> and returns to text generation. The design is deliberate: text remains the scaffold for high-level logical structure, while latent segments are used for evidence-intensive reasoning over dense audio-visual signals.

To keep those latent states grounded rather than turning them into arbitrary hidden vectors, the paper adds feature-level supervision. The latent reasoning states are aligned with task-relevant audio and video segments, encouraging the model to preserve and attend to the supporting sensory evidence during intermediate reasoning. The second key component is Omni-Sync Position Embedding (OSPE), an extension of time-aligned multimodal RoPE that synchronizes audio and visual latent features on a shared temporal axis. This is meant to improve reasoning over cross-modal correspondences such as sound-action alignment.

The data side is important. Existing audio-visual instruction datasets usually provide QA pairs or textual rationales, but not localized evidence for each reasoning step. To support feature-level latent supervision, the authors build LatentOmni-Instruct-35K through an audio-video interleaved reasoning-trajectory pipeline. That dataset design is essential to the method: without localized supervision, the latent segments could easily become unconstrained continuous placeholders.

Methodologically, the paper does not retrain a native omni-modal model from scratch, and it does not discard text CoT entirely. It keeps text for structure and inserts latent reasoning only where dense sensory grounding is needed. That compromise makes the approach more practical than a fully latent reasoning stack while staying compatible with autoregressive generation.
summary_en.experiments:
The paper evaluates on four benchmarks and reports that LatentOmni consistently outperforms both the base model and the explicit text CoT baseline, while also achieving the strongest results among the open-source models included in the comparison. The abstract does not expose the exact scores, so the more useful takeaway from the full paper is the pattern of gains: better task performance overall and stronger attention to the original audio-visual modalities, especially on AV alignment-heavy tasks.

The most informative parts of the experiments are the design validations rather than the headline table. First, the comparison against explicit text CoT tests whether the gain truly comes from latent intermediate states rather than simply more supervision. Second, the OSPE ablation checks whether synchronized positional encoding is actually helping cross-modal temporal alignment. Third, the latent-length K analysis reveals the trade-off between latent reasoning capacity and training/inference cost. Fourth, the feature-level supervision ablation is crucial: if performance drops substantially without it, that supports the claim that the latent states are grounded rather than acting as unconstrained extra capacity.

The training dataset size is explicitly given as LatentOmni-Instruct-35K, which is modest. So the results should be interpreted as evidence that the representation design works in post-training, not as proof that large-scale data has already validated a new paradigm. To judge its significance for foundation-model training, one would want to see whether the same latent reasoning interface scales stably to larger data and broader tasks.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick read, start with the introduction’s argument against pure text CoT in audio-visual reasoning. Then go straight to the method figure and the hybrid sequence definition to understand what exactly is generated after <Unified_Latent> and how the model transitions back to text. After that, focus on the feature-level supervision and OSPE sections; those are the real technical core. In the experiments, prioritize the comparison with explicit text CoT, the OSPE ablation, the latent-length K study, and any grounding or attention visualizations. If those pieces are weak, the headline benchmark gains are less convincing.

A useful skim should take around 20 minutes. If your interest is foundation-model design, the natural follow-up question is whether this latent intermediate interface should remain a post-training patch or move earlier into native multimodal pretraining.

recommendation.zh: 如果你在想‘推理一定要落在文本token上吗’，这篇值得看；先读方法图和 latent supervision 设计，实验强度暂时别高估。
recommendation.en: Read this if you're questioning whether reasoning must live in text tokens; focus on the latent-state design and supervision, but treat the empirical strength as provisional.

paper.title: Reasoning-Trace Collapse: Evaluating the Loss of Explicit Reasoning During Fine-Tuning
paper.abstract: Explicit reasoning models are trained to produce intermediate reasoning traces before final answers, but downstream fine-tuning is often performed on ordinary instruction-response data that contains no such traces. We show that this mismatch can induce reasoning-trace collapse: a fine-tuned model continues to produce plausible final answers while losing the structurally valid explicit reasoning traces that made it a reasoning model in the first place. We introduce a structural evaluation framewo

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的是 reasoning model 在后续 SFT 里的一个结构性退化：模型原本会先生成显式推理轨迹，再给最终答案；但如果继续用普通 instruction-response 数据微调，而数据里没有 reasoning trace，模型会逐渐学会直接给答案，显式推理部分变空、缺失或被截断。作者把这个现象定义为 reasoning-trace collapse。它要解决的核心问题不是推理质量高低，也不是 trace 是否 faithful，而是一个更基础的问题：模型是否还保留了“先推理、后作答”的外显行为，以及现有只看最终答案的评测为什么会掩盖这种退化。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接关联不如训练算法类工作强，但对 post-train 如何不破坏已有能力很有启发，尤其是小模型 reasoning adaptation、蒸馏、持续微调这类场景。它的贡献主要在评测层。作者把 answer correctness 和 reasoning-trace validity 明确拆开，提出 valid / empty / missing / truncated 的结构化指标，并引入 reasoning-conditioned pass@1，去区分“模型会推理但推得不好”和“模型已经不再稳定地产生推理”。这个区分很重要，因为很多后训练流程只盯最终任务分数，容易把行为退化误判成能力保留。论文还给出一个实际结论：简单的 loss masking 就能在不少场景下保住 trace 结构，说明问题不一定需要昂贵的 teacher trace augmentation 才能缓解。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是一个结构化评测框架，而不是新的 reasoning 训练算法。作者先定义 reasoning trace 的有效性标准：生成中是否存在完整、非空、格式上可解析的推理段；无效情况再细分为空白、缺失、截断等。然后把这些结构指标和任务表现结合，计算 reasoning-conditioned pass@1，也就是只在存在有效 reasoning trace 的样本子集上看任务成功率。这样可以把两个因素拆开：一是模型在“有 trace 时”是否仍具备推理能力，二是模型“愿不愿意/能不能稳定地产生 trace”。

工程上，作者实现了 ThinkPack，用于统一不同 reasoning model 的 chat template、trace parsing、validation、metric computation 和 loss masking。这个部分的意义在于，不同开源 reasoning model 的 trace 格式差异很大，如果没有统一解析层，很多评测结论会混入 prompt/template 偏差。

缓解策略上，论文比较了标准 SFT、loss masking 和 teacher distillation。这里的 masking 不是生成新的 reasoning 数据，而是在训练时对 reasoning 缺失区域去掉损失，避免模型因为训练目标而被直接奖励“省略推理”。这和蒸馏的取舍很清楚：蒸馏更直接，但需要额外生成高质量 trace；masking 更轻量，适合私有数据或难以增广的场景。
summary.experiments:
实验对象是 4 个开源 reasoning model，覆盖不同训练管线和不同 reasoning 格式；微调数据是标准 instruction-response 数据，不含显式 reasoning trace；评测任务包括新任务科学问答、数学推理和代码生成。论文的主结论是：普通 SFT 会很快压低 valid reasoning trace 比例，但最终答案性能在一段时间内可能仍然看起来还行，因此只看 answer accuracy 会低估退化程度。更关键的是，在若干设置下，conditioned on valid reasoning 的 pass@1 仍然较高，说明模型并不是完全失去推理能力，而是越来越少显式地把推理写出来。这一点把“能力退化”和“行为退化”区分开了。

缓解实验显示，简单 masking 往往能明显保住 valid reasoning 行为，同时维持较强任务表现；teacher distillation 也有效，但成本更高。摘要和正文给出的表述偏趋势性，强调 collapse 发生得快、跨模型存在、且可被轻量方法部分缓解。若从研究角度看，最有价值的不是某个单点分数，而是结构指标与最终答案指标之间出现系统性背离这一现象。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇更适合泛读，重点不在复杂算法，而在评测定义是否扎实。建议先看 Introduction 和方法部分里对 collapse 的定义，确认作者评估的是 trace 的存在性与结构完整性，而不是 trace 质量或真实性。然后看结构指标定义，尤其是 valid / empty / missing / truncated 的判定规则，以及 reasoning-conditioned pass@1 的计算方式。接着看主实验图表，观察标准 SFT 下 valid trace rate 和 answer accuracy 如何分叉变化。最后再看 masking 与 distillation 的对比，判断哪种缓解更适合自己的训练流程。

如果只花 25 分钟，读法可以是：问题定义 → 指标设计 → 主结果图 → mitigation 表。若要复现或接入现有 pipeline，再补看 ThinkPack 的实现假设，特别是不同模型模板和 trace parser 的鲁棒性。阅读时要留意一个边界：这篇工作证明了“显式 trace 行为会消失”，但并不能单独证明内部隐式推理能力是否同步下降，因此不要把它解读成对 reasoning 能力本身的完整判决。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a structural failure mode during downstream fine-tuning of explicit reasoning models. A model may originally generate an explicit reasoning trace before the final answer, but when it is further fine-tuned on ordinary instruction–response data without traces, it can gradually learn to skip the trace and output only the answer. The authors call this reasoning-trace collapse. The central question is not whether the trace is faithful or high quality, but whether the model still preserves the explicit reasoning behavior that distinguishes it as a reasoning model in the first place.
summary_en.importance: Its main value is methodological rather than algorithmic. For post-training and continual adaptation, it highlights that answer-only evaluation can systematically miss behavior loss. The paper separates answer correctness from reasoning-trace validity and introduces structural metrics such as valid, empty, missing, and truncated traces, together with reasoning-conditioned pass@1. That separation matters because it distinguishes two different failures: the model may still reason well when it produces a trace, yet become increasingly unlikely to produce one at all. The mitigation result is also practically useful: simple loss masking can preserve explicit reasoning behavior in many settings without requiring expensive teacher-generated traces.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The core contribution is an evaluation framework, not a new reasoning objective. The authors define structural validity criteria for reasoning traces: whether a generated response contains a complete, non-empty, parseable reasoning segment. Invalid traces are further decomposed into empty, missing, and truncated cases. They then combine these structural outcomes with task performance through reasoning-conditioned pass@1, which measures task success only on examples where a valid reasoning trace is present. This disentangles two factors: whether the model still has useful reasoning ability when it reasons explicitly, and whether it still reliably emits explicit reasoning at all.

To make this usable across models, they build ThinkPack, a lightweight toolkit for model-agnostic prompt construction, trace parsing, validation, metric computation, and loss masking. This matters because open reasoning models differ substantially in templates and trace formats, and evaluation can otherwise be confounded by model-specific parsing assumptions.

For mitigation, the paper compares standard SFT, loss masking, and teacher distillation. The masking strategy is intentionally lightweight: instead of generating new traces, it removes loss from regions where reasoning is absent, so the model is not directly rewarded for omitting the trace. Distillation is more direct but requires additional trace generation and is less convenient for private or specialized data.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments cover four open-weight reasoning models with different training pipelines and reasoning formats. The models are fine-tuned on standard instruction–response data without explicit traces, and evaluated on science QA, mathematical reasoning, and code generation. The main empirical pattern is clear: ordinary SFT can rapidly reduce the rate of valid reasoning traces, while final-answer performance may remain partially intact for some time. This means answer accuracy alone can hide substantial degradation in explicit reasoning behavior.

An especially useful observation is that in several settings, pass@1 conditioned on valid reasoning remains relatively high even as the valid-trace rate drops sharply. That suggests the model has not fully lost reasoning ability; instead, it is increasingly failing to externalize it. On mitigation, simple masking often preserves valid reasoning behavior much better than standard fine-tuning while maintaining strong task performance. Teacher distillation also helps, but at higher cost. The most important result is therefore the systematic divergence between structural reasoning metrics and answer-only metrics.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is best read as an evaluation paper. Start with the problem definition and make sure the target is clear: the paper measures the presence and structural integrity of explicit traces, not their faithfulness or semantic quality. Then read the metric section carefully, especially the definitions of valid, empty, missing, and truncated traces, and the construction of reasoning-conditioned pass@1. After that, inspect the main training curves or tables showing how valid-trace rate and answer accuracy diverge under standard SFT. Finally, read the mitigation comparison between masking and distillation.

If you only have about 25 minutes, read in this order: problem setup → metric design → main empirical results → mitigation section. If you are considering adoption, spend extra time on ThinkPack and the parser assumptions, since robustness across templates is central to whether the framework transfers cleanly. One important boundary to keep in mind: the paper shows that explicit trace behavior can disappear, but it does not by itself establish how much internal latent reasoning ability is lost at the same time.

recommendation.zh: 把“推理能力退化”拆成可测的 trace 结构问题，能直接指导你检查 SFT/RL 是否在悄悄抹掉可控推理格式；只看他们的 validity 分解和 conditional 指标就够。
recommendation.en: Useful if you care about preserving explicit reasoning formats: the validity decomposition + reasoning-conditioned metrics reveal SFT can silently erase trace structure even when answer scores look fine.

paper.title: On the Cost and Benefit of Chain of Thought: A Learning-Theoretic Perspective
paper.abstract: We develop a learning-theoretic framework for understanding Chain of Thought (CoT). We model CoT as the interaction between an answer map and a chain rule that generates intermediate questions autoregressively, and define the reasoning risk of a hypothesis under this interaction. Our first result is a tight canonical decomposition of this risk into two terms with opposing roles: an oracle-trajectory risk (OTR), which captures the benefit of CoT and reduces to a target-domain risk in a domain ada

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文讨论 CoT 为什么有时能降低推理错误、有时又会放大错误。它把 CoT 形式化为“answer map”和“chain rule”的交互：chain rule 自回归地产生中间问题，answer map 回答这些中间问题。核心问题是：在这种交互式推理过程中，模型最终答案的风险如何分解，哪些部分来自 CoT 的收益，哪些部分来自路径偏移带来的代价。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献不是新的训练 recipe，而是给 CoT 的收益和风险提供了一个较清楚的学习理论框架。它对 reasoning data、CoT distillation、process supervision、RL 后训练都有启发：CoT 并不只是“多生成一些中间 token”。如果中间轨迹把测试分布推到模型熟悉的训练分布附近，CoT 会降低 oracle-trajectory risk；如果模型在早期步骤产生偏差，后续 chain rule 会沿着错误轨迹继续滚动，trajectory-mismatch risk 会累积。这个视角有助于解释为什么长 CoT、self-generated CoT、multi-step tool use 在数据质量不足或局部不稳定时会变脆。
summary.technical_approach: 论文定义了一个通用 CoT 框架。真实答案函数是 ground-truth answer map，模型假设是 hypothesis answer map；chain rule 根据当前问题和答案生成下一个问题。对“recoverable”问题，真实 chain rule 轨迹可以恢复最终答案。作者在损失函数满足 quasimetric 条件下，将 reasoning risk 分解为两个项：oracle-trajectory risk，衡量模型在真实轨迹最后一步上的答案误差；trajectory-mismatch risk，衡量模型答案导致 CoT 轨迹偏离真实轨迹后引入的额外误差。OTR 被解释为一个 domain adaptation 风险：真实 CoT 轨迹把测试分布 push-forward 到一个目标分布，如果这个分布接近训练分布，CoT 就有收益。TMR 则刻画 CoT 的代价。作者进一步证明，没有稳定性假设时，只要 loss、hypothesis answer map 或 chain rule 中任一环节不稳定，TMR 可以任意大；在稳定性条件下，可以给出最优上界，并出现有界、线性增长、指数增长三种误差累积区间。
summary.experiments: 这是一篇理论论文，主要结果是风险分解、no-free-lunch 定理和 TMR 上界，而不是大规模实证实验。关键“结果数字”体现在复杂度形态上：TMR 随 CoT 步数可能保持有界、线性增长，或指数增长。这个结论比简单说“CoT 会错误累积”更细，因为它指出增长形态取决于 loss、answer map 和 chain rule 的稳定性常数。论文还把 OTR 与 domain adaptation 中的 target-domain risk 对齐，给出 CoT 有益的条件：推理轨迹诱导出的分布要比原始测试分布更接近训练分布。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 introduction 中的 formal setup，再看 reasoning risk 的分解定理和 TMR 的 no-free-lunch / upper bound 部分。重点不是符号细节，而是三个概念：recoverable points、OTR 作为 CoT 收益、TMR 作为轨迹偏移代价。预计阅读 30–45 分钟。对做 reasoning pretrain 或 posttrain 的读者，值得重点思考两个问题：训练数据是否覆盖了 oracle trajectory 上的中间状态；模型自生成轨迹的局部错误是否会被 chain rule 放大。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why Chain-of-Thought helps in some settings but hurts in others. It models CoT as an interaction between an answer map and a chain rule: the chain rule autoregressively generates intermediate questions, and the answer map answers them. The central question is how to decompose the final reasoning risk into a benefit term from following a useful trajectory and a cost term from deviating from that trajectory.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly conceptual and theoretical, not a new pretraining recipe. It is still relevant to LLM training because it clarifies what CoT supervision, CoT distillation, process supervision, and RL-style reasoning optimization are trying to control. CoT is not just extra generated text. It can help when the induced reasoning trajectory maps hard test inputs into regions closer to the model’s training distribution. It can hurt when early answer errors change the subsequent trajectory and cause error accumulation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework defines a ground-truth answer map, a hypothesis answer map, and a chain rule that maps current question-answer states to the next question. For recoverable inputs, the ground-truth trajectory can recover the final answer. Under a quasimetric loss assumption, the reasoning risk decomposes into two terms. Oracle-trajectory risk measures the hypothesis error when the trajectory is guided by the ground truth up to the final step. Trajectory-mismatch risk measures the extra error caused by the hypothesis driving the chain rule along a different trajectory. The oracle term is connected to domain adaptation: the ground-truth CoT trajectory pushes the test distribution into a target distribution, and CoT helps when that distribution is close to the training distribution. The mismatch term captures the cost of self-generated reasoning. The paper proves that without stability assumptions on the loss, the answer map, and the chain rule, this cost can be arbitrarily large. With stability, it gives an optimal upper bound with bounded, linear, and exponential regimes in the number of CoT steps.
summary_en.experiments: This is a theory paper, so the main evidence is formal rather than empirical. The key results are the canonical risk decomposition, a no-free-lunch statement for mismatch risk, and an optimal upper bound under stability assumptions.
