recommendation.en: Not a shocking claim, but the quantification is actionable—read the forced-answer-completion setup and the “~760 tokens after final switch” stats to guide early-exit and CoT-signal trimming.

paper.title: VG-CoT: Towards Trustworthy Visual Reasoning via Grounded Chain-of-Thought
paper.abstract: The advancement of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) requires precise local region-based reasoning that faithfully grounds the model's logic in actual visual evidence. However, existing datasets face limitations in scalability due to extensive manual annotation and lack of explicit alignment between multi-step reasoning and corresponding image regions, which constrains the evaluation of model trustworthiness. To address these challenges, we propose the Visual Grounding Chain-of-Thought (VG-Co

summary.core_problem: 如何构建一个能够显式对齐多步推理与对应图像区域的数据集，以评估和提升大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）在局部区域推理上的可信度？
summary.importance: 提出了 Visual Grounding Chain-of-Thought (VG-CoT) 数据集和一个全自动的构建 pipeline，解决了现有数据集在可扩展性和推理-区域对齐方面的局限性，并提供了一个新的 benchmark 来全面评估 LVLMs 的推理准确性。
summary.technical_approach: 提出一个全自动的三阶段 pipeline：1) 使用 SOTA 检测和 OCR 模型提取对象和文本级别的视觉证据；2) 使用 GPT-4o 生成逐步的 grounded reasoning；3) 通过 rationale-driven 的开放集检测过程细化 grounding。
summary.experiments: 引入了一个新的 benchmark，用于评估 LVLMs 的推理准确性。具体模型参数量、训练数据规模和 baseline 效果未在摘要中详述。

summary_en.core_problem: How to construct a dataset that explicitly aligns multi-step reasoning with corresponding image regions to evaluate and improve the trustworthiness of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) in local region-based reasoning?
summary_en.importance: Proposes the Visual Grounding Chain-of-Thought (VG-CoT) dataset and a fully automated construction pipeline, addressing the limitations of existing datasets in scalability and reasoning-region alignment, and introduces a new benchmark to comprehensively evaluate LVLM reasoning accuracy.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes a fully automated three-stage pipeline: 1) extracts object- and text-level visual evidence using SOTA detection and OCR models; 2) generates step-by-step grounded reasoning with GPT-4o; 3) refines the grounding through a rationale-driven open-set detection process.
summary_en.experiments: Introduces a new benchmark to evaluate LVLM reasoning accuracy. Specific model parameters, training data scale, and baseline results are not detailed in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 构建了一个多模态 CoT 数据集，将推理步骤与图像区域对齐，对 VLM 的精细化推理和可解释性有一定参考价值，但属于数据构建工作，作为 literature 备查。
recommendation.en: Constructs a multimodal CoT dataset aligning reasoning steps with image regions, offering some reference value for fine-grained reasoning and interpretability of VLMs, but it's primarily a data construction effort; keep as literature reference.

paper.title: Thinking with Reasoning Skills: Fewer Tokens, More Accuracy
paper.abstract: Reasoning LLMs often spend substantial tokens on long intermediate reasoning traces (e.g., chain-of-thought) when solving new problems. We propose to summarize and store reusable reasoning skills distilled from extensive deliberation and trial-and-error exploration, and to retrieve these skills at inference time to guide future reasoning. Unlike the prevailing \emph{reasoning from scratch} paradigm, our approach first recalls relevant skills for each query, helping the model avoid redundant deto

summary.core_problem: 减少推理模型在新问题上从零展开长链式思考的 token 开销，同时尽量提升准确率。
summary.importance: 这是后训练/推理时策略层面的工作，不是预训练范式创新。价值在于把“可复用 reasoning skill”显式缓存并检索，说明部分 CoT 可以被压缩成可迁移的技能单元。
summary.technical_approach: 方法先通过大量 deliberation 和 trial-and-error 提炼出可复用的 reasoning skills，再在推理时为当前 query 检索相关技能，用这些技能引导后续求解，而不是每次都从头生成完整长推理链。整体属于 skill distillation + retrieval-guided reasoning。
summary.experiments: 评测覆盖 coding 和数学推理任务。摘要声称同时减少 reasoning tokens 并提升总体性能，带来更低单次请求成本，但未在摘要中给出模型规模、训练数据量、具体 baseline 和提升幅度。更像 inference-time reasoning policy 优化，而非 clean 的能力提升证明。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to reduce the token cost of reasoning models that otherwise solve each new problem from scratch with long intermediate chains of thought, while maintaining or improving accuracy.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training/inference-strategy paper rather than a pretraining advance. Its main value is the explicit treatment of reusable reasoning skills as retrievable units, suggesting that some CoT can be compressed into transferable skills.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method first distills reusable reasoning skills from extensive deliberation and trial-and-error exploration, then retrieves relevant skills at inference time to guide problem solving instead of generating a full long reasoning trace from scratch every time. Conceptually, it is skill distillation plus retrieval-guided reasoning.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers coding and math reasoning tasks. The abstract claims both fewer reasoning tokens and better overall performance, implying lower per-request cost, but it does not provide model sizes, training data, baselines, or effect sizes. This looks more like an inference-time reasoning policy optimization than a clean demonstration of improved underlying capability.

recommendation.zh: 想看“CoT 能否被压成可检索技能”可以扫一眼；但这更像推理成本工程，先看实验表里 token 降幅和是否有 retrieval leakage。
recommendation.en: Skim it only if you care whether CoT can be compressed into retrievable skills; the key is the token reduction table and whether retrieval leakage contaminates the gains.

paper.title: Hybrid Latent Reasoning with Decoupled Policy Optimization
paper.abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning significantly elevates the complex problem-solving capabilities of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). However, adapting CoT to vision typically discretizes signals to fit LLM inputs, causing early semantic collapse and discarding fine-grained details. While external tools can mitigate this, they introduce a rigid bottleneck, confining reasoning to predefined operations. Although recent latent reasoning paradigms internalize visual states to overcome these

summary.core_problem: 多模态大模型适配视觉CoT时，视觉信号离散化导致语义丢失，现有隐式推理的混合离散连续动作空间难以优化
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出解耦策略优化方法处理混合隐式推理的混合动作空间，避免视觉离散化的语义损失
summary.technical_approach: 提出HyLaR框架，将离散文本生成与连续视觉隐表示无缝交替，冷启动SFT后用DePO解耦策略梯度分别优化离散和连续动作空间
summary.experiments: 未披露具体模型参数量、训练数据规模与完整对比实验结果
summary.authors_note: 无公开知名作者信息，机构未明确披露

summary_en.core_problem: When adapting CoT to vision for MLLMs, visual signal discretization causes semantic loss, and the hybrid discrete-continuous action space in existing latent reasoning paradigms is difficult to optimize
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, proposes decoupled policy optimization to handle hybrid action space for hybrid latent reasoning, avoiding semantic loss from visual discretization
summary_en.technical_approach: Propose HyLaR framework that interleaves discrete text generation with continuous visual latent representations. After cold-start SFT, use DePO to decompose policy gradient and optimize discrete and continuous action spaces separately
summary_en.experiments: No specific model parameter size, training data scale or full comparative experiment results disclosed
summary_en.authors_note: No well-known authors publicly identified, affiliated institutions not explicitly disclosed

recommendation.zh: 多模态后训练的增量改进，仅参考混合动作空间的RL优化思路即可，无需细读全文
recommendation.en: Incremental improvement for multimodal post-training, only refer to the hybrid action space RL optimization idea, no need to read the full text

paper.title: Where Reasoning Breaks: Logic-Aware Path Selection by Controlling Logical Connectives in LLMs Reasoning Chains
paper.abstract: While LLMs demonstrate impressive reasoning capabilities, they remain fragile in multi-step logical deduction, where a single transition error can propagate through the entire reasoning chain, leading to unstable performance. In this work, we identify logical connectives as primary points of this structural fragility. Through empirical analysis, we show that connective tokens function as high entropy forking points, at which models frequently struggle to determine the correct logical direction.

summary.core_problem: 研究 LLM 在多步逻辑推理中为何容易在局部转折处出错，并尝试定位 reasoning chain 中最脆弱的逻辑连接点。
summary.importance: 这属于推理机制与干预研究。价值不在于提出新的基座训练范式，而在于把 reasoning failure 具体落到 logical connectives 这一类 token 上，给后续训练信号设计或过程监督提供更细粒度的切入点。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先做经验分析，认为逻辑连接词是高熵分叉点，模型在这些位置更容易选错推理方向；随后提出多层干预框架，包括基于梯度的 logical steering，将内部表示推向更有效的推理子空间，以及 localized branching control 等局部路径选择机制，专门在逻辑关键节点上施加控制。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出模型规模、任务集、提升幅度和对照基线，只能确认其评估重点是多步逻辑推理稳定性与路径选择正确率。由于缺少 clean setup 细节，当前更适合作为现象假说而非强证据。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why LLMs fail in multi-step logical reasoning and tries to localize the fragile points in reasoning chains to logical connectives.
summary_en.importance: This is a reasoning-mechanism and intervention paper. Its value is not a new foundation-model training paradigm, but a more granular hypothesis: reasoning failures may concentrate at connective tokens, which could inform future process supervision or training-signal design.
summary_en.technical_approach: It first presents an empirical analysis arguing that logical connectives are high-entropy branching points where models often choose the wrong logical direction. It then proposes a multi-layer intervention framework, including gradient-based logical steering toward valid reasoning subspaces and localized branching control at logic-critical junctions.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, task suites, gain magnitudes, or strong baselines. So at this stage it is better treated as a hypothesis-generating paper than a high-confidence empirical result.

recommendation.zh: 把 reasoning failure 归因到 connective token 这个角度有点意思，但证据看起来还薄；只看现象分析部分，别急着接受干预方法的因果解释。
recommendation.en: The connective-token hypothesis is interesting, but the evidence looks thin; read it for the failure analysis, not for a strong causal claim about the intervention.

paper.title: Reasoning-targeted Jailbreak Attacks on Large Reasoning Models via Semantic Triggers and Psychological Framing
paper.abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in generating step-by-step reasoning chains alongside final answers, enabling their deployment in high-stakes domains such as healthcare and education. While prior jailbreak attack studies have focused on the safety of final answers, little attention has been given to the safety of the reasoning process. In this work, we identify a novel problem that injects harmful content into the reasoning steps while preserving unchanged ans

summary.core_problem: 如何攻击并绕过大型推理模型（LRMs）在生成中间推理步骤时的安全对齐机制？
summary.importance: 首次将越狱攻击的焦点从最终答案转移到 LRMs 的中间推理过程，揭示了即使最终答案安全，推理链中也可能被注入有害内容的隐患。
summary.technical_approach: 提出基于心理学的推理目标越狱攻击（PRJA）框架。包含两个模块：1) 基于语义的触发器选择模块，寻找不改变最终答案但能引导模型生成特定内容的触发词；2) 心理学框架模块，利用心理学技巧（如角色扮演、权威暗示）降低模型的安全防御，将有害内容嵌入推理步骤。
summary.experiments: 在多个开源和闭源 LRMs 上进行了测试，证明了 PRJA 能够有效地在推理链中注入有害内容，同时保持最终答案的正确性和表面上的安全性。
summary.authors_note: 来自上海大学等机构的研究团队。

summary_en.core_problem: How to attack and bypass the safety alignment mechanisms of Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) during the generation of intermediate reasoning steps?
summary_en.importance: First to shift the focus of jailbreak attacks from the final answer to the intermediate reasoning process of LRMs, revealing the vulnerability that harmful content can be injected into the reasoning chain even if the final answer is safe.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the Psychology-based Reasoning-targeted Jailbreak Attack (PRJA) framework. It includes two modules: 1) a Semantic-based Trigger Selection module to find triggers that do not change the final answer but guide the model to generate specific content; 2) a Psychological Framing module that uses psychological techniques (e.g., role-playing, authority suggestion) to lower the model's safety defenses and embed harmful content into the reasoning steps.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on multiple open-source and closed-source LRMs, demonstrating that PRJA can effectively inject harmful content into the reasoning chain while maintaining the correctness and superficial safety of the final answer.
summary_en.authors_note: Research team from Shanghai University and other institutions.

recommendation.zh: 针对 CoT 推理过程的越狱攻击，提醒我们在 RLHF/安全对齐时不能只看最终输出，中间 reasoning trace 的安全性同样需要纳入 reward model 的考量。
recommendation.en: Jailbreak attack targeting the CoT reasoning process, reminding us that during RLHF/safety alignment, the safety of intermediate reasoning traces must also be considered by the reward model, not just the final output.

institutions: Shanghai Key Laboratory of Data Science

paper.title: Chain-of-Thought Degrades Visual Spatial Reasoning Capabilities of Multimodal LLMs
paper.abstract: Multimodal Reasoning Models (MRMs) leveraging Chain-of-Thought (CoT) based thinking have revolutionized mathematical and logical problem-solving. However, we show that this paradigm struggles with generalized spatial intelligence. We perform a comprehensive evaluation of seventeen models across thirteen spatial benchmarks and identify a critical gap: CoT prompting consistently degrades performance in visual spatial reasoning. Furthermore, through a novel No-Image++ ablation, we demonstrate that

summary.core_problem: 多模态“推理模型”（通过SFT/RL学会长CoT）在数学/逻辑上常见收益，但在视觉空间推理上是否同样成立并不清楚。论文要回答两个问题：1) CoT提示或推理化后训练是否会系统性降低空间任务表现；2) 模型是否在空间题上依赖文本先验产生“无图也能答”的捷径与幻觉。
summary.importance: 对预训练/后训练研究的启发点很具体：把“长文本推理”当作通用能力注入，可能会牺牲视觉空间任务的可靠性，甚至强化基于语言先验的捷径。它对做RL后训练、数据配比和训练目标的人有现实意义：如果奖励/监督主要鼓励可读的文本推理轨迹，模型可能学到‘用语言编一个看似合理的空间解释’，而不是提升视觉表征上的几何操作能力。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上是系统评测与对照实验。
1) 模型组：17个模型，包含8个多模态推理模型（MRMs）与多种backbone MLM（含不同规模Qwen2.5-VL、InternVL、LLaVA，以及GPT-4o）。多数MRM基于同一Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct蒸馏/后训练，便于做“推理化是否伤害视觉空间”的同源对照。
2) 数据集组：13个空间基准，覆盖2D静态关系、3D几何、以及动态/时序一致性（如BLINK、CV-Bench2D/3D、MMVP、SpatialBench、3DSRBench、MindCube、OmniSpatial等）。
3) 统一评测协议：用VLMEvalKit统一系统提示与多选格式；pass@1 greedy；固定推理长度上限（max new tokens 32768）与上下文长度；3个seed。
4) CoT对照：同一模型在base prompt与CoT prompt（要求<think>…</think>再<answer>…</answer>）下对比，隔离“仅提示词引入CoT”的影响。
5) No-Image++：在不给图（空白图）的情况下加入“Cannot determine”选项，检验模型是否会因为文本先验而继续自信作答，从而量化shortcut learning与视觉幻觉。
summary.experiments:
1) CoT提示整体负效应：在多种MLM上，CoT prompting平均降低约3%准确率。
2) 推理模型不如其backbone：7/8个MRM未能超过其蒸馏来源的backbone，在“泛化空间基准”上出现系统性回退。
3) No-Image++揭示捷径：给空白图且提供“Cannot determine”时，推理模型仍会根据文本先验编造视觉细节并选择错误答案，表现出强幻觉与过度自信。
4) 评测设置细节：使用vLLM在4×A100上批量推理，bfloat16，batch size 16，3 seeds，greedy decoding。
（注：你提供的全文片段未包含各数据集逐项分数表与显著性检验细节；若要更精确的“哪些基准跌得最多/哪些模型例外”，需要补充结果章节表格。）
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议：先抓结论，再看对照设计是否严谨。
1) 先看Introduction与Figure 1/主结果表（若在正文后续）：确认“CoT平均-3%”与“MRM不如backbone”的统计口径。
2) 重点读Methodology里三件事：a) 统一prompt与MCQ格式是否会偏置某些模型；b) CoT prompt的具体模板；c) No-Image++如何构造空白图与“Cannot determine”选项，是否会引入新的分布外因素。
3) 再看分组结果：2D vs 3D/动态任务上负效应是否一致，这决定问题是“几何操作”还是“视觉证据使用”。
预计阅读时间：20-30分钟可把方法与主结论读清；若要复现或用于训练决策，需要把13个基准的细项结果与附录prompt逐条核对。

summary_en.core_problem: Reasoning-style multimodal models (post-trained with SFT/RL to produce long CoT) often help in math/logic, but it is unclear whether the same paradigm transfers to vision-centric spatial intelligence. The paper tests whether (1) CoT prompting and reasoning post-training systematically hurt visual-spatial benchmarks, and (2) models rely on textual priors to hallucinate spatial details even without images.
summary_en.importance: The takeaway for pretraining/post-training is operational: optimizing for verbose, text-first reasoning traces can reduce reliability on spatial tasks and amplify shortcut learning from language priors. This directly impacts RL/SFT objective design and data mixture decisions—rewarding “plausible explanations” may not train the underlying geometric/grounded operators needed for spatial reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach:
A controlled evaluation study.
1) Model suite: 17 models including 8 open-source multimodal reasoning models (MRMs) and multiple backbone MLMs (Qwen2.5-VL at 3B/7B/72B, InternVL variants, LLaVA variants, plus GPT-4o). Many MRMs share the same Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct backbone, enabling apples-to-apples comparisons.
2) Benchmarks: 13 spatial datasets spanning 2D static relations, 3D geometry, and dynamic/temporal consistency (e.g., BLINK, CV-Bench2D/3D, MMVP, SpatialBench, 3DSRBench, MindCube, OmniSpatial).
3) Standardized protocol: VLMEvalKit-style uniform prompting and MCQ formatting; pass@1 under greedy decoding; fixed inference settings (up to 32k tokens).
4) CoT ablation: evaluate each model with a base prompt vs a CoT prompt requiring <think> then <answer>, isolating the effect of prompting alone.
5) No-Image++: feed a blank image and include a “Cannot determine” option to measure shortcut reliance and hallucination when visual evidence is absent.
summary_en.experiments:
1) CoT prompting is net negative: across diverse MLMs, CoT reduces accuracy by ~3% on average.
2) Reasoning models regress vs their backbones: 7/8 MRMs fail to outperform the backbone they were distilled from on generalized spatial benchmarks.
3) No-Image++ exposes shortcut learning: with blank images and an explicit abstain option, MRMs still hallucinate visual details and confidently choose wrong answers based on textual priors.
4) Compute/eval details: vLLM on 4×A100, bfloat16, batch size 16, 3 seeds, greedy decoding.
(Note: the provided excerpt does not include the full per-dataset score tables; identifying which benchmarks/models drive the regressions requires the results section/appendix.)
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim with an eye for experimental control.
1) Start with the main results figure/table (and Figure 1 referenced) to confirm the averaging scheme behind “-3% with CoT” and the backbone-vs-MRM comparisons.
2) Read Methodology carefully: uniform prompt/MCQ formatting, the exact CoT template, and the No-Image++ construction (blank image + abstain option) to judge whether the ablation is fair.
3) Then check breakdowns by dataset category (2D vs 3D/dynamic) to infer whether the failure is about geometric operations or about using visual evidence at all.
Time: ~20–30 minutes for methods + headline results; longer if you need to reuse prompts or replicate the evaluation.

recommendation.zh: 别再默认“加 CoT 就更会推理”：这篇用 No-Image++ 把空间题的文本捷径暴露得很直白，优先看主表+无图消融。
recommendation.en: Don’t assume CoT is a free win: the No-Image++ ablation makes spatial-task shortcutting painfully obvious—read the main results table and the no-image section.

paper.title: Improving Reasoning Capabilities in Small Models through Mixture-of-Layers Distillation with Stepwise Attention on Key Information
paper.abstract: The significant computational demands of large language models have increased interest in distilling reasoning abilities into smaller models via Chain-of-Thought (CoT) distillation. Current CoT distillation methods mainly focus on transferring teacher-generated rationales for complex reasoning to student models. However, they do not adequately explore teachers' dynamic attention toward critical information during reasoning. We find that language models exhibit progressive attention shifts toward

summary.core_problem: 解决小模型推理蒸馏里只学最终 CoT 文本、却学不到教师在逐步推理时如何把注意力收敛到关键信息上的问题。
summary.importance: 这是一个后训练/蒸馏方向的增量方法工作，价值在于把“过程监督”从 token-level rationale 扩展到 attention dynamics；对预训练研究员的启发主要是监督信号设计，而不是基础建模范式。
summary.technical_approach: 作者先观察教师模型在推理过程中会逐步把注意力转向关键证据，然后提出带 stepwise attention transfer 的 CoT distillation；同时引入 Mixture-of-Layers 模块，让学生在不同层级上动态对齐教师的注意模式，而不是固定层对层蒸馏。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出教师/学生模型规模、任务集合、baseline 名称和具体提升幅度。能确认的是目标场景是 small models reasoning，比较对象应是常规 CoT distillation；但缺少关键实验细节，暂时只能视为中等可信度的蒸馏改进。

summary_en.core_problem: It targets a gap in small-model reasoning distillation: standard CoT distillation transfers rationale text but not the teacher’s progressive attention shift toward key evidence during reasoning.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training/distillation paper with incremental but potentially useful signal-design insight: it extends process supervision from rationale tokens to attention dynamics, rather than changing core pretraining methodology.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper first observes that teacher models progressively focus attention on key information during reasoning, then proposes a CoT distillation framework that transfers this stepwise attention pattern. A Mixture-of-Layers module is added for dynamic alignment instead of fixed layer-to-layer matching.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide teacher/student sizes, task suites, baselines, or effect sizes. We can infer the target is small-model reasoning and the comparison is against standard CoT distillation, but the evidence remains incomplete from the abstract alone.

recommendation.zh: 思路不新到改写范式，但“蒸馏 attention dynamics 而非只蒸文本 CoT”值得记一笔；只看方法图和消融，先别把它当稳结论。
recommendation.en: Not a paradigm shift, but the idea of distilling attention dynamics rather than only textual CoT is worth noting; read the method figure and ablations, not the headline.

paper.title: CiPO: Counterfactual Unlearning for Large Reasoning Models through Iterative Preference Optimization
paper.abstract: Machine unlearning has gained increasing attention in recent years, as a promising technique to selectively remove unwanted privacy or copyrighted information from Large Language Models that are trained on a massive scale of human data. However, the emergence of Large Reasoning Models (LRMs), which emphasize long chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning to address complex questions, presents a dilemma to unlearning: existing methods either struggle to completely eliminate undesired knowledge from the Co

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理的是：如何在不明显伤害长链推理能力的前提下，让大型推理模型遗忘指定知识或答案，尤其是把不该保留的信息从 CoT 过程中一起移除。
summary.importance: 它的重要性主要在后训练与安全侧，而不是基座预训练本身。贡献类型更接近方法改进：把 unlearning 从“删答案”改成“干预推理轨迹”，试图解决现有遗忘方法在 reasoning model 上要么删不干净、要么伤推理能力的问题。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 CiPO，把 machine unlearning 表述为针对 CoT 的 counterfactual intervention。核心做法是：给定需要遗忘的目标答案，先让模型生成逻辑上自洽的反事实推理链，再通过 iterative preference optimization 反复偏好这些反事实轨迹，从而把模型从原有不希望保留的推理路径上推开。方法的关键不是直接惩罚最终答案，而是用偏好学习约束中间 reasoning trace。
summary.experiments: 从摘要可见，实验对象是 Large Reasoning Models，比较对象应为现有 unlearning 方法，评估重点包括：目标知识是否被移除、CoT 中是否仍残留不希望的信息，以及总体 reasoning performance 是否下降。摘要没有给出模型规模、数据规模、具体 baseline 名称和量化提升，因此目前只能判断其卖点在于“遗忘更干净、能力损伤更小”的设定，而非已被充分验证的通用结论。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to unlearn targeted knowledge from large reasoning models without substantially damaging long-chain reasoning, especially by removing the unwanted information from the CoT process itself.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance is mainly in post-training and safety rather than base pretraining. The contribution is a method refinement: reframing unlearning from deleting answers to intervening on reasoning traces, aiming to avoid the usual trade-off between incomplete forgetting and degraded reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach: CiPO casts machine unlearning as counterfactual intervention over CoT. Given an answer that should be forgotten, the model is prompted to produce a logically valid counterfactual reasoning trace, and iterative preference optimization is then used to prefer those counterfactual traces over the original ones. The key idea is not to punish only the final answer, but to reshape the intermediate reasoning trajectory through preference learning.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, experiments are conducted on Large Reasoning Models and likely compare against prior unlearning methods. The main evaluation axes are whether the target knowledge is removed, whether the CoT still leaks the undesired content, and how much overall reasoning performance degrades. The abstract does not provide model sizes, data scale, baselines by name, or exact gains, so the current signal is more about setup novelty than a fully established general result.

recommendation.zh: 和预训练关系不深，更多是对齐/遗忘侧技巧；如果你关心 CoT 是否真能被定向改写，可只看方法设定与遗忘-能力权衡表，别把它当通用训练结论。
recommendation.en: This is much more alignment/unlearning than pretraining; read it only if you care whether CoT can be selectively rewritten, and focus on the forgetting-vs-capability trade-off rather than treating it as a general training lesson.

paper.title: LLM Reasoning Is Latent, Not the Chain of Thought
paper.abstract: This position paper argues that large language model (LLM) reasoning should be studied as latent-state trajectory formation rather than as faithful surface chain-of-thought (CoT). This matters because claims about faithfulness, interpretability, reasoning benchmarks, and inference-time intervention all depend on what the field takes the primary object of reasoning to be. We ask what that object should be once three often-confounded factors are separated and formalize three competing hypotheses:

summary.core_problem: 这篇文章讨论的不是“CoT 有没有用”，而是一个更基础的方法论问题：当我们研究 LLM reasoning 时，真正应该把什么当作主要研究对象。作者把当前常被混在一起的三件事拆开：表层 chain-of-thought 文本、隐藏状态中的 latent-state trajectory、以及单纯增加的 serial compute。论文要解决的是，现有关于推理、可解释性、faithfulness、test-time intervention 的很多结论，是否建立在一个并不稳固的默认前提上——即把可见 CoT 当成推理本身。作者的答案是：更合理的默认对象应当是 latent trajectory，而不是表层 CoT。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究者，这篇文章的价值不在于提出一个可直接训练的新算法，而在于重新整理 reasoning 研究的因果对象。现在很多工作把 CoT prompting、test-time scaling、latent reasoning、search、self-consistency 放在同一框架里比较，但这些方法同时改变了可见中间过程、隐藏状态演化和计算预算，导致结论常常不可归因。作者提出 H1/H2/H0 三个竞争假设，把争论从“哪种 prompting 更强”转成“哪种对象具有主要因果解释力”。这对后续设计 reasoning benchmark、faithfulness evaluation、intervention 实验、甚至 reasoning-oriented pretraining 都有方法论影响。尤其对基座模型训练来说，如果 reasoning 主要发生在 latent state 而不是自然语言 CoT，那么把 CoT 当作唯一监督接口可能既不充分，也可能误导评估。
summary.technical_approach:
这是一篇 position paper，但写法不是泛泛而谈，而是先做概念拆分，再给出可检验的竞争假设，最后提出实验裁决框架。核心技术贡献有三层。

第一层是对象分离。作者把 reasoning 相关现象拆成 S、Z、B 三个对象：S 是 surface CoT，即显式自然语言中间轨迹；Z 是 task-relevant latent-state trajectory，即隐藏状态中承载中间承诺和推理进展的路径；B 是 generic serial compute，即额外的迭代、采样、搜索、循环预算，不预设其表征形式。这个拆分的意义在于，很多现有实验同时改变了 S 和 B，或者同时改变了 Z 和 B，因此不能据此断言“CoT 就是 reasoning”或“只是算得更久”。

第二层是三种假设的形式化。H2 认为 reasoning 主要由显式 CoT 中介；H0 认为大部分收益来自额外 serial compute，本身不依赖某个特权表征对象；H1 认为 reasoning 主要由 latent trajectory 中介，CoT 只是部分接口，有时能报告 latent commitment，有时会扰动它，但不是默认的推理载体。作者的关键判断是，若要支持某个假设，应该看在控制其他因素后，哪一类对象具有最稳定、最强的因果杠杆。

第三层是裁决程序。论文提出 two-tier adjudication program：一层是 controlled regime matrix，在审计计算预算的前提下，系统比较 surface、latent、compute 三类方法；另一层是 naturalistic transport suite，检验这些结论在更自然、更复杂任务中的可迁移性。作者还讨论了边界情形：当任务把可见中间文本本身设为构成性对象时，H2 可能重新成立；当收益主要来自更长搜索或更大采样预算时，H0 也可能在局部成立。这个处理是稳妥的，因为它没有把 latent-first 说成放之四海而皆准，而是限定为 ordinary regimes 下的默认工作假设。
summary.experiments:
这篇文章的主体是立场论证与证据重组，不是新模型实验论文。它没有像标准 empirical paper 那样给出大规模新训练结果，而是系统梳理近年的 mechanistic interpretability、latent reasoning、CoT faithfulness、test-time scaling 等证据，并用这些证据去比较 H1/H2/H0 的解释力。作者的核心论点是：

1. 支持 H2 的证据不够强，因为普通 CoT 虽然常常有用，但并不稳定 faithful，且作用高度依赖任务；如果表层 CoT 真是主要推理对象，那么它应当提供更稳定的因果控制与解释。
2. 支持 H0 也不充分，因为单纯增加预算不能解释为什么某些特定内部状态、特征或轨迹能预测、监控甚至改变推理行为；如果只是 generic compute 起作用，那么这些 latent intervention 结果就不应如此关键。
3. 现有 latent monitoring 和 latent reasoning 相关工作更符合 H1：任务相关承诺可以先在隐藏状态中形成，而表层文本只是部分投影，甚至可能缺失或失真。

论文还提出一个重要实验规范：未来比较 reasoning 方法时，必须显式审计 compute budget，并把 surface trace、latent state、serial compute 三者解耦。虽然文中提到“resulting evidence shows H1 receives the strongest support in ordinary regimes”，但这更像对现有证据的综合裁决，而不是作者新跑出的一组统一 benchmark 数字。因此阅读时不要期待标准意义上的参数量、数据量、提升百分点表格；重点在论证结构和实验设计原则。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇文章适合带着方法论问题去读。先看 Introduction 和 Section 2，弄清 S/Z/B 的定义，以及为什么作者认为当前文献常把三者混淆。然后重点看 Section 3 对 H1/H2/H0 的逐项比较，这部分决定整篇文章是否站得住。接着看 Section 4 和 Section 5，那里给出了最有操作性的内容：未来实验应如何设计，怎样做 controlled regime matrix，怎样做 naturalistic transport。最后再看 Section 6，作者如何定位自己与已有 survey、faithfulness、latent reasoning 论文的关系。

如果只是泛读，30 分钟左右足够。最值得记笔记的不是结论句，而是作者提出的“因果杠杆”标准：在控制其他变量后，究竟是表层文本、隐藏轨迹，还是纯计算预算，对推理行为有更稳定的解释和干预能力。对做预训练的人，延伸思考有两个：一是 reasoning supervision 是否应更多面向 latent process 而不是只面向 verbalized CoT；二是 reasoning benchmark 是否需要把 compute 审计和表征对象分离写进协议。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper is not asking whether chain-of-thought helps. It asks a more basic methodological question: when we study LLM reasoning, what should count as the primary object of explanation? The authors separate three things that are often conflated in current work: surface chain-of-thought text, latent-state trajectories inside the model, and generic serial compute from giving the model more inference-time budget. Their central claim is that many conclusions about faithfulness, interpretability, reasoning benchmarks, and intervention rest on an unstable default assumption—namely, that visible CoT is the reasoning process itself. They argue that latent trajectories are the better default object.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining researchers, the value of this paper is conceptual rather than algorithmic. It reorganizes the causal structure of reasoning research. A large fraction of current work compares CoT prompting, test-time scaling, latent reasoning, search, and self-consistency as if they were directly commensurable, even though these methods often change visible traces, hidden-state dynamics, and compute budget at the same time. By formalizing three competing hypotheses—H1, H2, and H0—the paper shifts the debate from prompt-level performance to explanatory priority. That matters for how we design reasoning benchmarks, evaluate faithfulness, build interventions, and even think about reasoning-oriented pretraining. If reasoning is primarily latent rather than verbal, then treating natural-language CoT as the sole supervision interface may be both incomplete and misleading.
summary_en.technical_approach:
This is a position paper, but it is structured as a disciplined methodological argument rather than a loose essay. Its contribution has three layers.

First, it separates the objects. The paper defines S as surface CoT, the explicit natural-language intermediate trace; Z as task-relevant latent-state trajectories, meaning hidden-state paths that carry intermediate commitments during multi-step inference; and B as generic serial compute, meaning extra iterative budget for search, looping, sampling, or repeated computation without assuming any privileged representational form. This decomposition matters because many existing experiments move S and B together, or Z and B together, making causal interpretation weak.

Second, it formalizes three hypotheses. H2 says reasoning is primarily mediated by explicit surface CoT. H0 says most apparent reasoning gains are better explained by extra serial compute than by any privileged representational object. H1 says reasoning is primarily mediated by latent-state trajectories, with surface CoT acting only as a partial interface that may sometimes report latent commitments and sometimes perturb them. The key evaluative principle is causal leverage: after controlling the other factors, which object provides the strongest and most stable explanatory and interventional handle?

Third, the paper proposes an adjudication program. It outlines a two-tier framework: a controlled regime matrix that compares surface, latent, and compute families under audited budgets, and a naturalistic transport suite that tests whether conclusions survive in more realistic settings. The authors also discuss boundary regimes carefully. H2 may re-emerge when visible traces are constitutive of the task itself, and H0 may dominate when gains are driven mainly by larger search or sampling budgets. This makes the paper more precise than a blanket “latent is everything” claim; the recommendation is a default for ordinary reasoning regimes, not a universal law.
summary_en.experiments:
The paper is primarily a synthesis and adjudication argument, not a standard empirical training paper. It does not present a new large-scale model with fresh benchmark tables in the usual sense. Instead, it reorganizes evidence from recent work on mechanistic interpretability, latent reasoning, CoT faithfulness, and test-time scaling, and asks which hypothesis that evidence supports.

The core argument runs as follows. First, the case for H2 is weaker than often assumed: ordinary CoT can improve performance, but it is not reliably faithful, and its role varies sharply across tasks. If surface CoT were the main reasoning object, it should provide more stable causal control and explanation. Second, H0 is also insufficient as a default explanation: extra budget alone does not account for results showing that specific internal states, features, or trajectories can predict, monitor, or alter reasoning behavior. If generic compute were the whole story, such latent-state interventions should not matter so much. Third, the current body of work on latent monitoring and latent reasoning fits H1 better: task-relevant commitments can form in hidden-state dynamics before, beyond, or partly independent of what is verbalized on the surface.

One of the paper’s most useful contributions is procedural: future reasoning evaluations should explicitly audit compute budgets and disentangle surface traces, latent states, and serial compute instead of letting them vary together. The line in the paper that “the resulting evidence shows that H1 receives the strongest support in ordinary regimes” should be read as a synthesis of existing evidence, not as a single new benchmark result. So readers should not expect the usual tables of parameter counts, dataset sizes, or exact percentage gains; the main payload is the argument structure and the proposed experimental discipline.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read this paper as a methodological reset for reasoning research. Start with the Introduction and Section 2 to understand the S/Z/B decomposition and why the authors think current literature often confounds these objects. Then spend most of your time on Section 3, where H1, H2, and H0 are compared as competing explanations. After that, read Sections 4 and 5 carefully, because they contain the most operational content: how future experiments should be designed, what a controlled regime matrix should look like, and how a naturalistic transport suite could test external validity. Section 6 is useful for positioning the paper relative to adjacent surveys and empirical work.

A serious skim takes about 30 minutes. The most important thing to extract is not the headline claim, but the causal-leverage criterion: after controlling the other variables, is the strongest explanatory and interventional handle in the visible trace, the latent trajectory, or the compute budget? For pretraining researchers, two follow-up questions are especially relevant: whether reasoning supervision should target latent processes rather than only verbalized CoT, and whether future reasoning benchmarks should bake compute auditing and representational disentanglement into the protocol.

recommendation.zh: 这是篇观点文，不要按结果论文读；若你在做 CoT 数据、latent steering 或 reasoning eval，先看三假设框架，能帮你把实验对象定义得更干净。
recommendation.en: Read this as a framing paper, not a result paper; if you work on CoT data, latent steering, or reasoning evals, the three-hypothesis split is useful for cleaning up what exactly your experiment is measuring.

paper.title: Free Lunch for Unified Multimodal Models: Enhancing Generation via Reflective Rectification with Inherent Understanding

summary.core_problem: 统一多模态模型（理解+生成）存在“理解强、生成弱”的能力错配，生成阶段未能充分激活内部知识来纠错中间结果。
summary.importance: 提出训练free的“反思-纠错”生成范式（Thinking-While-Drawing），强调利用UMM固有理解能力作为生成过程的在线监督信号；对统一模型的推理-生成耦合有启发，但仍偏生成侧策略而非预训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: UniRect-CoT：将扩散去噪过程视为内在视觉推理过程，在生成过程中持续反思并对中间结果做rectification；核心是用模型自身理解模块产生反馈并对生成轨迹进行对齐/修正（无需额外训练）。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供具体模型/数据/指标与提升幅度；应在统一多模态生成任务上对比原始UMM采样与若干自反思/自纠错基线，展示质量与可控性提升。

summary_en.core_problem: Unified multimodal models show a capability mismatch: understanding is much stronger than generation, and internal knowledge is under-activated during generation.
summary_en.importance: Introduces a training-free reflection-and-rectification paradigm (Thinking-While-Drawing) that leverages inherent understanding as online feedback for generation. Insightful for coupling reasoning with generation, though not a pretraining contribution.
summary_en.technical_approach: UniRect-CoT treats diffusion denoising as an intrinsic visual reasoning process and continuously reflects to activate internal knowledge and rectify intermediate results during sampling, using the model’s own understanding module without additional training.
summary_en.experiments: No concrete model/data scale or gains are reported in the abstract; experiments likely compare vanilla UMM sampling vs. self-reflection/rectification baselines on unified multimodal generation benchmarks.

recommendation.zh: 训练free的“边画边想”更像推理时策略，能启发把理解当在线监督，但缺少干净对照来改我对预训练的prior。
recommendation.en: A training-free “think-while-drawing” recipe that treats understanding as online supervision; interesting inference-time coupling, but controls aren’t clean enough to update pretraining priors.

paper.title: Correct Prediction, Wrong Steps? Consensus Reasoning Knowledge Graph for Robust Chain-of-Thought Synthesis

summary.core_problem: 论文聚焦“答案正确但推理步骤不可靠”的结构性失配：LLM 可能通过带有逻辑错误/幻觉的中间步骤（Step Internal Flaws），或通过过度/不足推理（Step-wise Flaws：overthinking/underthinking）仍得到正确最终答案。作者进一步提出并验证一个反直觉问题：即便给定正确最终答案，让模型“只需解释”，也并不能稳定提升推理步骤质量或整体推理能力；因此需要一种能在样本级同时处理多类混合缺陷的统一后处理/合成框架。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在于提出新的预训练目标，而在于为“用 CoT 作为训练/蒸馏数据”的数据科学提供了强约束：1）仅用正确答案条件化并不能净化推理轨迹，说明轨迹缺陷主要来自中间结构与局部决策而非答案不确定性；2）提出“跨轨迹共识”作为自动化筛噪与补全的原则，可用于构建更高保真推理数据（SFT/RL/蒸馏）并降低把错误推理写入基座模型的风险；3）从方法论上把 over/underthinking 与 step-level 逻辑错误统一到同一检测与合成管线，提示后续在 RL pretrain/持续学习中应把‘轨迹结构一致性’作为可优化信号，而不是只优化 outcome reward。
summary.technical_approach:
CRAFT（Consensus Reasoning knowledge graph Aggregation for Flaw-aware Traces synthesis）是一个“多轨迹→共识结构→拓扑生成”的统一框架，核心思想是：同一题目采样得到的多条推理轨迹中，大多数步骤在语义与结构上是可对齐且正确的；错误/冗余/缺失步骤会在跨轨迹比较中表现为偏离共识。

模块 I：多样化轨迹生成与共识术语抽取。对每个样本 rollout K 条候选推理轨迹；用 TF-IRF（文中表述为 TF-IRF weighting）从多轨迹中抽取“共识术语/关键概念”T_con，用于后续对齐与图构建时的锚点，降低纯文本表述差异带来的噪声。

模块 II：共识 RKG 构建与异常过滤。将每条轨迹转为 Reasoning Knowledge Graph（RKG）：节点=推理步骤，边=逻辑关系（有向）。再把多条 RKG 聚合为共识图 G*：直观上保留多数轨迹共享的节点/边结构。随后用统计过滤（文中提到 z-score filtering）剔除结构上显著偏离的步骤/子结构，以同时捕捉两类缺陷：
- Step Internal Flaws：内容错误/幻觉导致该步骤与其他轨迹难以形成一致的语义-结构邻接；
- Step-wise Flaws：overthinking 表现为少数轨迹额外插入的冗余分支；underthinking 表现为少数轨迹缺失共识中的关键节点/边。
该“组内相对比较”的思想与 GRPO 的 group relative comparison 类似：不依赖外部标注逐步判错，而用组内一致性作为弱监督信号。

模块 III：拓扑引导的轨迹合成。对共识图 G* 做拓扑序遍历（topological order），按图结构生成一条高质量推理轨迹：既避免冗余（不走被过滤的偏离分支），又补齐关键步骤（沿共识主干覆盖必要节点），从而在不显式使用正确答案条件化的情况下提升最终预测与轨迹质量。
summary.experiments:
论文在两类互补评测上验证“给答案不提升推理”的结论与 CRAFT 的收益：
1）PRMBench：把 LLM 当 verifier 来识别错误步骤，衡量逐步可靠性；
2）ROSCOE：衡量生成推理轨迹的多维质量。
在 w/ Answer 与 w/o Answer 两种设置、跨 4 个 LLM 的系统评估中，给定正确最终答案总体“无一致提升”，部分情形还会下降，支持作者关于“问题在中间步骤结构与缺陷混合”的诊断。

在方法对比上，CRAFT 在逻辑与数学推理基准上平均带来 10%+ 的 label-prediction accuracy 提升，并在多种基线下保持一致优势；同时在细粒度轨迹质量评测维度上也更好。由于你提供的全文片段未包含完整实验表格与具体模型/数据规模/每个基准的逐项数值，无法在此可靠复述参数量、K 的取值、各数据集上的精确提升幅度与显著性检验细节。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 20–35 分钟）：
- 先读 Section 4.1（或对应实验小节）：作者如何设计“w/ Answer vs w/o Answer”的对照、在 PRMBench/ROSCOE 上如何度量“推理能力/轨迹质量”，以及哪些情况下给答案会变差。
- 再读 Methodology/Algorithm 1：重点看三模块接口（TF-IRF 共识术语→单轨迹 RKG→聚合成 G*→z-score 过滤→拓扑生成），理解它如何同时覆盖 internal flaw 与 step-wise flaw。
- 关注 RKG 的定义：节点/边如何从自然语言步骤抽取、聚合时如何对齐（共识术语在其中的作用），以及过滤阈值对 over/underthinking 的敏感性。
- 若你关心预训练数据科学：重点思考 CRAFT 生成的“高质量轨迹”能否作为蒸馏/持续学习数据，哪些环节可能引入偏置（例如共识会不会压制少数但正确的解法）。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a persistent mismatch in LLM reasoning: models can output the correct final label while producing unreliable chain-of-thought steps. It argues that failures are heterogeneous and sample-specific—mixing step-internal errors (logical mistakes, hallucinations) with step-wise issues (overthinking/underthinking). A key empirical question is tested: even when the correct final answer is provided and the model is asked to justify it, reasoning quality and robustness do not improve consistently, implying the root cause lies in intermediate-step structure rather than answer uncertainty.
summary_en.importance: Its main value for foundation-model researchers is as a data/trajectory quality result rather than a new pretraining objective. It provides evidence that “answer-conditioned justification” is not a reliable way to clean CoT traces, which matters for distillation and RL-style training where traces become supervision. The proposed cross-trace consensus principle suggests a scalable way to filter, repair, and synthesize higher-fidelity reasoning trajectories—potentially reducing the risk of imprinting flawed reasoning into base models. Conceptually, it reframes over/underthinking and step-level logical errors as a unified, consensus-detectable phenomenon, hinting that future RL pretraining could incorporate structural-consistency signals beyond outcome rewards.
summary_en.technical_approach:
CRAFT (Consensus Reasoning knowledge graph Aggregation for Flaw-aware Traces synthesis) is a multi-sample post-processing framework that turns multiple candidate traces into a single higher-quality trace via a consensus reasoning graph.

Module I: Generate K diverse candidate traces per problem and extract consensus terms using TF-IRF weighting. These terms act as anchors to reduce surface-form variance across traces.

Module II: Build a per-trace Reasoning Knowledge Graph (RKG) where nodes are reasoning steps and directed edges encode logical relations. Aggregate per-trace graphs into a consensus graph G* and filter anomalous steps/structures using z-score-based deviation filtering. The same mechanism is intended to catch (a) step-internal flaws, which tend to diverge semantically/structurally from the majority, and (b) step-wise flaws, where redundant branches (overthinking) or missing backbone steps (underthinking) are exposed by comparing each trace to the group consensus. The design is explicitly motivated by group-relative comparison ideas (akin to GRPO).

Module III: Synthesize a final trace by traversing the consensus graph in topological order, producing a coherent step sequence that follows the majority-supported backbone while avoiding filtered deviations.
summary_en.experiments:
The paper evaluates the “provide the correct answer” hypothesis and the CRAFT framework on two complementary benchmarks: PRMBench (LLM-as-verifier for erroneous-step identification) and ROSCOE (multi-dimensional reasoning-trace quality). Across four LLMs and two settings (with vs without the correct answer), providing the answer yields no consistent gains and sometimes degrades performance.

For end-task performance, CRAFT reports 10%+ average improvements in label-prediction accuracy across logical and mathematical reasoning benchmarks and also improves detailed trace-quality metrics. The provided full-text excerpt does not include the complete result tables (model sizes, dataset sizes, per-benchmark deltas, K values), so exact numeric breakdowns cannot be reproduced here without risking fabrication.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (20–35 minutes):
- Read the section reporting the w/Answer vs w/oAnswer study (notably the PRMBench/ROSCOE protocol and metrics) to understand why answer-conditioning fails.
- Then read the method/Algorithm 1 end-to-end: TF-IRF consensus term extraction → per-trace RKG construction → consensus aggregation and z-score filtering → topology-guided synthesis.
- Pay special attention to how RKG edges are defined/extracted from natural language steps and how graph alignment is done; these details determine whether consensus preserves correct minority solution paths.
- If your interest is pretraining data pipelines, focus on the discussion/implications for distillation and RL training: when consensus helps, when it might collapse diversity, and how to tune filtering thresholds.

recommendation.zh: 只看“正确答案条件化也洗不干净CoT”的证据与共识合成管线：它改变我对用CoT当训练数据的信心，应立刻加到内部轨迹筛噪里。
recommendation.en: Focus on the evidence that conditioning on the correct final answer doesn’t sanitize CoT, and the consensus synthesis pipeline—this should directly change how you filter/construct reasoning traces.

paper.title: Correct Chains, Wrong Answers: Dissociating Reasoning from Output in LLM Logic

summary.core_problem: 论文要解决的核心问题是：在逻辑推理任务中，“链式思维（CoT）每一步都正确”并不必然推出“最终答案正确”。作者希望把“真正按定义执行运算并逐步组合（operator logic）”与“凭运算符名字/常见模式检索（operator name / pattern retrieval）”严格解耦，并进一步定位：当出现“推理正确但答案错”时，错误究竟发生在推理过程、还是发生在最终输出生成阶段（autoregressive decoding 的末端决策）。
summary.importance:
对预训练研究的启发主要在三点：
1) 评测层面：提出一种能系统性暴露“推理—输出解耦（reasoning–output dissociation）”的构造范式（Novel Operator Test），它能绕开传统逻辑基准被语料记忆/模板检索污染的问题；这对研究“模型是否学到可组合的算法性语义”很关键。
2) 机制层面：把错误分成“策略失败（strategy failure，模型不进入推理模式）”与“内容失败（content failure，进入推理模式但末端答案仍错）”，并用长度/脚手架干预把两者分离，为研究训练动态（何时触发显式推理）、以及解码/对齐导致的末端不稳定提供了可操作的实验抓手。
3) 数据与对齐层面：结果暗示仅靠 CoT 监督或让模型‘写出正确步骤’不足以保证可执行性与最终决策一致；对后续的 RL pretrain / 过程监督（process supervision）/ 末端校准（answer calibration）都有直接影响。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 Novel Operator Test 基准设计与一组诊断性干预。
- 基准构造：从 16 个二元布尔函数中去掉 6 个“平凡函数”（常量、投影及其取反），保留 10 个非平凡算子；实验选 9 个（为平衡分组与结构覆盖，省略 NAND 与一个与 BLIF 镜像的算子）。
- 分组思想：
  * Group A（标准名）：AND/OR/XOR/IF-THEN，预训练语料中高频。
  * Group B（新名字但给出真值表定义）：BLIF(A∧¬B)、TARN(NOR)、QUEX(B→A)、DREM(XNOR)。这些在结构上覆盖对称性、稀疏性（真值表 True 行数）等维度，用于区分“结构难度”与“名字熟悉度”。
  * Group C（Trojan）：ZENT 的真值表与 XOR 完全相同但名字陌生，用来隔离“仅名字变化”对性能的影响：若 XOR≈ZENT，则模型主要按定义执行而非按名字联想。
- 任务形式：每题给出相关算子的真值表、变量赋值，要求计算左结合链式表达式；深度定义为链长（1–10）。同质链（同一算子重复）与混合算子链（额外 600 题）都测。
- 关键诊断：
  * 用“完成 token 数”作为行为代理，判断模型是在做“简短检索式回答”还是进入“显式 CoT 组合”。
  * 引入 Explicit Truth-Table Tracing (ETT) 提示：强制每一步按真值表查表并写出中间结果，作为结构化脚手架干预，用于检验：性能问题来自没进入正确策略，还是来自更深层的生成/一致性问题。
  * 自我纠错探针（self-correction probe）：对出现“推理正确但答案错”的样本，追问/要求核对以定位失败点；作者据此将深度 7 的核心失败归因到“自回归生成末端的答案声明”而非推理步骤本身。
- 与既有工作的区别：不同于 Turpin et al. 2024 所讨论的 CoT unfaithfulness（写出来的推理不等于真实过程），本文展示的是“写出来的推理在可验证意义上是正确的，但最终输出标签仍错”，属于另一类一致性断裂。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 5 个模型：GPT-4o-2024-11-20、Claude Sonnet 4、Llama 3.1 70B Instruct、o3-mini-2025-01-31、QwQ-32B；每模型最多约 8,100 题（含扩展深度、表示形式、ETT、混合链等；推理模型 o3-mini/QwQ-32B 不做部分干预）。
关键结果（文中给出的核心数字/现象）：
- 低深度：所有模型在 depth 1 均 ≥96%。
- depth 5：GPT-4o 与 Claude Sonnet 4 在所有组别均 ≥96%；Llama 有明显 novelty gap。
- novelty gap（Group A − Group B）：GPT-4o 在 depth 5 为 0pp，Claude 为 -1pp；Llama 在 depth 5 为 11pp（Welch t-test p<0.01）；QwQ-32B 约 6pp。Llama 的差距集中在 QUEX(78%)、DREM(86%)，说明困难更多来自算子结构而非名字。
- Trojan 检验：depth 5 时 XOR 与 ZENT 无显著差异（所有模型 Fisher exact p≥0.49），支持“按真值表定义执行”而非“按名字联想”。但在 depth 2 出现反直觉：GPT-4o 的 ZENT(82%) 反而高于 XOR(62%)，提示“熟悉名字”可能诱发错误的检索式策略。
- 深度—策略转变：GPT-4o 在多数算子上呈非单调：depth1 近 100%，depth2 明显下跌，depth3–5 恢复。行为证据来自输出长度：
  * depth1：所有算子几乎都 1 token 作答。
  * depth2：仍倾向短答导致失败，尤其 XOR：50/50 样本全部 1 token 作答但仅 62% 准确。
  * depth3：开始进入长 CoT，TARN 平均 321 tokens、DREM 272 tokens，准确率均跃升到 98%。
- 处理成本差异：depth 5 时 GPT-4o 对 Group A 平均 141 tokens，对 Group B 平均 343 tokens（2.4×），在准确率相当情况下显示“新算子需要更重的显式处理”。
- 论文标题现象（推理正确但答案错）：Claude Sonnet 4 在 depth 7 出现 31 个错误样本，作者逐步核验后认为每一步 CoT 都正确但最终声明答案错误；混合算子链中 19 个错误里有 17 个同样模式。自我纠错探针显示失败点集中在自回归生成末端的答案输出。
- ETT 干预：作者区分两类失败：
  * depth2 的“策略失败”可被 ETT 大幅修复（文中给出 +62pp 的提升量级）。
  * depth7 的“内容失败/末端失败”ETT 仅带来 +8–30pp 的提升区间，且作者报告在某些后续干预下出现“0/300 post-intervention”的现象（表明并非简单脚手架即可根治，更多像生成一致性/决策头问题）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 25–35 分钟）：
1) 先看基准定义部分：Novel Operator Test 的三组设计（标准/新名/Trojan）与“去平凡函数”的动机，理解它如何隔离语料记忆与组合推理。
2) 重点看 depth2 的“模式切换”证据：Figure 2（长度作为策略代理）+ XOR 在 depth2 的 1-token 行为，这是全文最关键的机制线索之一。
3) 精看 Table 3/4（或对应主结果表）：XOR vs ZENT 的无差异、以及 GroupA vs GroupB 的 token 成本差异。
4) 看 ETT 章节：作者如何用脚手架把 strategy failure 与 content failure 分开；并结合 depth7 的 31 个 dissociation 样本理解“错误发生在末端输出”。
5) 若你关注预训练/对齐：建议把本文现象与 process supervision、RLHF 对“最终答案 token”的偏置联系起来思考：为什么中间状态正确但最后一步会翻车？是否与解码温度、答案格式、或 reward model 对简短答案的偏好有关？

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific failure mode in logical reasoning with CoT: an LLM can produce a fully correct, verifiable chain of intermediate steps yet still output an incorrect final answer. The goal is to (i) disentangle genuine operator execution from name-based pattern retrieval by using unfamiliar operator names defined via truth tables, and (ii) localize where the failure happens—during reasoning steps vs. at the final autoregressive answer emission.
summary_en.importance:
Key implications for foundation-model pretraining research:
1) Evaluation design: the Novel Operator Test is a clean construction to reduce contamination from memorized operator semantics and to probe compositional, definition-following behavior.
2) Mechanistic diagnosis: the paper separates “strategy failures” (model never enters an explicit reasoning mode) from “content/decoding failures” (explicit reasoning is correct but the final answer token is wrong), offering a practical handle to study training dynamics and decoding stability.
3) Alignment/process supervision: it suggests that supervising or eliciting CoT is not sufficient to guarantee executable correctness at the decision point; the final-answer channel can be miscalibrated even when intermediate computation is correct—relevant to RL pretraining, process rewards, and answer calibration.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The approach combines a benchmark construction with targeted prompting/diagnostic probes.
- Benchmark: Boolean operator evaluation where each operator is defined by an explicit truth table, but operator names vary in familiarity.
  * Group A: standard names (AND/OR/XOR/IF-THEN).
  * Group B: unfamiliar names mapped to non-trivial Boolean functions (e.g., A∧¬B, NOR, converse implication, XNOR), chosen to span structural properties like symmetry and sparsity.
  * Group C (Trojan): ZENT has the exact XOR truth table under a novel name; this isolates name familiarity from operator logic.
- Task: left-associated homogeneous chains at depths 1–10, plus mixed-operator chains.
- Behavioral proxy: completion length is used to infer whether the model is doing terse retrieval vs. explicit multi-step reasoning.
- Intervention: Explicit Truth-Table Tracing (ETT) forces step-by-step truth-table lookup to test whether failures are due to missing strategy vs. deeper inconsistencies.
- Localization: a self-correction probe on dissociation cases is used to argue the error is concentrated at the final autoregressive answer declaration rather than in the intermediate reasoning steps.
- Distinction from prior work: unlike CoT unfaithfulness (where written reasoning diverges from the true internal process), here the written reasoning is itself correct but the final output label is wrong.
summary_en.experiments:
Models: GPT-4o-2024-11-20, Claude Sonnet 4, Llama 3.1 70B Instruct, o3-mini-2025-01-31, QwQ-32B; up to ~8,100 problems/model depending on interventions.
Main findings with concrete reported numbers:
- Depth 1: all models achieve ≥96%.
- Depth 5: GPT-4o and Claude Sonnet 4 achieve ≥96% across all operator groups; Llama shows a novelty gap.
- Novelty gap (Group A − Group B) at depth 5: GPT-4o 0pp, Claude -1pp, Llama 11pp (Welch t-test p<0.01), QwQ-32B ~6pp. For Llama, the gap concentrates on QUEX (78%) and DREM (86%), indicating structural difficulty beyond name familiarity.
- Trojan test: no significant XOR–ZENT gap at depth 5 for any model (Fisher exact p≥0.49), supporting definition-based execution. However at depth 2 GPT-4o shows ZENT 82% vs XOR 62%, suggesting familiar names can trigger a wrong “retrieval” strategy.
- Depth-2 mode transition: GPT-4o exhibits a sharp dip at depth 2 then recovers by depth 3–5. Length evidence: depth 1 answers are ~1 token; at depth 2 XOR is answered in exactly 1 token for all 50 instances yet only 62% correct; by depth 3 the model produces long CoT (e.g., TARN ~321 tokens, DREM ~272 tokens) with ~98% accuracy.
- Processing cost: at depth 5 GPT-4o uses 141 mean tokens for Group A vs 343 for Group B (2.4×) at similar accuracy.
- Core dissociation: Claude Sonnet 4 at depth 7 has 31 errors where every CoT step is verified correct but the declared final answer is wrong; in mixed-operator chains 17/19 errors show the same pattern. Self-correction probes attribute the failure to the final autoregressive answer emission.
- ETT: large gains for depth-2 strategy failures (reported +62pp), but limited gains for depth-7 dissociation/content failures (reported +8–30pp range), with some post-intervention settings yielding 0/300 success—suggesting the issue is not fixed by scaffolding alone.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (~25–35 minutes):
1) Read the benchmark construction carefully (operator grouping + Trojan logic) to understand how it isolates memorization vs compositional execution.
2) Focus on the depth-2 “mode switch” evidence: the response-length analysis (Figure 2) and the XOR 1-token behavior at depth 2.
3) Inspect the main tables for XOR vs ZENT and Group A vs Group B token-cost differences.
4) Read the ETT intervention section to see how the paper separates strategy vs content/decoding failures.
5) For pretraining/alignment researchers: reflect on why correct intermediate computation can still produce a wrong final token—possible interactions with decoding, formatting, or reward-model biases.

recommendation.zh: 只看 Novel Operator Test 和“策略失败 vs 内容失败”的分解：它提醒 CoT 正确不等于决策正确，适合用来评估你过程监督/RL 是否只在教模型写漂亮步骤。
recommendation.en: Skim the Novel Operator Test and the strategy-vs-content failure split: it shows correct CoT doesn’t guarantee correct decisions, a good probe for whether your process supervision/RL just trains fluent steps.

paper.title: LongCoT: Benchmarking Long-Horizon Chain-of-Thought Reasoning

summary.core_problem: 如何可控、可验证地评测前沿模型在“超长推理链”(长时程CoT)上的规划与错误累积问题。
summary.importance: Benchmark贡献：把长时程推理失败从“单步能力不足”中剥离出来，直接测量跨数万到数十万推理token的长链依赖与状态管理能力，为长上下文训练、推理时计算分配、以及后训练/自我纠错研究提供靶标。
summary.technical_approach: 提出LongCoT基准：2500道专家设计题，覆盖化学/数学/计算机/国际象棋/逻辑；题目输入短且答案可验证，但解题需要在“相互依赖步骤图”中推进，链长可达数十到数十万推理token；设计使得每个局部步骤对前沿模型都可解，从而将失败归因于长时程组织与累积误差。
summary.experiments: 报告发布时前沿模型在该基准上准确率<10%（如GPT 5.2: 9.8%，Gemini 3 Pro: 6.1%）；其余训练规模/提示策略/对比设置摘要未展开。

summary_en.core_problem: How to rigorously and verifiably evaluate frontier models’ long-horizon chain-of-thought planning and error accumulation over extremely long reasoning traces.
summary_en.importance: Benchmark contribution: isolates long-horizon reasoning failures from single-step capability limits, providing a target for long-context training, inference-time compute allocation, and post-training/self-correction research.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces LongCoT: 2,500 expert-designed problems across chemistry, math, CS, chess, and logic. Inputs are short with verifiable answers, but solving requires traversing a dependency graph of steps spanning tens to hundreds of thousands of reasoning tokens. Each local step is intended to be tractable for frontier models, attributing failures to long-horizon limitations.
summary_en.experiments: At release, best models achieve <10% accuracy (e.g., GPT 5.2: 9.8%; Gemini 3 Pro: 6.1%). The abstract does not detail training scale, prompting protocols, or broader baselines.

recommendation.zh: 当benchmark备查即可：重点看任务如何可验证+错误累积统计，能把长上下文训练/推理算力分配的改动落到可测靶标上。
recommendation.en: Use it as a benchmark reference: focus on the verifiability design and error-accumulation stats—it gives a concrete target for long-context training and inference compute-allocation tweaks.

paper.title: Sample Complexity of Autoregressive Reasoning: Chain-of-Thought vs. End-to-End

summary.core_problem: 在“自回归下一token生成器”PAC学习框架下，系统刻画学习由T步自回归推理过程诱导的端到端映射的样本复杂度如何随推理长度T增长，并严格比较两种监督信号：只给最终答案的端到端监督（e2e） vs 给出完整中间轨迹的Chain-of-Thought监督（CoT）。核心问题是：CoT监督在统计效率上究竟能带来多大、在什么条件下的优势？是否存在本质的指数级差距？
summary.importance:
对预训练/后训练（尤其是“用CoT数据做SFT/RL/蒸馏”）的直接启发在于：它把“CoT更省样本/更易学”从经验直觉提升为可证明的统计学习结论，并明确优势来源于“可观测中间状态”带来的可分解学习结构。对基座研究的影响主要是理论层面的：
- 给出随T增长的样本复杂度上/下界，说明在某些函数类中，e2e学习会因长链组合而出现显著更差的样本复杂度，而CoT监督可避免这种组合爆炸。
- 为数据科学提供原则：当任务天然包含长推理链、且中间token具有可预测结构时，标注/合成CoT可能比单纯增加e2e样本更“划算”。
- 也提示风险：若中间链并非唯一正确（多解推理）或监督链与模型可实现的生成机制不匹配，理论优势的前提会被削弱（论文在更一般损失/多标签视角下讨论）。
summary.technical_approach:
论文建立在Joshi et al. (COLT 2025)的next-token generator PAC框架上：
1) 对象与派生类：基础类F是f: Σ*→Σ。迭代apply-and-append T次得到完整轨迹（CoT）与最终token（e2e）。由此诱导两类：F^{CoT,T}（输出T步后缀序列）与F^{e2e,T}（只输出最后符号）。
2) 学习设定：分布D over prompts x∈Σ*；目标f_*∈F。训练样本在e2e监督下是(x, f_*^{e2e,T}(x))；在CoT监督下是(x, f_*^{CoT,T}(x))。测试都评估端到端最后token错误率。
3) 主要结果形态（从全文结构可见）：分别在Section 6（e2e）与Section 7（CoT）给出样本复杂度界与可学习性/不可学习性构造；通过构造特定的F与分布D，证明两种监督在随T扩展时存在本质差异。
4) 证明策略概览：
- e2e侧：学习的是“迭代组合后的函数类”F^{e2e,T}，其复杂度可随T急剧膨胀；典型做法是给出下界构造（例如让不同的中间轨迹在最终输出上发生混叠/别名，使得仅观察最终token难以区分目标生成器），从而导致样本复杂度随T显著变差。
- CoT侧：观察到完整轨迹等价于获得每一步的监督信号，使问题更接近逐步学习/分解学习；可通过把T步问题还原为对基础生成器f在不同前缀分布上的监督学习，从而得到更好的（通常是多项式级）样本复杂度上界。
5) 现实性讨论：论文在引言脚注与Section 2.4提到“多正确输出/多条正确推理链”的情形更贴近真实LLM推理，暗示需要用更一般的损失或多标签定义来扩展该PAC框架；这对把理论结论迁移到真实CoT数据（多样推理路径）非常关键。
summary.experiments:
该工作为理论学习论文，全文结构显示主要贡献是定理、上/下界与构造性证明，不以大规模实证为主；因此没有典型的“参数量/数据规模/基准分数”式实验。你在阅读时应把“实验”理解为：
- 不同监督设定下的样本复杂度定理（随T、|Σ|、以及F的复杂度度量如VC维/增长函数等的依赖）。
- 关键反例/下界构造展示e2e监督在长链下的困难，以及CoT监督如何规避。
（你提供的全文片段未包含Section 2的主定理陈述与具体界的公式常数/阶数，因此我无法在不臆测的情况下写出精确的O(·)/Ω(·)表达式；建议直接从Section 2的Main Results表述与Section 6/7的定理编号处摘录。）
summary.reading_guide:
精读建议（must_read，约2–4小时，建议带着做笔记）：
1) Section 2（Main Results）必须逐条读清：每个结果对应的假设（对F的限制、对分布D的条件、输出空间Σ大小、是否随机化等）与结论（样本复杂度对T的依赖）是全文主线。
2) Section 6（End-to-End）重点看下界构造与“为何只看最终token会信息不足”的关键引理：这部分最能转化为对真实LLM训练的直觉（长推理链导致信用分配/别名问题）。
3) Section 7（CoT supervision）重点看如何把轨迹监督转化为逐步学习的上界证明：关注它如何处理“前缀分布随生成器变化”的技术点（这是自回归学习区别于普通监督学习的核心难点）。
4) Section 2.4（多解输出/更一般损失）建议精读：它决定了该理论与真实CoT数据（多条合理推理链、非唯一中间步骤）的距离。
5) 作为预训练数据科学启发：读完后可尝试把你关心的任务抽象成该框架中的F与T，判断CoT标注/合成是否可能带来“阶数级”的样本效率收益，还是仅常数级改进。

summary_en.core_problem: In a PAC framework for autoregressive next-token generators, quantify how the sample complexity of learning the induced T-step end-to-end input–output mapping scales with the generation length T, and rigorously compare two supervision regimes: end-to-end labels (only the final token) versus chain-of-thought labels (the entire intermediate trajectory).
summary_en.importance: Highly relevant as a theory anchor for why CoT supervision/data can be more sample-efficient than pure final-answer supervision. The paper formalizes an intuition central to LLM post-training and data design: observing intermediate reasoning states can fundamentally change learnability by turning a hard composed mapping into a decomposable, step-supervised problem. For foundation-model researchers, the value is not a new training trick but a set of provable separations and scaling dependencies with T that can inform when CoT annotation/synthesis is worth the cost, and when end-to-end-only supervision is statistically doomed to scale poorly with longer reasoning chains.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Built on the Joshi et al. (COLT 2025) PAC model:
- Base hypothesis class F consists of next-token generators f: Σ*→Σ.
- Iterating the apply-and-append operator T times yields a length-T trajectory (the “CoT”) and the final token (the e2e output). This induces derived classes F^{CoT,T} and F^{e2e,T}.
- Learning task: prompts x are drawn i.i.d. from an unknown distribution D; target generator f_*∈F. Training data reveals either (x, f_*^{e2e,T}(x)) or (x, f_*^{CoT,T}(x)), but evaluation is always end-to-end error on the final token.
- Core proof pattern: analyze how complexity blows up when learning the composed/iterated mapping under e2e-only labels (typically via lower-bound constructions where many distinct generators/trajectories alias to the same final outputs on observed samples), versus how full-trajectory supervision enables stepwise identification and yields substantially better (often polynomial-in-T) sample complexity upper bounds.
- The paper also discusses extensions beyond single “correct” outputs (multi-solution reasoning) via more general loss/multilabel viewpoints, which is crucial for mapping the theory to real CoT data where many intermediate chains can be valid.
summary_en.experiments: This is a theoretical learning paper: the main “results” are theorems (upper/lower bounds and separations) rather than empirical scaling runs. The key artifacts to extract are the explicit sample-complexity dependencies on T (and on the complexity measure of F and the alphabet size). The provided excerpt does not include the full Main Results section with the exact asymptotic forms, so precise O(·)/Ω(·) statements should be taken directly from Section 2 and the formal theorems in Sections 6–7.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Deep-read checklist (2–4 hours):
1) Section 2 (Main Results): pin down assumptions for each theorem and the exact T-dependence; this is the paper’s payload.
2) Section 6 (End-to-End): focus on the lower-bound constructions and the key lemmas explaining why final-token-only supervision is information-poor under long autoregressive chains.
3) Section 7 (CoT supervision): focus on how trajectory labels reduce the problem to stepwise learning, and how the proofs handle the fact that prefix distributions depend on the generator.
4) Section 2.4 (multiple correct outputs / general losses): essential for interpreting the results in realistic LLM settings with non-unique reasoning paths.
Use the paper as a decision tool: for a given task abstraction (choice of F and effective T), ask whether CoT supervision can change the learning rate in T by an order, or only by constants.

recommendation.zh: 直接改变我对“CoT只是更好prompt”的prior：在PAC里给中间轨迹可把样本复杂度从随T爆炸拉回可控；应据此重算CoT标注/合成的ROI。
recommendation.en: This should update your prior that CoT is “just nicer prompting”: in a PAC view, observing intermediate states can avoid T-driven sample-complexity blowups; use it to re-evaluate the ROI of CoT labeling/synthesis.

paper.title: Filtered Reasoning Score: Evaluating Reasoning Quality on a Model's Most-Confident Traces

summary.core_problem: 如何在“推理轨迹/思维链”评测中，避免模型用低置信度或噪声轨迹掩盖真实推理质量，并更可靠地衡量模型在其最自信输出上的推理能力。
summary.importance: 属于评测方法/机制分析类贡献：提出一种更贴近“模型真实会采用的推理”的评测视角（聚焦最自信轨迹并过滤），有助于减少CoT评测中的方差与投机行为，对推理能力度量、训练信号设计（如偏好学习/自训练）都有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Filtered Reasoning Score（FRS）框架：从模型生成的多条推理轨迹中，基于模型自身置信度（如token概率/序列得分等）选取“最自信”的轨迹集合，并对其中不满足某些质量/一致性条件的轨迹进行过滤，再在过滤后的轨迹上计算推理质量分数；核心思想是把评测目标从“平均轨迹质量”转为“模型最可能采用的高置信轨迹质量”。
summary.experiments: 摘要缺失，无法确认：使用的任务集合（数学/逻辑/多跳QA等）、采用的模型规模、置信度定义细节、与哪些推理评测指标对比（如pass@k、self-consistency、CoT正确率等）、以及提升幅度或相关性分析结果。

summary_en.core_problem: How to evaluate chain-of-thought reasoning without letting low-confidence/noisy traces distort the measurement, by focusing on the model’s most-confident traces as a proxy for its actual reasoning behavior.
summary_en.importance: An evaluation/analysis contribution: reframes reasoning assessment toward high-confidence traces, potentially reducing variance and gaming in CoT-style evaluation, and offering signals relevant to preference learning or self-training pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Filtered Reasoning Score (FRS): generate multiple reasoning traces, select the most-confident ones according to model confidence (e.g., sequence/token likelihood), filter out traces failing certain quality/consistency criteria, and compute reasoning quality on the remaining set—shifting from average-trace quality to high-confidence-trace quality.
summary_en.experiments: Abstract not available; cannot verify tasks, model sizes, confidence definition, baselines (e.g., pass@k, self-consistency), or quantitative gains/correlation results.

recommendation.zh: CoT评测里“挑最自信轨迹再打分”能显著降方差、减少投机，但也可能偏向过度自信模型；只看指标定义与和pass@k/SC的对照实验。
recommendation.en: Scoring only the model’s most-confident traces can cut variance and gaming in CoT evals, though it may reward overconfidence; read the metric definition and the comparisons vs pass@k/self-consistency.

paper.title: Do Thought Streams Matter? Evaluating Reasoning in Gemini Vision-Language Models for Video Scene Understanding
paper.abstract: We benchmark how internal reasoning traces, which we call thought streams, affect video scene understanding in vision-language models. Using four configurations of Google's Gemini 2.5 Flash and Flash Lite across scenes extracted from 100 hours of video, we ask three questions: does more thinking lead to better outputs, where do the gains stop, and what do these models actually think about? We introduce three evaluation metrics. Contentfulness measures how much of the thought stream is useful sce

summary.core_problem: 评估内部推理轨迹（thought streams / CoT）在视觉语言模型处理视频场景理解任务中的实际收益和饱和点。
summary.importance: 定量分析了多模态模型在推理期计算（inference-time compute）的 scaling 行为，提出了衡量思考内容有效性和忠实度的新指标。
summary.technical_approach: 使用 Gemini 2.5 Flash 和 Flash Lite 在 100 小时视频场景上进行测试。引入 Contentfulness（有用内容占比）、Thought-Final Coverage（思考到输出的转化率）和 Dominant Entity Analysis 三个指标，并用 GPT-5 作为裁判。
summary.experiments: 发现增加思考带来的质量提升会迅速进入平台期，大部分收益集中在前几百个 token 内；Flash Lite 在质量和 token 消耗之间取得了最佳平衡。

summary_en.core_problem: Evaluates the actual benefits and saturation points of internal reasoning traces (thought streams / CoT) for video scene understanding in VLMs.
summary_en.importance: Quantitatively analyzes the scaling behavior of inference-time compute in multimodal models, introducing new metrics for thought utility and faithfulness.
summary_en.technical_approach: Tests Gemini 2.5 Flash and Flash Lite on 100 hours of video scenes. Introduces metrics like Contentfulness, Thought-Final Coverage, and Dominant Entity Analysis, using GPT-5 as an independent judge.
summary_en.experiments: Finds that quality gains from additional thinking plateau quickly, with most improvements occurring in the first few hundred tokens; Flash Lite offers the best quality-to-token balance.

recommendation.zh: 对多模态 CoT 的定量分析，指出视频理解任务中 inference-time compute 的收益极易饱和，打破了 'think longer, do better' 的线性预期。
recommendation.en: Quantitative analysis of multimodal CoT showing that inference-time compute gains plateau very quickly in video understanding, challenging the 'think longer, do better' expectation.

paper.title: Audio Flamingo Next: Next-Generation Open Audio-Language Models for Speech, Sound, and Music

summary.core_problem: 开放式大音频语言模型（LALM）在真实世界长音频、复杂声学场景（噪声、多说话人、跨语种、音乐/环境声混合）上的泛化与推理能力不足；同时训练往往过度绑定学术基准，导致“榜单好看但部署不稳”，且缺少对长音频进行可对齐、可解释推理的机制。
summary.importance: 音频是通用多模态系统的关键输入（对话、情境感知、音乐理解等）。若开放社区无法获得可复现、可扩展的训练配方与数据构建方法，音频理解会长期落后于视觉语言模型，进而限制语音助手、长音频检索/总结、音频生成与世界建模等下游能力。AF-Next试图把“开放、可规模化、面向真实长音频”的LALM推进到新一代水平，并提供可复现的训练范式与检查点。
summary.technical_approach: AF-Next沿用Audio Flamingo系列的模块化架构：Whisper系音频编码器（AF-Whisper，进一步在更大更杂的多语种与多说话人语料上预训练）+ 音频投影器（将音频表征对齐到LLM语言空间）+ 文本LLM骨干 + 流式TTS。输入端采用16kHz单声道、log-mel谱（25ms窗/10ms hop），以30秒非重叠chunk做滑窗式特征提取，支持最长约30分钟长音频。训练上强调“超越学术基准的数据规模化构建”与“后训练推理能力”：使用四阶段课程式训练（多轮SFT + 基于GRPO的RL）在精心配比的数据混合上提升通用指令跟随、ASR/字幕、长音频理解与鲁棒性。关键新增范式为Temporal Audio Chain-of-Thought：在长音频推理中显式把中间推理步骤锚定到时间戳，实现细粒度时间对齐与可追溯证据链（尤其适合长音频问答、事件定位、分段总结等）。同时发布三类面向不同使用场景的checkpoint：Instruct（通用QA/指令）、Think（更强推理）、Captioner（更细致描述）。
summary.experiments: 论文宣称在20+音频理解与推理基准上达到SOTA或显著领先同尺寸开源模型，并在长且复杂的真实世界音频上对更大开权重/闭源模型保持竞争力甚至超越。评测覆盖语音（含多说话人ASR）、环境声、音乐理解，以及长音频能力（最长30分钟）、时间戳预测/对齐、长音频caption与指令跟随等更贴近应用的任务维度。整体实验意图是证明：更强的基础音频-语言模型 + 可扩展数据构建 + 课程式后训练 + 时间戳链式推理，能系统性提升鲁棒性与长音频推理质量。
summary.reading_guide:
must_read（精读建议）
1) Introduction：抓住作者对“benchmark-centric训练”的批判与真实世界长音频动机，理解AF-Next的设计目标与开放策略（权重/数据/代码）。
2) Methodology（含Fig.3）：精读整体架构与长音频处理方式（30s chunk、特征分辨率、投影到LLM空间），这是理解“为何能扩到30分钟”的关键。
3) 训练配方与数据构建章节（文中强调四阶段课程、SFT+GRPO RL、互联网规模数据）：重点看数据来源/过滤/混合比例思想，以及每一阶段对应能力增益（ASR、caption、指令、推理）。
4) Temporal Audio Chain-of-Thought：作为核心创新点，重点看其输出格式（中间步骤+时间戳锚定）、训练信号如何构造、以及在长音频任务上的收益与失败案例。
5) 实验主表与长音频/真实世界设置：优先看与“长、噪、杂、多说话人”相关的评测与消融（是否仅靠更大模型/更强编码器即可？时间戳CoT是否带来可解释对齐？）。

skim（泛读建议）
- 先读Introduction的贡献点列表，明确四个增量：更强基础模型、可扩展数据、30分钟长音频、Temporal Audio CoT。
- 快速扫Methodology的输入处理与组件划分，理解其与AF3的连续性。
- 直接跳到实验总表与长音频相关结果，确认“相对同尺寸开源模型的提升幅度”与“对闭源/大模型的差距”。
- 最后回看Temporal Audio CoT的小节与示例，建立对其可对齐推理输出的直观印象。
summary.authors_note: 作者将AF-Next定位为“首个把开放LALM训练扩展到互联网规模数据”的尝试，并强调完全开放（权重/数据/代码/方法透明）但受数据许可影响以research-only发布；同时通过Instruct/Think/Captioner三检查点覆盖通用对话、强推理与细粒度描述三类需求。

summary_en.core_problem: Open large audio-language models lag behind real-world needs: they often overfit academic benchmarks and generalize poorly to long, noisy, diverse audio (multi-speaker speech, multilingual content, mixed speech/sound/music). In addition, long-audio reasoning lacks an explicit, temporally grounded mechanism that links intermediate reasoning to evidence in time.
summary_en.importance: Audio understanding is foundational for general-purpose multimodal systems (conversation, situational awareness, music listening) and downstream applications (long-form QA/summarization, retrieval, generation, world modeling). Without reproducible, scalable open training recipes and data construction beyond benchmarks, progress in open LALMs will remain slower than VLMs, limiting both research and deployment robustness.
summary_en.technical_approach: AF-Next follows the Audio Flamingo modular design: a Whisper-family audio encoder (AF-Whisper, further pretrained on larger/more diverse multilingual and multi-talker corpora) + an audio projector into the LLM embedding space + a text-only pretrained LLM backbone + streaming TTS. Audio is resampled to 16 kHz mono, converted to 128-bin log-mel (25 ms window / 10 ms hop), and processed in non-overlapping 30-second chunks with sliding-window style feature extraction, enabling up to ~30 minutes of audio. Training emphasizes scalable internet-scale data curation and post-training for reasoning via a four-stage curriculum with multiple rounds of SFT and GRPO-based RL over carefully curated mixtures. The key new paradigm is Temporal Audio Chain-of-Thought: intermediate reasoning steps are explicitly grounded to timestamps in long audio, enabling fine-grained temporal alignment and traceable evidence for long-form audio reasoning. The release includes three checkpoints: AF-Next-Instruct (general instruction/QA), AF-Next-Think (stronger reasoning), and AF-Next-Captioner (detailed captioning).
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports state-of-the-art results across 20+ audio understanding and reasoning benchmarks, large gains over similarly sized open models, and strong competitiveness (sometimes surpassing) larger open-weight or closed models—especially on long, complex real-world audio. Evaluations span speech (including multi-talker ASR), environmental sounds, music understanding, long-audio capabilities (up to 30 minutes), timestamped prediction/alignment, long-form captioning, and instruction following. The experimental narrative is that stronger foundations + scalable data + curriculum post-training + temporally grounded CoT jointly improve robustness and long-audio reasoning quality.
summary_en.reading_guide:
must_read (deep dive)
1) Introduction: focus on the critique of benchmark-centric training and the motivation for real-world long-audio robustness and openness.
2) Methodology (incl. Fig. 3): study the end-to-end architecture and long-audio processing (30s chunks, temporal resolution, projection into LLM space) to understand how 30-minute inputs are supported.
3) Data curation + training curriculum: prioritize the internet-scale data construction/filters/mixtures and the four-stage SFT+GRPO RL recipe; map each stage to capability gains (ASR, captioning, instruction following, reasoning).
4) Temporal Audio Chain-of-Thought: treat as the main innovation—read the output format (steps + timestamps), how supervision is built, and where it helps/fails on long-audio tasks.
5) Main results tables and long/real-world settings: concentrate on long/noisy/multi-speaker evaluations and ablations (is scaling alone enough? does timestamped CoT improve alignment and interpretability?).

skim (fast pass)
- Read the contribution bullets in the Introduction to capture the four deltas: stronger foundation, scalable data, 30-min audio, Temporal Audio CoT.
- Skim Methodology for the component breakdown and chunking strategy.
- Jump to the headline benchmark tables and long-audio results to gauge improvements vs. same-size open models and gaps to closed systems.
- Finally skim the Temporal Audio CoT section and qualitative examples to build intuition for timestamp-grounded reasoning outputs.
summary_en.authors_note: AF-Next is positioned as the first fully open LALM scaling audio understanding to internet-scale data, with transparent methodology and open-sourced code/data/weights (research-only licensing due to data constraints). The three released checkpoints target general instruction, advanced reasoning, and detailed captioning use cases.

recommendation.zh: 更像开放配方与工程基线：预训练研究员只需看数据构建/长音频训练细节与消融，结论主要指导“怎么训”而非新机制。
recommendation.en: Primarily an open recipe/engineering baseline—focus on dataset construction, long-audio training details, and ablations; it’s more “how to train” than new theory.

paper.title: Bringing Value Models Back: Generative Critics for Value Modeling in LLM Reinforcement Learning

summary.core_problem: LLM 后训练 RL 中的核心瓶颈是长序列生成的 credit assignment：奖励通常只在序列末端给一个标量，导致难以判断哪些中间 token/决策真正促成了最终成功。经典 actor-critic 依赖 value function 做细粒度 advantage 估计，但在 LLM 规模下“判别式（discriminative）一发标量预测”的 value model 往往难训、不稳、效果不随规模可靠提升，实践中被 GRPO/RLOO 等 value-free 方法替代，从而把序列问题近似成 contextual bandit，牺牲精细归因能力。
summary.importance: 随着应用走向更长上下文（复杂推理、多轮对话、agentic 系统），uniform credit（把同一序列奖励广播到所有 token）会成为性能上限：它无法对关键推理分叉、错误早期决策、以及中间步骤质量提供足够训练信号。论文的意义在于：不是“critic 不需要”，而是“现有 critic 表达范式不够”，因此需要把 value modeling 以更可表达、更可校准的方式带回 LLM RL，以恢复细粒度 credit assignment 与更高样本效率。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 Generative Actor-Critic (GenAC)：用“生成式 critic”替代传统 one-shot 标量回归 critic。核心思想是让 critic 像解题一样先进行显式 chain-of-thought/逐步推理，再输出 value/优势相关估计，从而提升表达能力，缓解表示复杂度（representation complexity）导致的近似困难。作者从理论与实证两方面论证：在 one-shot 标量预测范式下，某些 value function 近似具有较高表示复杂度，导致即便扩大模型规模也不稳定/不单调变好，且对随机种子敏感。为解决训练过程中 critic 与当前 policy 分布漂移导致的失配，论文进一步引入 In-Context Conditioning：在 critic 的输入中加入与“当前策略行为/候选轨迹”相关的上下文条件，使 critic 在训练迭代中保持对当前 policy 的校准（calibration），从而更稳定地产生可用的 token-level 信号。整体上，GenAC 试图恢复 PPO/GAE 式的细粒度优势估计，但把 value 估计从‘直接回归’升级为‘先推理再估值’的生成过程。
summary.experiments: 论文在数学推理类基准上评估 GenAC，关注样本效率与训练后期是否继续提升。结论包括：GenAC 相比 value-free 基线具有更高 sample efficiency，并且在基线出现平台期的训练区间仍能持续改进。配套分析显示生成式 critic 在候选动作/续写的排序（ranking）上更可靠、在分布外（OOD）泛化更好，并能给出更可解释的 credit assignment（与推理质量一致的归因）。此外，作者做了受控 scaling 实验来展示传统判别式 critic 的误差不随规模稳定下降且对 seed 敏感，用以支撑“表达性不足而非纯优化问题”的主张。
summary.reading_guide:
must_read（精读）建议：
1) Introduction：把“critic 为何在 LLM RL 里失宠”与“为何这会限制长程推理”讲清楚，是全文动机与问题定义的关键。
2) 理论部分（representation complexity 相关论证）：重点理解作者为何认为 one-shot scalar value prediction 在函数近似上先天吃亏；建议把该论证与后面的 scaling 实验对照阅读。
3) 方法章节（GenAC + In-Context Conditioning）：精读 critic 的生成式输出格式、训练目标如何从生成文本中提取 value/advantage、以及 ICC 如何缓解 policy-critic 分布漂移与校准问题。
4) 实验主表 + scaling/seed 稳定性图：重点看“随训练步数/样本数的曲线是否持续上升”“平台期对比”“seed 方差”，以及 ranking/OOD/可解释性分析对应的图表与案例。

skim（泛读）建议：
- 先读 Introduction + 方法概览图/伪代码（若有）把 GenAC 的输入输出与训练闭环搞清楚；
- 再快速扫实验主结果（数学推理）与两类关键分析：传统 critic 的 scaling/seed 不稳定证据、以及 GenAC 的 ranking/OOD/解释性收益；
- 细节（如具体 prompt 模板、实现超参）可后置。
summary.authors_note: 作者的核心立场是：现代 LLM RL 回避 value model 并不意味着 value function 无用，而是传统“判别式一发标量回归”critic 的表达范式不适配长程推理的价值估计；通过让 critic 以生成式推理来表达中间结构，并用 in-context 条件化保持对当前策略的校准，可以把经典 actor-critic 的细粒度 credit assignment 优势重新带回 LLM 后训练。

summary_en.core_problem: A key bottleneck in LLM post-training RL is long-horizon credit assignment: supervision is typically a single scalar outcome reward at the end of a generated sequence, making it hard to identify which intermediate tokens/decisions caused success. Classical actor-critic methods address this via value functions and fine-grained advantage estimation, but at LLM scale conventional discriminative critics (one-shot scalar value prediction) are hard to train reliably, do not improve consistently with scale, and are sensitive to random seeds. As a result, practice has shifted to value-free methods (e.g., GRPO/RLOO) that broadcast uniform credit across tokens, effectively reducing sequence generation to a contextual bandit and weakening token-level attribution.
summary_en.importance: As LLM applications move to longer contexts (complex reasoning, multi-turn dialogue, agentic workflows), uniform reward broadcast can become a performance ceiling: it cannot properly reinforce pivotal reasoning forks or penalize early mistakes. The paper’s significance is the claim that critics are not inherently unnecessary—rather, existing critics are under-expressive. Restoring robust value modeling can bring back fine-grained credit assignment and improve sample efficiency for long-horizon reasoning tasks.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes Generative Actor-Critic (GenAC), replacing one-shot scalar regression with a generative critic that explicitly performs chain-of-thought-style reasoning before emitting value estimates. The motivation is representational: representation complexity theory suggests some value functions are intrinsically hard to approximate under the one-shot scalar prediction paradigm, which the authors support with controlled scaling experiments showing non-monotonic/unstable error vs. model size and strong seed sensitivity. To mitigate critic-policy mismatch during training, GenAC introduces In-Context Conditioning, conditioning the critic on context reflecting the current policy/trajectory distribution to keep value estimates calibrated throughout RL updates. Overall, GenAC aims to recover PPO/GAE-like dense advantages, but upgrades the critic from direct regression to “reason-then-evaluate” generation.
summary_en.experiments: On mathematical reasoning benchmarks, GenAC shows better sample efficiency and continues improving in regimes where strong baselines plateau. Supporting analyses indicate the generative critic more reliably ranks candidate actions/continuations, generalizes better out-of-distribution, and yields interpretable credit assignments aligned with reasoning quality. The paper also includes scaling/seed-stability studies demonstrating that standard discriminative critics do not reliably improve with scale, reinforcing the expressiveness-based diagnosis.
summary_en.reading_guide:
must_read (deep dive):
1) Introduction: key motivation—why critics fell out of favor in LLM RL and why that harms long-horizon reasoning.
2) Theory/diagnosis (representation complexity argument): understand why one-shot scalar critics can be fundamentally under-expressive; read alongside the scaling/seed experiments.
3) Method (GenAC + In-Context Conditioning): focus on the critic’s generative format, how value/advantages are extracted, and how ICC maintains calibration under policy drift.
4) Main results + analysis figures: prioritize learning curves (plateau vs. continued gains), seed variance, and the ranking/OOD/interpretability analyses.

skim (high-level):
- Read Introduction and the method overview/diagram/pseudocode to grasp the training loop;
- Skim the main math-reasoning results and two key analyses: (i) discriminative critic scaling instability, (ii) GenAC ranking/OOD/interpretability benefits;
- Defer implementation details (prompt templates, hyperparameters) unless reproducing.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors’ thesis is that value models were abandoned not because critics are useless, but because the prevailing discriminative one-shot scalar critic is an ill-suited, under-expressive paradigm for long-horizon value estimation in LLMs. A generative, reasoning-based critic plus in-context conditioning can make value modeling robust again and restore fine-grained credit assignment in LLM RL.

recommendation.zh: 改变“value-free 足够”的直觉：生成式 critic 让 credit assignment 可表达且可校准；建议重点看 value 训练稳定性与长序列增益那几张表。
recommendation.en: It challenges the “value-free is enough” instinct: a generative critic is a more expressive, calibratable route to credit assignment—focus on the stability evidence and long-horizon gains tables.

paper.title: Reason Only When Needed: Efficient Generative Reward Modeling via Model-Internal Uncertainty

summary.core_problem: 现有 Generative Reward Model（GRM）在推理增强中普遍“对所有输入都强制 CoT”，导致不必要的算力/时延；同时对 CoT 路径质量的评估多依赖投票，粒度粗、难以区分细微优劣，限制了奖励信号的保真度与最终性能。问题是：能否用任务无关的内部信号决定何时需要 CoT，并提供更细粒度的推理链评分？
